articles.title: Cost of living protests  to spread to Germany and reignite in France on Halloween
articles.author: Deborah Cole in Berlin and Jon Henley in Paris

paras.en: Street protests sweeping Europe are expected to spread to Germany and reignite in France on Saturday, with police mobilised to stop potential looting and rioting on the fringes of what organisers hope will be peaceful rallies.

Weeks of, at times violent, student demonstrations have rocked Italy, Spain, Portugal, Albania and France, where activists on Halloween have again called for people to make their anger over the cost of living and deficient public services felt across the country.

In Germany, a loose alliance of groups called Gen Z regelt (Gen Z is sorting it) has called for supporters to turn out in more than 30 cities demanding more spending on schools, climate protection and housing, and against any plans to return to mandatory military service.

Alexander Throm, of the ruling conservative Christian Democratic Union (CDU) parliamentary group, wrote in the Handelsblatt business newspaper: “Scenes like those in France must be prevented at all costs.”
But Felix Banaszak, the co-leader of the opposition Green party, cautioned against attempts to place the youth protests under general suspicion in advance.

“The [CDU’s] rhetoric, which seeks to criminalise these protests pre-emptively and paint them as the work of marauding gangs, may even drive people towards radicalisation,” he told the RND media group.
Berlin’s police chief, Barbara Slowik Meisel, said she would deploy an additional 1,500 officers in the capital, though she had little reason to fear that people or property would come under attack.
“We have no concrete evidence of any coordinated looting operations being planned,” she said.

About 10,000 protesters, mainly pupils, students and their parents, are expected at the Brandenburg Gate on Saturday afternoon, with another smaller gathering planned in the early evening in the Mitte district.
Large rallies have also been called in Cologne, Munich, Frankfurt and Hamburg.

The team behind Gen Z regelt has used social media and its website to call on participants to exercise restraint: “Our protest is peaceful, without exception. Violence goes against everything we stand for. Only through peaceful means can we achieve something together.”
By Friday, more than 160,000 people had registered on the website saying they planned to attend the protests.

The federal pupils’ conference, a youth political lobbying group, has distanced itself from Saturday’s demonstrations, saying the initiative’s “unclear” organisational structure made the events unpredictable.
It plans to hold a separate protest in Berlin on 20 November that will include teachers and other youth movements focused on the marked decline in German school performance.

In France, the interior minister, Laurent Nuñez, said Saturday looked like “a very high risk” day, adding that 70,000 police and gendarmes, including elite units, would be deployed in an effort to quell violence on the sidelines of the new wave of protests.

Nuñez said late on Thursday that radical groups had called on social media for violent Halloween gatherings and that the biggest threat to public order would probably come after mainstream cost-of-living demonstrations had officially ended.

“We are seeing many calls from the labour movement, the radicalised far left and certain radicalised gilets jaunes [yellow vests], urging people to attend rallies on public streets starting at 8pm in many cities across France,” he said.

The calls were “accompanied by various messages which are quite radical”, Nuñez added, including some demanding “revolution”. He said authorities would “tolerate zero excesses” and promised an “extremely firm” security response.

Measures introduced last weekend to protect shops would be reinforced, Nuñez said, and while peaceful demonstrations would be authorised, most would not be permitted “in city centres, where there is a risk of public disorder”.

In Paris, two separate marches planned by unions and gilets jaunes through the city centre have been banned. Instead, police have authorised a single march in the far south-east. An appeal by organisers against the decision to exclude them from the centre was rejected late on Friday night.

The interior ministry has said 410,000 people marched last Saturday, when a strong police presence mostly prevented a repeat of the widespread violence and looting that swept French cities during a first wave of mass protest on 17 October.

Unions and the gilets jaunes movement protesting over low wages, the cost of living and deteriorating public services have joined school and university students calling for better learning conditions, with a nationwide strike called for 5 November.

Government measures to address the students’ demands – including replacing a creaking university admissions platform and providing loans to local authorities for school renovations – did not go far enough, student leaders said.

articles.title: Starmer says UK must get closer to Europe as US relationship changes
articles.author: Kevin Rawlinson

paras.en: The UK and other European nations must draw closer together as the US becomes a less-reliable partner, Keir Starmer has said in his first significant political intervention since leaving No 10.
paras.zh: Keir Starmer在离开第10名后的第一次重大政治干预中表示，随着美国成为一个不太可靠的伙伴，英国和其他欧洲国家必须走得更近。

paras.en: The former prime minister warned European leaders of the threat posed by Russia, among others, and said the shift in relations with Washington during Donald Trump’s presidency was not likely to reset once he leaves the Oval Office. He accused them of being caught out by these new realities twice already.
paras.zh: 这位前总理警告欧洲领导人俄罗斯等构成的威胁，并表示在唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）担任总统期间与华盛顿的关系转变不太可能在他离开椭圆形办公室后重置。他指责他们已经两次被这些新的现实所困扰。

paras.en: “A stronger Europe is vital and the UK must be at the heart of it,” Starmer told an audience at the British Irish Chamber of Commerce on Friday. “Europe has twice been caught asleep, failing to anticipate and prepare for predictable events.
paras.zh: “一个更强大的欧洲至关重要，英国必须处于其核心地位，” Starmer周五在英国爱尔兰商会向观众表示。“欧洲两次陷入困境，未能对可预测的事件进行预测和准备。

paras.en: “First, when Russia’s attack on Ukraine exposed longstanding European weaknesses on defence and security, and second, when President Trump made clear, once and for all, that the US will no longer bankroll our European security. We have to catch up.”
paras.zh: “首先，俄罗斯对乌克兰的攻击暴露了欧洲在国防和安全方面的长期弱点，其次，特朗普总统一劳永逸地明确表示，美国将不再为我们的欧洲安全提供资金。我们必须迎头赶上。”

paras.en: Starmer had called for closer European ties before stepping down as prime minister in July. Three months earlier, amid Trump’s war with Iran and his threats to withdraw from Nato, Starmer said Europe represented a “partnership for a dangerous world we must navigate together”.
paras.zh: Starmer在7月份辞去总理职务之前曾呼吁加强欧洲关系。三个月前，在特朗普与伊朗的战争以及他威胁退出北约的情况下，斯塔默表示，欧洲代表了“一个我们必须共同驾驭的危险世界的伙伴关系”。

paras.en: He said those ties should go further than just defence, adding that Brexit had done “deep damage” to the UK economy, and that he wanted to be “more ambitious”, including pursuing “closer economic cooperation [and] closer security cooperation”.
paras.zh: 他说，这些关系应该不仅仅是防御，并补充说，英国脱欧对英国经济造成了“严重损害” ，他希望“更雄心勃勃” ，包括追求“更紧密的经济合作[和]更紧密的安全合作”。

paras.en: Starmer spoke after spending time in Dublin meeting senior business leaders and politicians, including the taoiseach, Micheál Martin, with whom he established the annual UK-Ireland summit.
paras.zh: Starmer在都柏林与高级商界领袖和政界人士会面后发表了讲话，其中包括总理Micheál Martin ，他与他建立了一年一度的英国-爱尔兰峰会。

paras.en: “I will say here what I have said to European leaders. This is about responding to a permanent change of affairs, not an aberration of the Trump presidency. Things will not go back to the way they were before.
paras.zh: “我将在这里说我对欧洲领导人所说的话。这是为了应对事务的永久性变化，而不是特朗普总统任期的失常。事情不会回到以前的样子。

paras.en: “That doesn’t mean the US relationship is no longer important. On the contrary, the military, security and intelligence alliance is far too strong for that. But it does mean enabling Europe to take on far more responsibility for its own defence and security.”

His comments reflect a growing consensus on the left of UK politics that closer ties with Europe are essential to ensure economic and military security. Soon after taking office as Starmer’s successor, Andy Burnham said that he intended to be “bolder” about closer ties with the EU.
Next month, Burnham will attend a crucial EU-UK summit where new agreements on food standards, energy and youth mobility will be the main focus.

Burnham has also said he wants a public debate on how the UK could move to a closer relationship with the EU after the next election. At a meeting of European defence ministers in Paris this week, the defence secretary, Wes Streeting, said that they were “united and unwavering” in support for Ukraine in the face of Russian hostility.

Starmer said: “We need to build up pan-European cooperation and coordination on defence and security – a common security framework as much as a common market. The EU is changing to respond to that, but it cannot be the EU alone when Europe’s periphery is core to its defence.

“Britain must be central to that project. We are one of two nuclear powers. We are a leading Nato member. We have a viable next-generation fighter jet programme. And we are pledged to work alongside European allies to guarantee security in Ukraine.

“Ireland and the UK stand side by side in the coalition of the willing and with Ukraine, working together to guarantee and shape the security of our continent. I hope and believe that Britain’s relationship with its friends and allies can and should be strengthened by this urgent and common security project.”

articles.title: Protests under way in Germany and France as minister warns against use of Halloween masks – Europe live
articles.author: Nadeem Badshah (now) and Taz Ali (earlier)

paras.en: 320,000 attend protests in France, according to government
paras.zh: 据政府称， 32万人参加了法国的抗议活动

paras.en: Turnout at the protests in France against the cost of living stood at 320,000 nationwide, the interior ministry said, lower than the 410,000 seen the previous Saturday and 550,000 on October 17 when riots erupted across the country.
paras.zh: 内政部表示，法国全国范围内反对生活费用的抗议活动的投票率为32万，低于上周六的41万和10月17日全国爆发骚乱时的55万。

paras.en: Demonstrations were largely peaceful through the afternoon, though police fired tear gas in Lyon, France’s third-largest city, and Toulouse in the southwest, while tension also broke out at the end of the march in Marseille, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，示威活动在整个下午基本上是和平的，尽管警察在法国第三大城市里昂和西南部的图卢兹发射了催泪瓦斯，而在马赛游行结束时也爆发了紧张局势。

paras.en: Police cancel march in Cologne due to masked protesters
paras.zh: 由于戴面具的抗议者，警方取消了在科隆的游行

paras.en: Police in the German city of Cologne have called off the march organised by Gen Z regelt due to some protesters wearing masks and throwing smoke bombs.
paras.zh: 由于一些抗议者戴着口罩并投掷烟雾弹，德国科隆市警方取消了Z世代组织的游行。

paras.en: “The demonstration will continue as a stationary rally,” a police spokesperson told German DPA news agency.
paras.zh: “示威活动将继续作为固定集会，”警方发言人告诉德国DPA通讯社。

paras.en: Police officers at Place de la Bastille in Paris, where protest organisers had originally planned to begin the march before authorities banned the route and ordered it to start at Porte de Bagnolet, on the eastern edge of the capital:
paras.zh: 巴黎巴士底广场（ Place de la Bastille ）的警察，抗议活动组织者最初计划在当局禁止这条路线并命令它从首都东部边缘的巴尼奥莱门（ Porte de Bagnolet ）开始之前开始游行：

paras.en: A few Halloween costumes stood out in the crowd, including a zombie Michael Jackson from “Thriller,” a pirate and a Spider-Man. Protesters waited calmly, chanting and singing through megaphones.
paras.zh: 一些万圣节服装在人群中脱颖而出，包括一个来自“惊悚片”的僵尸迈克尔杰克逊，一个海盗和一个蜘蛛侠。抗议者静静地等待着，用扩音器唱着歌。

paras.en: Corentin Cabreux, a 21-year-old student, said he lives in a state-run student residence where “there are damp stains all along the bottom of my walls, whole sections peeling off, cockroaches everywhere, rats.”
paras.zh: 21岁的学生Corentin Cabreux说，他住在国营的学生公寓里， “我的墙壁底部到处都是潮湿的污渍，整个部分都在剥落，到处都是蟑螂，老鼠。”

paras.en: He said he hoped Saturday’s protest would be festive in honor of Halloween, to counter the image of violence that has attached itself to France’s protests.
paras.zh: 他说，他希望周六的抗议活动是为了庆祝万圣节，以对抗与法国抗议活动有关的暴力形象。

paras.en: France interior ministry says 15,000 people taking part in protests
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，有1.5万人参加抗议活动

paras.en: The French interior ministry said about 15,000 people were taking part in demonstrations across the country, adding that the situation remained “generally calm”.
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，约有15,000人参加全国各地的示威活动，并补充说局势“总体平静”。

paras.en: The protests were unfolding “without any notable incidents”, the ministry added.
paras.zh: 该部补充说，抗议活动正在展开， “没有任何明显的事件”。

paras.en: Police had made 27 arrests by 2pm local time, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，截至当地时间下午2点，警方已逮捕27人。

paras.en: So far, police in Germany have reported 2,700 protesters in Berlin, with 1,800 people participating in Munich, and about 1,000 in Frankfurt. Police in Cologne have not provided figures but said it was “significantly” lower than the 15,000 registered by organisers, according to the German newspaper Die Welt.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，德国警方报告说，柏林有2700名抗议者，慕尼黑有1800人参加，法兰克福约有1000人参加。据德国《世界报》报道，科隆警方没有提供数据，但表示这“大大”低于组织者登记的1.5万人。

articles.title: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak

paras.en: More than 5,000 people have died from an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, government data shows.
paras.zh: 政府数据显示，刚果民主共和国已有5000多人死于持续的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: Eight of 26 provinces are now affected, with more than 10,300 confirmed cases.
paras.zh: 26个省份中有8个受到影响，确诊病例超过10,300例。

paras.en: The outbreak, which started in May, became the country's deadliest in its history in August, public health officials said. The current case fatality rate is 48.6%.
paras.zh: 公共卫生官员表示，疫情始于5月，成为该国8月份历史上最致命的疫情。目前的病例死亡率为48.6%。

paras.en: In its latest update, the health ministry said the epicentre of the epidemic remains in the Ituri province, in the north-east of the country, which is a conflict zone, making it harder to contain the virus.
paras.zh: 在最新的更新中，卫生部表示，疫情的中心仍然在该国东北部的伊图里省，这是一个冲突地区，使遏制病毒变得更加困难。

paras.en: Cases have also been confirmed in Kenya, Nigeria and Uganda.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚、尼日利亚和乌干达也确诊了病例。

paras.en: This marks the 17th outbreak in DR Congo's history, according to the United Nations (UN), and the second largest in history.
paras.zh: 根据联合国的数据，这是刚果民主共和国历史上第17次爆发疫情，也是历史上第二大疫情。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) office in Africa said a "continued scale-up of key control measures, greater access to affected areas, and community outreach" is needed to end the outbreak.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（世卫组织）驻非洲办事处表示，为了结束疫情，需要“继续扩大关键控制措施，更多地进入受影响地区，并开展社区外联活动”。

paras.en: Testing and treatment are under way, along with clinical trials of vaccines, it added.
paras.zh: 它补充说，正在进行测试和治疗，以及疫苗的临床试验。

paras.en: The Bundibugyo species is behind the current outbreak, but there is not yet any treatment or vaccine for this strain.
paras.zh: Bundibugyo物种是当前疫情的幕后黑手，但目前还没有任何针对该菌株的治疗或疫苗。

paras.en: DR Congo's previous deadliest outbreak saw 2,299 deaths recorded between 2018-2020, the UN said.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，刚果民主共和国此前最致命的疫情在2018年至2020年期间记录了2,299人死亡。

paras.en: The deadliest in history occurred in West Africa between 2014 and 2016, killing more than 11,325 people and spread across several countries, including Italy, the UK and United States, according to the WHO.
paras.zh: 根据世界卫生组织的数据，历史上最严重的死亡事件发生在2014年至2016年期间在西非，造成超过11,325人死亡，并蔓延到包括意大利，英国和美国在内的几个国家。

paras.en: The UN warns that the current outbreak is "taking lives at a much faster rate".
paras.zh: 联合国警告说，目前的疫情正在“以更快的速度夺走生命”。

paras.en: Ebola is a rare, deadly disease caused by a virus, and symptoms come on suddenly.
paras.zh: 埃博拉是一种由病毒引起的罕见致命疾病，症状突然出现。

paras.en: As the disease progresses, vomiting and diarrhoea develop and it can lead to organ failure. Some, but not all, patients develop internal and external bleeding.
paras.zh: 随着疾病的进展，呕吐和腹泻会发展，并可能导致器官衰竭。部分（但不是全部）患者出现内外出血。

paras.en: The virus spreads from one person to another by contact with infected bodily fluids such as blood or vomit.
paras.zh: 病毒通过接触受感染的体液（如血液或呕吐物）从一个人传播到另一个人。

paras.en: Adding to the challenge of treating the disease, some health workers and a politician have been attacked while responding to the outbreak.
paras.zh: 除了治疗疾病的挑战外，一些卫生工作者和一名政治家在应对疫情时遭到袭击。

paras.en: Earlier this week, a nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured in an attack when responding to an Ebola alert. Local youths had accused them of contaminating water sources and spreading the virus, according to the UN-backed Radio Okapi.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，一名护士在应对埃博拉警报时遇袭身亡，另一名卫生工作者受重伤。据联合国支持的霍加皮电台（ Radio Okapi ）称，当地青年指责他们污染水源并传播病毒。

paras.en: Last month, a politician was beaten to death after promoting measures to stop the spread of Ebola, while in August, the Red Cross said its volunteers had been injured and an ambulance set on fire in 11 violent incidents in the outbreak's first 100 days.
paras.zh: 上个月，一名政治家在推动阻止埃博拉病毒传播的措施后被殴打致死，而在8月，红十字会表示，在疫情爆发的前100天，其志愿者受伤，一辆救护车在11起暴力事件中被焚烧。

paras.en: In Uganda, two people died and 20 cases were recorded shortly after the outbreak started, but no cases have been reported since August. Travel restrictions remain in place for those crossing into the country from neighbouring DR Congo.
paras.zh: 在乌干达，疫情爆发后不久就有2人死亡， 20例病例被记录在案，但自8月以来没有报告病例。对于从邻国刚果民主共和国进入该国的人，旅行限制仍然有效。

paras.en: In Kenya, there have been nine confirmed cases and two recorded deaths.
paras.zh: 在肯尼亚，已有9例确诊病例和2例记录在案的死亡病例。

paras.en: Two suspected cases were identified in Nigeria on Saturday, its disease control centre said, adding that the individuals have been isolated and they are undergoing testing.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚疾病控制中心表示，周六在尼日利亚发现了两例疑似病例，并补充说，这些人已被隔离，正在接受检测。

paras.en: Earlier in October, one woman was confirmed to have the disease in the country but was flown to Switzerland for further treatment.
paras.zh: 10月初，一名妇女被确认在该国患有这种疾病，但被空运到瑞士接受进一步治疗。

paras.en: The likelihood of infection for people in the Europe area is "very low," the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control said.
paras.zh: 欧洲疾病预防控制中心表示，欧洲地区人们感染的可能性“非常低”。

articles.title: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city

paras.en: There were raw emotional scenes as people evacuated from the devastated Russian-occupied city of Oleshky crossed from Belarus into the Ukrainian region of Chernihiv.
paras.zh: 人们从被俄罗斯占领的城市奥列什基撤离，从白俄罗斯进入乌克兰的切尔尼霍夫地区，出现了原始的情绪场景。

paras.en: Families cried as they reunited with relatives they had not seen for years, with two sisters running and crying out as they embraced their father.
paras.zh: 家人们在与多年未见的亲戚团聚时哭泣，两姐妹在拥抱父亲时奔跑并哭泣。

paras.en: Some elderly residents were so weak they were carried on stretchers. They had been trapped in the frontline city without food, water and electricity, with many resorting to cooking garden weeds to survive.
paras.zh: 一些老年居民非常虚弱，他们被担架抬着。他们被困在前线城市，没有食物、水和电，许多人依靠烹饪花园杂草来生存。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky thanked US First Lady Melania Trump for her efforts in brokering a local ceasefire that paved the way for their evacuation on Friday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）感谢美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普（ Melania Trump ）努力促成当地停火，为周五的撤离铺平了道路。

paras.en: Upon their arrival, Dasha and Anya Palii sprinted across the tarmac screaming towards the bus carrying their father Mykhailo.
paras.zh: 他们到达后， Dasha和Anya Palii冲过停机坪，朝着载有他们父亲Mykhailo的公共汽车尖叫。

paras.en: Their cries and their tears captured the sheer relief of three years of desperate worry, fearing they would never see him again.
paras.zh: 他们的哭声和眼泪完全缓解了三年的绝望担忧，担心他们再也见不到他了。

paras.en: Their mother Zhanna clasped Mykhailo's face and stroked his forehead again and again, as if checking he was the same man she had left behind. He promised her, finally, they will now get married.
paras.zh: 他们的母亲Zhanna紧握着Mykhailo的脸，一遍又一遍地抚摸着他的额头，好像在检查他就是她留下的那个男人。他答应过她，最后，他们现在要结婚了。

paras.en: Tetiana and Volodymyr, an older couple carrying their cat, told the BBC they no longer have a home, after it was burned down in the first year of the war. They have been living in the abandoned house of a neighbour.
paras.zh: 带着猫的老夫妇Tetiana和Volodymyr告诉英国广播公司，在战争的第一年被烧毁后，他们不再有家。他们一直住在邻居的废弃房子里。

paras.en: They said they instantly took the decision to leave but feared their journey could be disrupted. Now they have to work out where to go next and how to rebuild their lives.
paras.zh: 他们说，他们立即决定离开，但担心他们的旅程可能会中断。现在，他们必须找出下一步该去哪里，以及如何重建自己的生活。

paras.en: Ukrainian military positions lie just 5km (3.1 miles) from Oleshky, but evacuees first had to travel through Russian-occupied territory to southern Russia, where they flew to Belarus, before finally being driven across Ukraine's northern border on Saturday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰军事阵地距离奥列什基仅5公里（ 3.1英里） ，但撤离人员首先必须通过俄罗斯占领的领土前往俄罗斯南部，在那里他们飞往白俄罗斯，然后最终于周六被赶过乌克兰北部边境。

paras.en: The oldest evacuee was 94 years old, while the youngest was one, according to Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's human rights ombudsman.
paras.zh: 根据乌克兰人权监察员德米特罗·卢比内茨（ Dmytro Lubinets ）的说法，最年长的撤离者是94岁，最年轻的是一名。

paras.en: Zelensky said in a post on X that "all of them will receive the assistance they need. It is important that government agencies and all the regional and local authorities involved work effectively and help our people adapt."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在X上的一篇帖子中说： “他们都将得到所需的帮助。重要的是，政府机构和所有相关的地区和地方当局都要有效地工作，帮助我们的人民适应。”

paras.en: Many people bear the scars: the convoy includes as many ambulances as coaches. The impact of years caught between the frontlines is written on the weary faces of many of Oleshky's residents, some hobbling on crutches, others needing wheelchairs.
paras.zh: 许多人身上都有伤疤：车队包括与教练一样多的救护车。夹在前线之间的岁月的影响写在Oleshky的许多居民疲惫不堪的面孔上，有些人蹒跚着拐杖，有些人需要轮椅。

paras.en: They have a lot to come to terms with, not least having left the place they call home.
paras.zh: 他们有很多可以接受的事情，尤其是离开了他们称之为家的地方。

paras.en: A humanitarian ceasefire took effect across the frontline region of Kherson on Tuesday, providing the first few days of peace in the area in four years, following Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. Before the war, Oleshky was home to 24,000 people.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯于2022年2月全面入侵乌克兰之后，人道主义停火于周二在赫尔松前线地区生效，为该地区提供了四年来最初几天的和平。战前，奥列什基居住着24000人。

paras.en: Conditions had become so desperate in the city that not only was getting supplies into the city extremely difficult, but escape was highly dangerous because the routes out had been mined and subject to drone attack.
paras.zh: 这座城市的条件变得如此绝望，以至于不仅难以向城市运送物资，而且逃生也非常危险，因为外面的路线已经被开采并受到无人机的攻击。

paras.en: Bridges across the nearby River Dnipro have been destroyed and sources say the riverbank has been mined and is dangerous.
paras.zh: 横跨附近第聂伯河的桥梁已被摧毁，消息人士称该河岸已被埋设地雷，非常危险。

paras.en: One resident who fled the city three weeks earlier told the BBC he had walked through 24km (15 miles) of minefields to get to safety.
paras.zh: 三周前逃离该市的一名居民告诉英国广播公司，他已经走过24公里（ 15英里）的雷区才能安全到达。

paras.en: The ceasefire allowed the road out of the city to be cleared of mines and humanitarian aid to be delivered.
paras.zh: 停火使出城的道路得以清除地雷，并运送人道主义援助物资。

paras.en: Ceasefire measures will remain in place until the end of Sunday 1 November.
paras.zh: 停火措施将持续到11月1日星期日结束。

paras.en: Residents had a four-hour window to leave before a convoy of 25 buses, with space for 750 people, left the town on Friday afternoon - along with ambulances for people with limited mobility.
paras.zh: 周五下午，居民有四小时的时间离开，然后由25辆公共汽车组成的车队，可容纳750人，以及为行动不便者提供的救护车。

paras.en: Several hundred people are understood to have decided to stay in the war-torn city, despite widespread devastation and the lack of gas, electricity and running water.
paras.zh: 据了解，尽管遭受了广泛的破坏，并且缺乏天然气、电力和自来水，但仍有数百人决定留在这座饱受战争蹂躏的城市。

paras.en: Some of the older generation did not want to leave, one relative told the BBC.
paras.zh: 一位亲戚告诉英国广播公司，一些老一辈人不想离开。

paras.en: Lubinets said on Friday morning that those who decided to stay "will receive all the necessary humanitarian assistance".
paras.zh: Lubinets周五上午表示，那些决定留下来的人“将获得所有必要的人道主义援助”。

paras.en: He and his Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova travelled to Oleshky together on Friday, setting off from Armiansk, in the Russian-occupied Crimean peninsula.
paras.zh: 他和他的俄罗斯同行亚娜·兰特拉托娃（ Yana Lantratova ）周五从俄罗斯占领的克里米亚半岛的阿米扬斯克出发，一起前往奥列什基。

paras.en: Lubinets is the first Ukrainian official since the start of the war to visit Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 卢比涅茨是战争开始以来首位访问俄罗斯占领的乌克兰部分地区的乌克兰官员。

paras.en: Zelensky praised him and his team for helping move evacuees out to safety.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基称赞他和他的团队帮助疏散人员安全撤离。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president also thanked those who had helped bring attention to the "true humanitarian catastrophe in Ukrainian territory temporarily occupied by Russia".
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统还感谢那些帮助人们关注“俄罗斯暂时占领的乌克兰领土上真正的人道主义灾难”的人。

paras.en: The ceasefire has required close cooperation between Lubinets and Lantratova, which Lubinets said he carried out in the interests of saving lives.
paras.zh: 停火需要Lubinets和Lantratova之间的密切合作， Lubinets说他是为了挽救生命而进行的。

paras.en: But some in Ukraine have recoiled at the sight of him standing beside a representative of the Russian occupying power which has killed so many of the city's residents and made life unbearable for the rest.
paras.zh: 但是，乌克兰的一些人看到他站在俄罗斯占领国代表旁边时退缩了，俄罗斯占领国代表杀死了该市的许多居民，并使其他人的生活难以忍受。

paras.en: Russia said on Thursday that it had prepared "dozens of tonnes" of aid for the residents who do not wish to leave, including food, medicine, hygiene products and fuel for generators.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯周四表示，已为不想离开的居民准备了“数十吨”的援助，包括食品、药品、卫生用品和发电机燃料。

articles.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack

paras.en: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, says it has covered 90% of the $6.3bn (Â£4.7bn) assets stolen in a hack on Thursday.
paras.zh: 全球最大的加密货币交易所币安表示，它已经覆盖了周四在黑客攻击中被盗的63亿美元资产中的90%。

paras.en: The remaining 10% may take longer to source in the required amounts, the company added.
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，剩余的10%可能需要更长的时间才能达到所需的金额。

paras.en: Binance has consistently pledged to cover 100% of the losses from what is suspected to be crypto's biggest hack on record and said it has set aside more than $6.34bn in company funds to do so.
paras.zh: 币安一直承诺100%弥补被怀疑是有史以来最大规模的加密黑客攻击造成的损失，并表示已拨出超过63.4亿美元的公司资金。

paras.en: "Binance will absorb the financial impact of these stolen funds, not our users," the company said in a statement on Saturday.
paras.zh: “币安将吸收这些被盗资金的财务影响，而不是我们的用户，”该公司周六在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: It said it had replenished the assets using various funds and its own corporate treasury.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，已使用各种资金和自己的公司资金补充了资产。

paras.en: All holdings of the cryptocurrencies bitcoin, ethereum and Tether are covered, along with seven other widely-traded crypto assets, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，所有持有的加密货币比特币、以太坊和Tether以及其他七种广泛交易的加密资产都包括在内。

paras.en: The company said its next goal is resuming withdrawal services for users, saying it remained on track to reopen withdrawals on Sunday 1 November and would provide a further update once details were confirmed.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，其下一个目标是恢复对用户的提款服务，并表示仍有望在11月1日星期日重新开放提款，并将在确认细节后提供进一步的更新。

paras.en: The hack is believed to be the largest in history, eclipsing the record of a $1.5bn heist on the Bybit exchange in 2025.
paras.zh: 这次黑客攻击被认为是历史上规模最大的一次，超过了2025年Bybit交易所15亿美元$抢劫的记录。

paras.en: Binance's initial investigation suggested an engineer's laptop was compromised, which allowed access to unauthorised withdrawals, but a later update said they had uncovered "additional points of breach".
paras.zh: 币安的初步调查表明，一名工程师的笔记本电脑遭到入侵，允许未经授权的提款，但后来的更新称，他们发现了“其他违规点”。

paras.en: Richard Teng, Binance's co-chief executive officer, said the hack was carried out by more than one person, and the hackers used sophisticated methods to hide their tracks, such as a "self-destruct mechanism".
paras.zh: 币安联合首席执行官理查德·滕（ Richard Teng ）表示，这次黑客攻击是由不止一个人实施的，黑客使用了复杂的方法来隐藏他们的踪迹，例如“自毁机制”。

paras.en: On Friday, the company said it had frozen around $3bn of stolen assets after working with law enforcement, intelligence firms and partners.
paras.zh: 周五，该公司表示，在与执法部门、情报公司和合作伙伴合作后，已冻结了大约30 $的被盗资产。

paras.en: The investigation is ongoing, it added. The US Secret Service said on Friday it is "working around the clock" with private sector partners "to identify, freeze, trace, and recover funds" stolen from Binance.
paras.zh: 它补充说，调查正在进行中。美国特勤局周五表示，它正在与私营部门合作伙伴“全天候工作” ，以“识别、冻结、追踪和追回从币安窃取的资金”。

paras.en: Two major blockchain analytics firms say they have robust intelligence pointing to a North Korean state-backed group called The Lazarus Group, also known as TraderTraitor, as the likely culprits.
paras.zh: 两家主要的区块链分析公司表示，他们拥有强大的情报，指出朝鲜国家支持的一个名为The Lazarus Group的组织（也称为TraderTraitor ）可能是罪魁祸首。

paras.en: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said North Korea was responsible for the theft of $1.5bn on the Bybit exchange last year.
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局（ FBI ）表示，朝鲜应对去年在Bybit交易所盗窃的15亿美元负责。

paras.en: North Korea has always denied involvement in these attacks.
paras.zh: 朝鲜一直否认参与这些袭击。

paras.en: Binance, founded in China in 2017, lets users buy, sell and trade digital assets - it is estimated to have hundreds of millions of users worldwide.
paras.zh: 币安于2017年在中国成立，允许用户购买、出售和交易数字资产--据估计，它在全球拥有数亿用户。

paras.en: Crypto is a digital asset, which doesn't exist physically and is instead accessed via digital wallets or computers.
paras.zh: 加密货币是一种数字资产，实际上并不存在，而是通过数字钱包或计算机进行访问。

articles.title: NAPA Apprentice Program Builds a New Path Into the Service Bay
articles.author: NAPA

paras.en: As repair shops across the country struggle to recruit qualified technicians, the NAPA Auto Care Apprentice Program offers participating businesses a structured way to develop new talent inside their own service bays.

More than 700 NAPA Auto Care centers nationwide participate in the program, which combines technical education, hands-on experience and mentorship. Its mission is to educate and cultivate the next generation of automotive repair professionals by providing a broad learning experience that combines online and classroom training.

For shop owners, the program offers an alternative to waiting for experienced technicians to appear in an increasingly competitive labor market. A participating shop can identify someone with the right attitude and work ethic, then help that person build technical skills through a defined training path.

“NAPA is committed to finding solutions that address the national shortage of skilled automotive technicians,” said Jason Rainey, vice president of Auto Care. “Our apprenticeship program is one of several key NAPA initiatives that help pave the way for young people to launch long and fruitful careers in our industry.”

The NAPA Apprentice Program uses a nine-stage curriculum designed to give participants a broad understanding of the systems and components found on modern vehicles. Most apprentices can complete the program in two years or less.

However, the curriculum is competency-based rather than tied strictly to a calendar. Apprentices can progress through each stage at a pace that matches their learning style and demonstrated abilities. A participant who quickly masters a subject can move forward, while someone who needs additional practice can spend more time developing that competency.
Training is 100% technical and is delivered through several formats:
- Classroom training videos exclusive to the Apprentice Program provide in-depth instruction from experienced master technicians.
- NAPA Autotech classes offer instructor-led training taught by experienced ASE Master Certified instructors.
- Autotech eLearning provides web-based instruction targeting specific systems, procedures and diagnostic topics.
- Hands-on training allows apprentices to apply what they have learned while working in the shop under the guidance of a mentor.

This combination helps connect classroom theory with real repairs. Apprentices do not just learn how a component operates; they also gain experience inspecting, testing and servicing that component on vehicles.

The curriculum will continue to evolve as vehicle technology and industry standards change. Planned enhancements include updated training modules and specialized certification options covering emerging service areas, giving apprentices additional opportunities for career advancement.

Apprentices earn the work experience requirement for three Automotive Service Excellence certifications as they advance through the program: Maintenance and Light Repair (G1), Suspension and Steering (A4), and Brakes (A5). They also gain the practical know-how to pass the EPA Section 609 refrigerant recovery and recycling credential test administered through ASE.

That distinction is important: G1, A4 and A5 are ASE professional certifications, while Section 609 is an EPA-required credential for technicians who service motor-vehicle air-conditioning systems. Together, these credentials provide outside validation of the knowledge and skills developed during the apprenticeship.

Because the program is registered with the U.S. Department of Labor, graduates also finish with a nationally recognized journey-level credential in automotive repair. This gives apprentices evidence of completing a structured combination of education and supervised on-the-job training.

The program provides the curriculum and training materials, but its success inside a repair facility depends heavily on the shop’s involvement. An apprentice needs an experienced technician who can explain procedures, demonstrate good work habits, supervise repairs and provide constructive feedback.

“We need their mentorship, their participation,” said Hannah Klausman, account marketing manager for Auto Care. “We want to support them by providing the materials for their technicians to go through this program, but we need their buy-in by having them provide a mentor and really put their time into taking a chance on these new technicians.”

For a shop owner, that requires a real commitment. Mentoring can temporarily affect the productivity of an experienced technician, especially during an apprentice’s first months. The potential return is a technician trained around the shop’s procedures, quality standards and culture.

The program can also create a clearer career ladder. Instead of hiring someone as an entry-level employee with no defined next step, a shop can show the apprentice how training, demonstrated competencies and certifications lead to greater responsibilities.

“The success of the apprentice program is a reflection not only of the investment NAPA has made but also of its collaboration with Auto Care centers across the country,” said Ryan Ouellette, director of strategic accounts at NAPA. “We are committed to developing future professionals at NAPA, and we look forward to continuing to educate and support the talent in the industry.”
Applicants must be at least 17 years old. Applicants who are 17 require written parental consent, and there is no maximum age.

Previous professional repair experience is not the program’s defining qualification. Shops should look for candidates who have a positive attitude, arrive ready to work and take initiative beyond their assigned tasks.

Successful apprentices must also be able to build relationships. Automotive repair is increasingly collaborative, particularly when diagnostic information, specialized equipment and technical knowledge must be shared among technicians. An apprentice must be willing to ask questions, accept coaching and learn from the people around them.
Most importantly, candidates need to embrace continuous learning. Vehicle technology does not stand still, and neither can a technician’s education.

For aspiring technicians, the program provides an opportunity to learn the trade without taking on the expense of a traditional trade-school program. Apprentices receive a paycheck while learning in an operating repair facility, and the training itself is provided at no cost to the participant.
Additional information about the program is available at NAPA Auto Care Training.
Sidebar: Addressing the Cost of a Technician’s First Tools

Tools represent one of the largest entry barriers for a new automotive technician. Even a basic professional set can require a substantial investment before the technician earns a full professional wage.

To help address that barrier, Carlyle Tools developed an Apprentice Set containing professional-quality tools considered essential for a new technician’s career. NAPA Auto Care makes the exclusive set, which has a stated retail value of $6,566, available for participating Auto Care centers to purchase for their apprentices.

Providing or helping finance an appropriate starter set can make a shop’s apprenticeship opportunity more attractive. It also helps ensure that the apprentice begins with tools capable of withstanding daily professional use.

articles.title: Servicing Volkswagen Electronic Parking Brakes
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The majority of Volkswagen vehicles sold in the past decade have electronic parking brakes. However, most customers don’t even realize that the vehicle has an electronic parking brake, because the system engages and disengages the parking brake automatically on most vehicles. But, when the system fails and turns on the light or has a warning in the driver information center, then the customer will notice.

If you are doing a brake job on a vehicle with an electronic parking brake, you will need a scan tool with the proper software for the parking brake system to retract the calipers, adjust and perform diagnostics. There are no shortcuts on YouTube. You can find videos that involve removing the electric motor, jumping connectors and disassembling the parking brake mechanism. But, these methods are very risky and can damage the vehicle and kill productivity. Unapproved methods will set malfunction codes, and the worst-case scenario is that you could damage the unit.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The VW system that was installed on many of its platforms starting in 2004 is an example of a system that requires a scan tool to replace the rear brake pads.

The system has stepper motors on the back of the caliper that actuate the piston. The motor can be removed from the caliper, though the ignition should be switched off for at least 30 seconds before removing the connector.

The motor is sealed to the caliper with an o-ring around the spindle. The condition of this o-ring is critical for the life of the motor and should be lightly lubricated with brake fluid. If the o-ring fails, water and debris will be one step closer to the motor gears.
The spindle on the caliper can be rocked slightly with a torx bit so the motor seats in the spindle. Don’t force the motor assembly onto the caliper, because damage to the housing can occur.

On recent platforms, VW have outfitted the motors with a sensor that can measure brake pad wear and adjust the pads for the least amount of drag. During this adjustment on some vehicles, the pad thickness is calculated. The system counts the number of rotations of the motor with a hall effect sensor inside the unit.
Inspecting the caliper, hardware and motors may not give you a complete picture of what is happening with these systems. Having access to a scan tool can reduce diagnostic time.

The OEMs have built-in bi-directional protocols to retract the parking brake so the pads can be replaced. A dedicated brake tool or enhanced scan tool is able to command these protocols and interrogate the module for codes and faults.

The Electronic Parking Brake Module (EPBM) is the module on the CAN bus of most vehicles equipped with this system. Any missing data for vehicle speed, gear position or brake pedal input will cause a problem with the system.

Some systems use information from the electric parking brake to track shoe and pad wear. The system will count the number of turns the actuator makes or the position of the stepper motor to determine the thickness of the friction material.

If you do find yourself working on a vehicle whose electronic parking brake will not disengage, the first thing to do is look at the basics. Some systems require that the doors be shut and the brake pedal depressed. Some models may even require the seat belt to be buckled. Simple items like a defective brake pedal or door switch may hinder operation. Also, in some cases, the button may be defective. On some vehicles, the operation of the switch can be verified with a scan tool.

articles.title: How Brake-Based Traction Control Helps AWD
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Many all-wheel-drive (AWD) systems reached the market during the 1990s, as the SUV boom gave automakers an opportunity to sell profitable light trucks. Many early SUVs used transfer cases, limited-slip or locking differentials, and locking hubs adapted from the automakers’ truck platforms. As buyers began asking for four-wheel-drive capability in smaller, more fuel-efficient vehicles, automakers developed lighter AWD systems for passenger cars and crossovers.

Sending power to all four wheels is possible with either a longitudinal or transverse engine. A transverse layout can send power from the transaxle through a power takeoff unit and driveshaft to the rear axle. Depending on the design, the system may use a center differential, a coupling, or another device to manage the front-to-rear torque distribution. One feature these systems may lack, compared with traditional four-wheel-drive hardware, is a mechanical differential lock or limited-slip differential.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Engineers found another way to improve traction: use the ABS hardware to apply a brake at a slipping wheel. This brake-based traction control can make an open differential behave somewhat like a limited-slip differential in low-traction conditions.

An open differential allows the drive wheels to turn at different speeds while cornering. The ring gear turns the differential case, which carries small spider gears. Those gears mesh with side gears connected to the axle shafts. An open differential delivers similar torque to both axle shafts, but the torque available is limited by the wheel with less grip. If one tire is on a slippery surface, it can spin while the other tire receives too little torque to move the vehicle effectively.

Brake-based traction control addresses this by applying the brake at the spinning wheel. The added resistance creates a reaction torque through the differential, allowing more usable torque to reach the wheel with better grip. The system does not lock the differential mechanically, but it can produce a limited-slip effect. Some AWD systems also use brake control to manage wheelspin across the front and rear axles; the exact strategy depends on the vehicle’s driveline and control system.

The system makes quick adjustments based on wheel-speed signals. Depending on the vehicle, it may apply the brakes, reduce engine torque, or use both strategies to control wheelspin. Some drivers may feel or hear the brakes operating during a traction event. On some vehicles, limited brake-based traction functions remain active even when the driver switches off part of the stability-control system.

Brake-based traction control has limits compared with a four-wheel-drive system equipped with mechanically locking differentials. Brake application creates heat, and traction may be reduced if the system reaches its operating limits. Still, for drivers who encounter snow, mud, or other slippery conditions occasionally, the system can make a substantial difference.

These systems do not have differential clutches that require service, but brake-based traction control adds activity to the brakes and ABS hydraulic control unit. Follow the manufacturer’s brake-fluid specification and service interval. Some vehicles require a low-viscosity DOT 4 fluid so the hydraulic system can respond as designed; use it only when specified for that application.

Replacement brake pads should perform similarly to the original pads across the operating temperature range. A pad with different friction behavior may affect braking response and the system’s ability to control wheelspin.

Wheel-speed sensors are another service consideration. If a sensor or its circuit provides an inaccurate signal, the system may limit its operation or disable traction-control functions. That can reduce the vehicle’s ability to manage wheelspin in snow, mud or ice. Check for ABS and traction-control codes, inspect the sensor wiring and tone or encoder rings, and verify wheel-speed data before condemning a sensor.

articles.title: MEMA Announces Top Supplier Recognition Winners
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers and AftermarketNews announced the winners of the 2027 Top Suppliers Recognition Program. The program recognizes companies contributing to the growth and advancement of the automotive aftermarket.

Part of the 2027 Top Suppliers Directory initiative, the program recognizes suppliers in four categories: Customer & Market Impact, Emerging Supplier, Industry Engagement and Sustainability. The categories highlight how suppliers deliver value to customers, support the industry and help shape its future.
2027 Top Suppliers Recognition Program Winners
This category recognizes suppliers delivering value to customers through innovative products, solutions and contributions to aftermarket growth.
This category recognizes suppliers bringing new ideas, innovative solutions and fresh perspectives to the aftermarket.
- Advanced Innovative Technology/TrakMotive
This category recognizes suppliers that support the broader aftermarket through collaboration, industry involvement and leadership.
- M&D (Magneto & Diesel Injector Service)
This category recognizes suppliers advancing environmental responsibility, resource efficiency and sustainable business practices.

“Our industry is stronger because of suppliers that continue to innovate, invest in their customers, and contribute to the aftermarket community,” said Ben Brucato, vice president of membership and engagement at MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers. “These companies demonstrate the leadership and commitment that move our industry forward. We’re proud to recognize their achievements and the impact they’re making.”
Top Suppliers Directory Connects the Aftermarket

MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers and AftermarketNews present the Top Suppliers Directory, along with a searchable industry database. It connects aftermarket professionals with companies providing parts, equipment, tools, technologies and solutions.

The directory showcases supplier capabilities and helps industry professionals identify companies and innovations supporting the aftermarket. The MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers Top Suppliers Recognition Program builds on that effort by recognizing suppliers for their contributions to customers and the industry.

articles.title: Valvoline Global Expands Mechanics Training Program in Mexico
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Valvoline Global Operations announced the expansion of its flagship social responsibility program, “Mecánicos del Mañana” (Aspiring Mechanics), across Mexico. The announcement coincides with Mexico City’s Formula One race weekend.

Valvoline Global launched the program with a five-year, $1 million global investment announced in 2025. The initiative addresses the automotive industry’s skilled labor shortage, which could reach a global deficit of 4.3 million mechanics by 2030.
The program aims to benefit more than 10,000 aspiring technicians worldwide through academic scholarships, tool donations and direct community engagement.
Valvoline Global Supports Mexican Students
Valvoline Global is marking the program’s first anniversary and highlighting its continued partnership with Escuela Mexicana de Electricidad (EME).

Through this collaboration, eight EME students have received academic scholarships and opportunities to participate in hands-on training sessions. These sessions take place alongside the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team.
The program provides students with firsthand experience in Formula One garage operations and technical workflows.

Students also receive mentorship from industry figures, including Miguel Faísca, head of esports at the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team. Another mentor is Ivanna Richards, a Mexican motorsport driver recognized as a TIME Young Talent.
Additionally, the initiative provides specialized equipment and a competition-grade go-kart to support practical learning throughout the academic year.
The shortage of technical personnel presents a global challenge, particularly in Mexico, where the automotive industry plays a major economic role.

The “Mecánicos del Mañana” program connects traditional technical education with Formula One motorsport practices. The initiative aims to strengthen students’ technical skills and improve their employment opportunities across Mexico.
Throughout the weekend, Valvoline Global plans to share highlights from the students’ experiences across its social media and digital channels.
The content will feature interactions between industry experts and students, firsthand accounts from EME participants and program success stories.

articles.title: PRT to Showcase Expanded Product Lines at AAPEX
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: PRT, a brand of ADD USA Group, will showcase its product lines and latest applications at AAPEX 2026. The company will exhibit at the Venetian Expo in booth F14600. PRT manufactures shocks, struts and complete strut assemblies. A key highlight will be its new light commercial vehicle (LCV) line, which expands coverage in the segment.
PRT Expands Light Commercial Vehicle Coverage

The company also will present its air shocks, top mounts and motor mounts product lines. Its heavy-duty portfolio includes applications for trucks, trailers, buses, commercial vehicles, cement mixers and motorhomes. Attendees can visit the booth to learn about promotional offers available to eligible customers during the show.

“We’re more than happy to introduce our new LCV line and showcase our multiple product lines at AAPEX 2026,” said Bruno Bello of PRT. “Our ongoing investments in manufacturing technology and OE-quality engineering support the continued development of solutions for the North American Aftermarket.”

Customers can obtain additional product information by calling PRT at 770-238-1611 or visiting www.prtautoparts.com. The company also provides updates through its social media channels at @prtautoparts.

articles.title: What About the Scratch?
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Vehicle scratch repairs depend on the depth of the damage. Counter professionals can recommend polishing compounds and buffing pads for minor clear-coat scratches. Deeper scratches that penetrate the base coat require touch-up paint and clear coat.
For more extensive repairs, customers may need 2,000-grit sandpaper and progressively finer polishing pads. Caution customers against machine polishing near edges.
This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.

articles.title: Dayco Expands Radiator Hose Line With 283 New Parts
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Dayco is expanding its radiator hose line in response to key market indicators and growing demand. The company supplies engine products and drive systems to the automotive, industrial and aftermarket industries. The expansion will introduce 283 new hoses for complex vehicle applications.
Dayco Targets 90% Radiator Hose Coverage

The expansion will increase Dayco’s radiator hose coverage to 90% of vehicles in operation (VIO) by March 2027. That represents a 20% increase since 2025. Dayco will make 66 applications available in November and another 40 by year-end. The company will launch the remaining applications by the end of the first quarter of 2027.
The new part numbers include simple and branched hoses that meet stringent original equipment specifications for fit, form and function.

Industry trends helped drive Dayco’s hose line expansion. These include more vehicles approaching cooling system maintenance intervals. Today’s downsized turbocharged and high-performance engines also place greater demands on cooling systems and surrounding components.

“Between strong market drivers related to maintenance as well as an increase in demand, we prioritized an aggressive go-to-market strategy so we could introduce a significant number of new hose applications over the next several months,” said Jerry Reeves, head of product management for Dayco N.A. “This enables us to help our customers capture immediate market share while also enhancing our core value proposition.”
Dayco’s automotive hose line includes simple and branched designs for radiators, heaters, exhaust vents, fuel systems and other applications.

The company uses EPDM compounds and other materials to manufacture hoses for transferring fluids or gases. These hoses serve applications involving corrosive substances and high-pressure environments.
For more information on Dayco’s complete hose line, visit the company’s website.

articles.title: Bronze Age sword discovered in an Italian lake is still sharp after 3,300 years
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have recovered a well-preserved bronze sword from a volcanic lake in Italy. The 3,300-year-old weapon may have been deposited in the lake as an offering to a deity or for a high-status warrior who lived long before the rise of the Etruscans or the Romans.

The sword was found in Lake Mezzano, which is located in the crater of an ancient volcano roughly 60 miles (100 kilometers) northwest of Rome, according to a translated statement from the Superintendence of Archaeology, Fine Arts and Landscape for the Province of Viterbo and Southern Etruria. Dating to the Late Bronze Age (14th to 13th centuries B.C.), the sword has maintained its sharp edge. It is the third such sword found in Lake Mezzano in the past 50 years.

Bronze Age people erected pile dwellings or stilt houses in what is now Lake Mezzano, and archaeologists recovered parts of the submerged settlement during their recent investigations. According to the statement, researchers also found numerous intact vases, axes, arrowheads, daggers, spearheads, pins and a bronze razor.

The sword and the razor were found near each other, suggesting the two artifacts may have been linked to a person of high social status, such as an elite warrior. But the placement of the metal weapons in a lake may also be related to a wider Bronze Age ritual practice where hoards of jewelry and bent or ritually "killed" artifacts were tossed into bodies of water. This practice continued through the centuries into Etruscan times, when wells were ritually "closed" with artifacts and human sacrifices.

paras.en: During the 13th century B.C., people in central Italy engaged in trade networks that spanned the Mediterranean. "In this context, bronze weapons were not only instruments of combat, but also symbols of prestige, identity, and power," according to the statement.

The sword and other artifacts discovered in Lake Mezzano are giving archaeologists new information about the people who flourished in prehistoric Italy long before the Romans and Etruscans. Additional research is planned in the coming years, according to the statement.

Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. articles.title: Could AI ever build itself? Scientists map the road to the 'last AI built by humans.'
articles.author: Owen Hughes

paras.en: Scientists in China are exploring what it would take to develop "the last AI built by humans" — a powerful, self-improving artificial intelligence (AI) system capable of creating its own successors.
In a new paper, researchers examine how approaches to recursive self-improvement (RSI) could help tackle the rising financial and computational costs of developing ever-more advanced AI models.
RSI refers to the idea that future AI models could direct their own training and development, using what they learn from each round of improvements to guide subsequent rounds of development.
This recursive feedback loop could eventually enable AI systems to develop newer, more powerful generations of models with minimal human input.

The study, which was uploaded to the preprint database arXiv Sept. 10 but has not been peer-reviewed, proposes a framework for classifying AI systems based on their self-improvement capabilities, from Level 1 (lowest) to Level 5 (highest).

At the lower levels, development remains largely human-led. As AI systems move up the scale, they become increasingly capable of identifying their weaknesses and deciding how to address them, eventually gaining the ability to make their own “meta-improvements” — improving how they improve themselves.
Whether AI could ever achieve this level of sustained self-improvement remains an open question. Previous experiments have, however, demonstrated more limited forms of RSI.
In one study earlier this year, an AI system called A-Evolve-Training was tasked with improving the performance of a 30 billion-parameter large language model (LLM).

Over four rounds, A-Evolve-Training modestly improved the LLM's benchmark performance by testing different training techniques and using the results to change how it approached subsequent experiments.
Peter Bentley, a professor of digital biology at University College London, questioned whether such experiments offer a credible route to RSI.
"This idea that some AI is magically going to start generating better and better AIs by themselves [is] nonsense," Bentley told Live Science in an email.

Bentley pointed out that self-improving computer systems have been around for decades. Evolutionary computation and reinforcement learning, for instance, are both based on the principle of systems refining their performance over time in response to feedback.

The much greater challenge, he said, is developing AI systems capable of autonomously conducting the research needed to create more powerful successors — not to mention overcoming their dependence on human expertise and physical computing infrastructure.
"You can't 'recursively self-improve' unless you can also enhance your own training, enhance your hardware, and test it exhaustively in real world settings," Bentley added.

The study's authors acknowledged some of these challenges. Developing RSI-capable systems could require enormous investments in computing power, as well as human supervision to ensure successive improvements delivered meaningful gains. All of this becomes effectively redundant if the resources needed to develop and test subsequent AI models outweigh any benefits they offer, the authors noted.
- We're not about to awaken an evil digital god — AI is far more likely to end in a great disappointment
- Google DeepMind's latest AI tool promises a new era for genetics research, but experts warn to take its predictions with caution
- OpenAI claims we've entered the AGI era — has GPT-6 Astra really demonstrated general intelligence?

Scientists would also need a reliable way to determine whether an AI system was genuinely becoming more capable over iterations, rather than exploiting weaknesses in tests used to measure its capabilities. This is a known problem in AI development, where models can achieve higher benchmark scores by exploiting testing methods or cherry-picking results.

Kayla Blomquist, an AI researcher at the University of Oxford and co-founder of the Oxford China Policy Lab, said that, while the paper doesn't provide a practical road map to RSI, it could help developers and policymakers understand the technical challenges and safety risks associated with increasingly autonomous AI systems.

She also questioned whether there would ever be a clear point at which AI became completely independent of human development. "The paper describes a gradual handover of responsibility rather than a single moment, so there may never be an obvious 'last' model built by humans," Blomquist added.

Previously a senior editor at ZDNET, Owen has been writing about tech for more than a decade, during which time he has covered everything from AI, cybersecurity and supercomputers to programming languages and public sector IT. Owen is particularly interested in the intersection of technology, life and work – in his previous roles at ZDNET and TechRepublic, he wrote extensively about business leadership, digital transformation and the evolving dynamics of remote work.

articles.title: Nearly 30% of US adults admit to lying about or exaggerating their symptoms to get antibiotics from doctors, survey finds
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: Nearly 30% of U.S. adults have lied to doctors in an effort to obtain antibiotics, either by exaggerating their actual symptoms or by fabricating symptoms, the results of a new national survey suggest. Additionally, in a second survey, about one-quarter of children's caregivers reported lying about their kids' symptoms to get antibiotics on their behalf.

"As clinicians, we know that patients lie to us sometimes," Dr. Jeffrey Linder, a general internist and primary care clinician-investigator at Northwestern Medicine, wrote in a commentary about the survey findings.

However, the results are still important because the inappropriate use of antibiotics can contribute to the mounting problem of antibiotic resistance, in which bacteria build up a tolerance to the drugs designed to kill them. Recent data released by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) highlight the extent of the problem: In 2023, drug-resistant bacteria and fungi caused about 9.7 million infections in the U.S., up from 2.8 million in 2017. In turn, the estimated number of deaths caused by drug-resistant germs rose from 35,000 to 50,800 between the two years.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: A major factor driving resistance among bacteria is the misuse of antibiotics — in other words, using antibiotics for ailments like viral infections, which the drugs do not treat. For individual patients, such prescriptions don't cure their illness and can result in an upset stomach or issues with the gut microbiome, the community of microbes in the intestines. Simultaneously, they place extra pressure on bacteria to evolve resistance, granting the germs opportunities to pick up new strategies for thwarting antibiotics.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Doctors play a big role in ensuring that the antibiotic prescriptions they write are necessary. Part of their decision-making process comes down to what patients say about their symptoms, some of which may be fabricated, the two new surveys suggest.
The new surveys were published Friday (Oct. 30) in the journal JAMA Network Open.

The first survey was completed by nearly 960 adults from across the U.S. in January and February 2026. It asked whether the respondents had ever told a healthcare provider that their symptoms were worse or more long-lasting than they were in order to get antibiotics, as well as whether they'd ever made up symptoms for the same reason. It then inquired about what motivated a given patient to lie — or avoid lying, if they were truthful — as well as posed contextual questions about their demographics, health behaviors and beliefs.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

Overall, about 28% of the respondents reported misrepresenting their symptoms, including 26% who exaggerated their existing symptoms and 17% who fabricated symptoms. They most frequently lied about cold-like symptoms, such as fever, cough and sore throat. About two-thirds of these patients were at least moderately confident that their lie would motivate a clinician to prescribe them antibiotics, and 77% said the strategy worked for them at least once.

Often, patients' motivations for lying centered around feeling very sick, holding strong beliefs that antibiotics would help them recover quickly and get back to their responsibilities, and wanting control over the treatments prescribed to them. Compared with people who didn't lie, those who lied were also more likely to feel that clinicians didn't take them seriously or more likely to endorse statements suggesting that antibiotic resistance is a hoax.
"Greater antibiotic knowledge and aversion to taking antibiotics were associated with lower odds of misrepresentation," meaning lying about symptoms, the study authors noted.

Less than 30% of these patients regretted their lies or taking the antibiotics prescribed to them. Those that did express regret noted experiencing side effects, noticing that the treatment didn't help or feeling that the lying itself was morally wrong.

The second survey was much smaller; it included 236 parents and other guardians of children and teens under 18 years old. It posed similar questions but asked whether the caregivers had lied about their children's symptoms and, if so, what motivated them to lie.

About 27% reported lying about a child's symptoms to get antibiotics, with 87% of these caregivers believing that their lying worked at least once. Their reasons for lying were very similar to those expressed by the respondents in the first survey.
"These findings suggest that symptom misrepresentation may contribute to antibiotic overuse in pediatric care," the study authors concluded.

The surveys reached a diverse group of people, including a range of ages, demographics and locations within the United States; however, the respondents were not necessarily representative of the whole U.S. population, the authors noted. The prevalence of lying should therefore be seen as a tentative measure to be checked in future studies, rather than an unbiased, population-level metric, they wrote. It's also possible that not all the respondents who lied disclosed that they did so or remembered that they had done so.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Especially in outpatient settings, which account for most antibiotic use among U.S. patients, it can be difficult for doctors to quickly determine whether a patient needs an antibiotic.

One factor is that there's a lack of fast, surefire diagnostic tests for many bacterial infections. Outpatient appointments are also extremely short, so doctors sometimes worry about overlooking an infection that could then get worse, Julia Szymczak, a medical sociologist at the University of Utah School of Medicine, previously told Live Science. Another major factor is that clinicians can face pressure to prescribe antibiotics from their adult patients or from children's caregivers, as the new surveys reflect.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: But in the face of these pressures and patients' occasional lies, Linder argues that it's still up to the clinicians to do the right thing. "While clinicians might interpret patients' symptom maximization and questions as demands for antibiotics, symptoms do not determine the indication, a diagnosis does," he wrote in the commentary.

"It does not track that approximately 80% of respondents who reported misrepresenting their symptoms obtained a prescription," he added, "unless prescribers were being willfully deceived or, more likely, just getting worn down with what they perceive as patient demand, regardless of actual clinical appropriateness."

When it comes to making decisions about individual patients, Linder argued that doctors don't necessarily need to think about the big picture of antibiotic resistance and how their patient's case fits into that global trend. Rather, providers should simply ask whether a given prescription is more likely to help or hurt that patient, he said.

"Clinicians' obligation is to act in patients' best interest," he said, "even if patients are hoping we do something different, even if patients do not like it, or even if patients lie about their symptoms."

Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
