articles.title: Tame Impala Take On Seal’s ‘Kiss From a Rose’ for Like A Version
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Tame Impala got into the Halloween spirit a day early, covering Seal’s “Kiss From a Rose” for Australian radio station triple j’s Like A Version series on Friday (Oct. 30).
paras.zh: Tame Impala 提前一天融入了万圣节气氛，于周五（10 月 30 日）为澳大利亚电台 Triple j 的 Like A Version 系列节目翻唱了 Seal 的《Kiss From a Rose》。

paras.en: At triple j’s Sydney studios, the band reworked the 1994 ballad into a stripped-back, synth-driven take, then followed it with a pared-down version of their own hit “Dracula.”
paras.zh: 在 Triple j 的悉尼工作室，乐队将 1994 年的民谣重新改编成由合成器驱动的精简版本，然后推出了他们自己的热门歌曲“Dracula”的精简版本。

paras.en: For Kevin Parker, the cover was a trip back to the start. He explained that “Kiss From a Rose” was on the first CD he ever bought, the Batman Forever soundtrack, which also introduced him to acts including U2, the Flaming Lips and Nick Cave.
paras.zh: 对于凯文·帕克来说，封面是一次回到起点的旅程。他解释说，《玫瑰之吻》收录在他购买的第一张 CD《永远的蝙蝠侠》原声带中，这张 CD 也让他认识了 U2、Flaming Lips 和 Nick Cave 等乐队。

paras.en: It’s Tame Impala’s fourth Like A Version cover, following OutKast’s “Prototype” in 2013, Kylie Minogue’s “Confide in Me” in 2015 and Edwyn Collins’ “A Girl Like You” in 2021.
paras.zh: 这是 Tame Impala 的第四张 Like A 版本封面，之前是 2013 年 OutKast 的《Prototype》、2015 年凯莉·米洛 (Kylie Minogue) 的《Confide in Me》和 2021 年埃德温·柯林斯 (Edwyn Collins) 的《A Girl Like You》。

paras.en: The session caps the biggest year of the project’s career. “Dracula,” first released as a solo single in October 2025, took off after a February remix featuring Jennie, giving Tame Impala their first top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 with a No. 5 peak. The song also reached No. 1 on Pop Airplay and Hot Rock & Alternative Songs, and spent more than six months atop Hot Dance/Electronic Songs. Tame Impala have just come off their biggest Australian tour to date, and their album Deadbeat leads next month’s ARIA Awards with eight nominations, tied with Genesis Owusu.
paras.zh: 这次会议为该项目职业生涯中最重要的一年画上了句号。 《Dracula》于 2025 年 10 月首次作为个人单曲发行，在 2 月份与 Jennie 合作进行混音后，Tame Impala 首次跻身 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜前 10 名，最高排名为第 5 名。这首歌还在 Pop Airplay 和 Hot Rock & Alternative Songs 上排名第一，并在 Hot Dance/Electronic Songs 上停留了六个多月的时间。 Tame Impala 刚刚结束了迄今为止规模最大的澳大利亚巡演，他们的专辑《Deadbeat》在下个月的 ARIA 颁奖典礼上获得八项提名，与 Genesis Owusu 并列领先。

paras.en: Tame Impala recently wrapped the Australian leg of their Deadbeat Tour, which featured multiple arena shows in Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney before finishing with two hometown performances in Perth on Oct. 24 and 25. Parker and his band are set to return to the road in May 2027 for a string of UK and European arena dates, followed by several summer festival appearances.
paras.zh: Tame Impala 最近结束了他们的 Deadbeat 巡回演唱会的澳大利亚站，该巡演在布里斯班、墨尔本和悉尼举行了多场演出，最后于 10 月 24 日和 25 日在珀斯举行了两场家乡演出。帕克和他的乐队将于 2​​027 年 5 月重返巡回演出，进行一系列英国和欧洲的舞台演出，随后还会进行几次夏季音乐节演出。

paras.en: Seal’s original topped the Billboard Hot 100 for a week in August 1995 after its Batman Forever placement and won three Grammys the following year, including record and song of the year.
paras.zh: 1995 年 8 月，《Seal》的原创歌曲在《永远的蝙蝠侠》中登上公告牌百强单曲榜榜首，并连续一周位居榜首，并于次年赢得了三项格莱美奖，包括年度唱片奖和年度歌曲奖。

paras.en: Watch Tame Impala cover “Kiss from a Rose” below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面 Tame Impala 翻唱的“Kiss from a Rose”。

articles.title: Harry Styles Revives His ‘X Factor’ Audition Look for ‘Isn’t She Lovely’ at Harryween
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Harry Styles went back to where it all started for Harryween.
paras.zh: 哈利·斯泰尔斯 (Harry Styles) 回到了哈利温 (Harryween) 的起点。

paras.en: At Madison Square Garden on Friday (Oct. 30), the 29th night of his 30-show Together, Together residency, Styles changed into the outfit he wore for his 2010 X Factor audition and performed Stevie Wonder’s “Isn’t She Lovely,” the song that got him through to the next round at 16. He even repeated a line from that day, telling the crowd, “I work in a bakery,” a nod to the part-time job he held in his Cheshire hometown of Holmes Chapel.
paras.zh: 周五（10 月 30 日），在麦迪逊广场花园，也就是他 30 场演出 Together, Together 驻场演出的第 29 晚，斯泰尔斯换上了他在 2010 年 X Factor 试镜时穿的服装，并演唱了 Stevie Wonder 的《Isn’t She Lovely》，这首歌让他在 16 岁时进入了下一轮。他甚至重复了那天的台词，告诉观众“我在一家面包店工作”，这是对兼职工作的认可。他在柴郡的家乡福尔摩斯教堂举行了这次活动。

paras.en: The audition outfit was a mid-show swap. Styles opened the night dressed as Elvis Presley, while his band and dancers came as different versions of Styles from across his career. The Elvis nod tracks: the first song Styles ever recorded was a cover of Presley’s “The Girl of My Best Friend.”
paras.zh: 试镜服装是演出中途更换的。斯泰尔斯以猫王的身份拉开了当晚的序幕，而他的乐队和舞者则扮演了他职业生涯中不同版本的斯泰尔斯。猫王点头曲目：Styles 录制的第一首歌曲是翻唱普雷斯利的《我最好朋友的女孩》。

paras.en: On the audition itself, “Isn’t She Lovely” wasn’t Styles’ first pick. Footage released by the show in 2022 revealed he opened with Train’s “Hey, Soul Sister,” and only sang the Wonder song a cappella after Simon Cowell asked to hear him without a backing track. He was later placed in One Direction alongside Niall Horan, Louis Tomlinson, Zayn Malik and the late Liam Payne. Earlier this month, Styles debuted “What Is Enough,” a song written for Payne, at the same venue on the second anniversary of Payne’s death.
paras.zh: 在试镜过程中，《Isn’t She Lovely》并不是斯泰尔斯的第一选择。该剧在 2022 年发布的视频显示，他以《Train》的《Hey, Soul Sister》开场，在西蒙·考威尔 (S​​imon Cowell) 要求在没有背景音乐的情况下听他表演后，他才清唱了《Wonder》这首歌。后来他与尼尔·霍兰、路易斯·汤姆林森、扎恩·马利克和已故的利亚姆·佩恩一起被安排在 One Direction 中。本月早些时候，斯泰尔斯在佩恩去世两周年之际在同一地点首次推出了为佩恩创作的歌曲“What Is Enough”。

paras.en: Costumed covers have become a Harryween tradition. At the first edition, at MSG in 2021, Styles dressed as Dorothy to sing “Over the Rainbow,” then came out as a clown the next night to cover Britney Spears’ “Toxic.” In 2022, at Los Angeles’ Kia Forum, he dressed as Grease’s Danny Zuko for “Hopelessly Devoted to You.”
paras.zh: 盛装封面已成为哈利温的传统。在 2021 年 MSG 的第一届演出中，斯泰尔斯打扮成多萝西演唱《Over the Rainbow》，然后在第二天晚上以小丑的身份翻唱布兰妮·斯皮尔斯的《Toxic》。 2022 年，在洛杉矶的起亚论坛上，他装扮成《油脂》的丹尼·祖科 (Danny Zuko) 表演“Hopeously Devoted to You”。

paras.en: The residency wraps Saturday (Oct. 31) with a final Harryween show. The MSG run drew a record 11.5 million presale registrations on Ticketmaster. Styles has sent all four of his solo albums to No. 1 on the Billboard 200, most recently Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally. in March, and has topped the Hot 100 three times: “Watermelon Sugar” in 2020, “As It Was” in 2022 (15 weeks at No. 1, the longest run atop the chart by a U.K. act) and “Aperture” this year.
paras.zh: 驻场演出将于周六（10 月 31 日）以最后一场 Harryween 演出结束。 MSG 活动在 Ticketmaster 上吸引了创纪录的 1,150 万预售注册。 Styles 的所有四张个人专辑均在 Billboard 200 排行榜上名列第一，最近的一张是 Kiss All the Time。迪斯科，偶尔。 3 月份，他曾三次登上热门 100 强：2020 年的《西瓜糖》、2022 年的《As It Was》（连续 15 周排名第一，是英国艺人连续登顶排行榜最长的时间）和今年的《Aperture》。

articles.title: Margaret Qualley and Jack Antonoff File for Divorce After Three Years of Marriage
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Margaret Qualley and Jack Antonoff are divorcing after three years of marriage, with court records obtained by The Associated Press showing that a divorce filing was made Friday.
paras.zh: 玛格丽特·奎利和杰克·安东诺夫结婚三年后即将离婚，美联社获得的法庭记录显示，他们已于周五提出离婚申请。

paras.en: A source told People magazine that the split is “a mutual decision,” adding, “They share a deep affinity and love for one another, and though their romantic partnership is ending, they will absolutely be lifelong friends.”
paras.zh: 一位消息人士告诉《人物》杂志，分手是“共同的决定”，并补充道，“他们彼此有着深厚的亲和力和爱，尽管他们的浪漫关系即将结束，但他们绝对会成为终生的朋友。”

paras.en: Qualley’s reps did not immediately respond to The Hollywood Reporter’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 奎利的代表没有立即回应《好莱坞报道》的置评请求。

paras.en: Although the divorce filing is recent, the pair reportedly separated in July. At the time, a rep for Qualley confirmed the breakup to People and pushed back on speculation surrounding their split.
paras.zh: 尽管离婚申请是最近才提出的，但据报道两人于七月分居。当时，奎利的一名代表向《人物》杂志证实了两人的分手，并反驳了有关他们分手的猜测。

paras.en: “The narratives running in the press about Margaret and Jack are categorically untrue. There are no trust issues. There was no infidelity or anything outside of respect and partnership in this relationship,” the actress’ rep said in a statement.
paras.zh: “媒体上关于玛格丽特和杰克的叙述绝对不真实。不存在信任问题。在这段关系中不存在不忠或任何超出尊重和伙伴关系的事情，”这位女演员的代表在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: Earlier this week, the Bleachers frontman opened up about performing songs inspired by his former relationship with The Guardian. He said he was initially “worried” about performing the songs about but now views it differently.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，这位露天看台主唱公开表示要表演受他与《卫报》前任关系启发的歌曲。他说他最初对表演这些歌曲感到“担心”，但现在有了不同的看法。

paras.en: “It’s actually been really beautiful,” Antonoff said.
paras.zh: “它实际上非常美丽，”安东诺夫说。

paras.en: “Songs which I wrote recently, I obviously was really worried about this specific thing,” he added. “I sat long and hard with it and thought, ‘If I change the setlist …’ and in my gut there was a unanimous jury that said, ‘No, this is the deal. The deal I’ve made with my audience is that I’m going to tell you honestly how I feel and I’m going to risk at any moment having to stand behind it for fucking ever.’”
paras.zh: “我最近写的歌曲，显然我真的很担心这个具体的事情，”他补充道。 “我苦苦地坐了很长时间，想，‘如果我改变歌单……’，在我的内心深处，有一个一致的陪审团说，‘不，这就是协议。我和观众达成的协议是，我要诚实地告诉你们我的感受，我随时都会冒着永远支持它的风险。’”

paras.en: The Substance star and Antonoff began dating in 2021 and married in August 2023.
paras.zh: 这位《物质》明星和安东诺夫于 2021 年开始约会，并于 2023 年 8 月结婚。

articles.title: Bill Maher Responds to Trump’s 1,318-Word Social Rant: “He Went Off on Me Like Kelly Clarkson in a Toy Store”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Bill Maher has responded to President Donald Trump‘s lengthy social media post where he slammed him as a “complete and total loser,” and shared more details about their recent dinner at the White House.
paras.zh: 比尔·马赫回应了唐纳德·特朗普总统在社交媒体上发表的冗长帖子，猛烈抨击特朗普是“彻头彻尾的失败者”，并分享了他们最近在白宫共进晚餐的更多细节。

paras.en: During Friday’s episode of Real Time with Bill Maher, the comedian addressed a few of the statements made in Trump’s post. He began the monologue by discussing the upcoming midterms and how former President Barack Obama caused a “big scandal” for a comment he made at a campaign rally saying that Trump has “got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory.”
paras.zh: 在周五的《比尔·马赫实时》节目中，这位喜剧演员回应了特朗普帖子中的一些言论。他在独白中首先讨论了即将到来的中期选举，以及前总统巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)如何因在竞选集会上发表的言论而引发“大丑闻”，称特朗普“让白宫看起来像萨达姆·侯赛因(Saddam Hussein)开了一家芝士蛋糕工厂”。

paras.en: Maher said, “And the Republicans all said, ‘Leave the Cheesecake Factory out of this!’ Well, I mean, I should know. I just had dinner there. I hear it went well. What have you heard?”
paras.zh: 马赫说：“共和党人都说，‘不要再管芝士蛋糕工厂了！’好吧，我的意思是，我应该知道。我刚刚在那里吃过晚饭。我听说进展顺利。你听说了什么？”

paras.en: The host then asked, “Now, did you see the 1,300-word Tweet he sent out? Longest ever. Kind of a flex.” He joked that “dining at the White House is the opposite of the Cheesecake Factory. After you leave, they review you.”
paras.zh: 主持人接着问道：“现在，你看到他发出的那条 1300 字的推文了吗？有史以来最长的推文。有点灵活。”他开玩笑说，“在白宫用餐与芝士蛋糕工厂相反。你离开后，他们会对你进行评价。”

paras.en: “He went off on me like Kelly Clarkson in a toy store,” Maher added. “I mean, eating with Trump is like dating Taylor Swift. It’s a lot of laughs at the time, but later on, they’re tearing you a new asshole.”
paras.zh: “他对我发脾气，就像凯莉·克拉克森在玩具店里一样，”马赫补充道。 “我的意思是，和特朗普一起吃饭就像和泰勒·斯威夫特约会一样。当时有很多笑声，但后来，他们会为你撕下一个新的混蛋。”

paras.en: Maher was then handed a printed copy of Trump’s Truth Social post, and began to “address a few of the allegations.” Before that, he noted, “Look, I don’t want it to be this way. The whole point of having these dinners was talk, disagree, but listen, which he does in person, but don’t hate each other. And then I go back to my job here and then the heartaches begin.”
paras.zh: 随后，马赫收到了特朗普在《真相社会》帖子的印刷版，并开始“回应一些指控”。在此之前，他指出，“听着，我不希望事情是这样的。举办这些晚宴的全部目的就是交谈、表达不同意见，但要倾听，他亲自这样做，但不要互相仇恨。然后我回到这里的工作，然后心痛就开始了。”

paras.en: “It begins, ‘Let’s talk about the complete and total loser Bill Maher.’ You got me there. I’ll own that,” Maher joked, going on to explain “what pisses me off” is that “he doesn’t even notice what I say,” specifically citing a line in Trump’s post where he wrote, “[Maher] doesn’t think it was a good thing to take the Nuclear Weapon away from Iran, which shows you that he is not very smart.” Real Time then played a series of clips showcasing the opposite of Trump’s claim.
paras.zh: “它的开头是，‘让我们来谈谈彻底的失败者比尔·马赫。’你明白了。我会承认这一点，”马赫开玩笑说，接着解释说，“让我生气的是”，“他甚至没有注意到我说的话”，特别引用了特朗普帖子中的一句话，他写道，“[马赫]认为从伊朗夺走核武器不是一件好事，这表明他不是很聪明。”随后，《实时》播放了一系列片段，展示了与特朗普主张相反的内容。

paras.en: Maher then moved on to another section: “Page two, he talks about how I call him incessantly. I’ve never called you, you call me. I’d be afraid to call you. You’re the president. I think you’re too busy. Well, plainly not. He’s talking about me, ‘He invited himself to the White House.’ As if you could do that. ‘Sir, Bill Maher is here.’ ‘Well, he’s not invited, but the law.”
paras.zh: 马赫然后转到另一部分：“第二页，他谈到我如何不断地打电话给他。我从来没有给你打电话，你打电话给我。我害怕打电话给你。你是总统。我认为你太忙了。好吧，显然不是。他在谈论我，‘他邀请自己来到白宫。’好像你可以这样做。‘先生，比尔·马赫在这里。’‘好吧，他不是被邀请的，而是法律。”

paras.en: He also read aloud Trump writing that Maher is a “major POTHEAD.” Maher’s response: “Well, I guess the cat’s out of the bag now. Boy, that explains a lot. I thought I was just happy.” (Later in the Real Time episode, Kid Rock, who was at the dinner, told Maher he was “pretty high” at the White House.)
paras.zh: 他还大声朗读特朗普写道，马赫是一个“大笨蛋”。马赫的回答是：“嗯，我想现在已经秘密了。天哪，这解释了很多。我以为我只是很高兴。” （后来在《实时》节目中，参加晚宴的基德·洛克告诉马赫，他在白宫“非常嗨”。）

paras.en: He continued reading Trump’s post, “‘Bill had alcohol in his hand,’ that you gave me, ‘as he walked through the White House,’ and then — I love this — ‘Overall, I thought it was a good meeting.'”
paras.zh: 他继续阅读特朗普的帖子，“‘比尔手里拿着酒精’，这是你给我的，‘当他走过白宫时’，然后——我喜欢这个——‘总的来说，我认为这是一次很好的会面。’”

paras.en: “‘I understand he’s doing his thing. I never took it personally,'” Maher recited, dumbfounded. “‘He’s not a nice guy, and what he spouts isn’t what he believes. He has to cater to his base, which is mostly composed of losers,’ that would be you assholes,” the host said to his audience.
paras.zh: “‘我知道他在做他的事。我从来没有把这当成是针对我个人的，’”马赫目瞪口呆地回忆道。 “‘他不是一个好人，他所说的也不是他所相信的。他必须迎合他的基本盘，而这个基本盘主要由失败者组成，'那就是你们这些混蛋，"主持人对观众说。

paras.en: Trump penned a 1,318-word Truth Social post on Sunday, where he criticized Maher, Real Time and producer Chuck LaBella. He wrote, “Let’s talk about this COMPLETE AND TOTAL LOSER, Bill Maher. He’s got a Low Rated Show on equally Low Rated HBO, which was once, long ago, a Network of Quality and Excitement — But that’s all gone. It’s not ‘HOT’ anymore! Maher’s friend and business associate, Chuck LaBella, was also a friend of mine, worked on The Top Hit Show, The Apprentice, as a ‘gofer’ and, because of the success of that show, Number One and Top Rated on many weeks, with the Finale’ being among the Top Shows of the Year, he was automatically and quickly brought up through the Ranks of NBC, along with everyone else associated with that Historic ‘Happening.'”
paras.zh: 特朗普周日发表了一篇长达 1,318 字的《Truth Social》帖子，批评马赫、《Real Time》和制片人查克·拉贝拉 (Chuck LaBella)。他写道，“让我们来谈谈这个彻底的失败者，比尔·马赫。他在同样低收视率的 HBO 上播出了一部低收视率的节目，很久以前，HBO 曾经是一个高质量和令人兴奋的网络——但这一切都消失了。它不再‘热门’了！马赫的朋友和商业伙伴查克·拉贝拉 (Chuck LaBella) 也是我的朋友，在热门节目《学徒》中担任‘跑腿’而且，由于该节目的成功，连续数周排名第一和收视率最高，《大结局》跻身年度最佳节目之列，他和其他与这一历史性“事件”相关的人一起，自动迅速跻身 NBC 的行列。”

paras.en: Trump’s post seemingly was made in response to jokes Maher made during his monologue on the Oct. 23 episode. “It’s just a little odd that Trump keeps gushing about men’s bodies, and how handsome they are, and their jawlines, and their asses, their physiques,” said Maher. “I’m a little hurt. I was there for dinner for four hours last week, and not a peep. Nothing.”
paras.zh: 特朗普的帖子似乎是为了回应马赫在 10 月 23 日节目中的独白中开的玩笑。马赫说：“特朗普一直滔滔不绝地谈论男人的身体，他们有多英俊，他们的下巴轮廓，他们的屁股，他们的体格，这有点奇怪。” “我有点受伤。上周我在那里吃了四个小时的晚餐，没有任何反应。什么也没有。”

paras.en: Maher said, “Trump has the lowest approval rating of any midterm candidate ever. Only one percent of the Republicans are mentioning him in their ads.”
paras.zh: 马赫说：“特朗普的支持率是有史以来中期候选人中最低的。只有百分之一的共和党人在广告中提到他。”

paras.en: The president also wrote in his post that LaBella asked if he’d ever appear on Real Time, which he said led to their first meeting last year.
paras.zh: 总统还在帖子中写道，拉贝拉问他是否会出现在《实时》节目中，他说这促成了他们去年的第一次会面。

paras.en: “In any event, over the last few years, LaBella would call me nonstop to say, ‘Hello,’ be very nice, and tell me how much Bill Maher ‘loves’ and respects me, and would constantly ask of me, even before I was President, for any form of meeting with Maher and, would I do his show?” he wrote. “When I became President, I agreed to meet, after the first one, and the last one, but never agreed to do his show, which he wants me to do, DESPARATELY [sic] — It won’t happen! When I have watched the show, which isn’t often, it always ends with dishonesty, about me at least, but, who cares?”
paras.zh: “无论如何，在过去的几年里，拉贝拉会不停地打电话给我，说‘你好’，表现得非常友善，并告诉我比尔·马赫有多么‘爱’和尊重我，甚至在我担任总统之前，他就会不断地问我是否可以与马赫进行任何形式的会面，以及，我会做他的节目吗？”他写道。 “当我成为总统时，我同意在第一场和最后一场之后会面，但从未同意做他的节目，而他想让我做，绝望[原文如此]——这不会发生！当我观看节目时，这并不常见，它总是以不诚实结束，至少对我来说，但是，谁在乎呢？”

paras.en: He also later claimed LaBella and Kid Rock, the latter of which appeared on Friday night’s Real Time episode, “called me incessantly about meeting with Bill Maher,” which led to their first dinner in March 2025. “My first response was, ‘Fellas, this guy’s a Goofball,'” Trump wrote.
paras.zh: 他后来还声称，拉贝拉和摇滚小子（后者出现在周五晚上的《实时》节目中）“不断打电话给我，说要与比尔·马赫见面”，这导致了他们在 2025 年 3 月的第一次晚餐。“我的第一反应是，‘伙计们，这家伙是个傻瓜，’”特朗普写道。

articles.title: 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards: ‘General Hospital’ Wins Best Daytime Drama
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: The 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards were presented Friday night, with General Hospital taking home the top prize of best daytime drama.
paras.zh: 2026 年日间艾美奖于周五晚上颁发，《综合医院》荣获最佳日间剧集最高奖。

paras.en: The series, which went into Friday night’s show up for 13 awards, won three other awards and saw its Genie Francis receive the lifetime achievement award. Beyond the Gates also won four awards, with star Tamara Tunie winning best actress in a daytime drama series. Best actor in a daytime drama went to The Bold and the Beautiful‘s Scott Clifton.
paras.zh: 该剧在周五晚上的节目中获得了 13 个奖项，还赢得了另外三个奖项，其中的精灵弗朗西斯还获得了终身成就奖。 《超越大门》还获得了四项奖项，明星塔玛拉·图尼 (Tamara Tunie) 获得了日间剧集最佳女主角奖。日间剧最佳男主角颁给了《勇敢与美丽》中的斯科特·克利夫顿。

paras.en: Tunie, who won her first Daytime Emmy, paid tribute to the “host of Black actresses who paved the way for me, and I feel them as I stand here tonight, beginning with the legendary Cicely Tyson, the first Black woman to appear on a daytime television show, The Guiding Light.”
paras.zh: 图尼首次赢得日间艾美奖，她向“为我铺平道路的众多黑人女演员致敬，当我今晚站在这里时，我感受到了她们，从传奇人物西塞莉·泰森开始，她是第一位出现在日间电视节目《指路明灯》中的黑人女性。”

paras.en: Fellow best actress nominee Heather Tom, from The Bold and the Beautiful, was eyeing a record-setting seventh trophy, which would have made her the most awarded actress in daytime history.
paras.zh: 获得最佳女主角提名的希瑟·汤姆（《勇敢与美丽》）正在瞄准创纪录的第七座奖杯，这将使她成为白天历史上获奖最多的女演员。

paras.en: The Young and the Restless led this year’s nominees with 18 nominations. Though it only won three awards, two of those came in the supporting performer categories. Roger Howarth was named best supporting actor, and Beth Maitland was named best supporting actress.
paras.zh: 《年轻与不安》以 18 项提名在今年的提名者中名列前茅。尽管它只获得了三个奖项，但其中两个奖项属于配角奖。罗杰·豪沃斯（Roger Howarth）被评为最佳男配角，贝丝·梅特兰（Beth Maitland）被评为最佳女配角。

paras.en: The Kelly Clarkson Show won five awards, including best daytime talk series, but the singer-host of the now-completed talk show didn’t appear to be at the Daytime Emmys. And Clarkson didn’t win the award for best daytime talk series host. Instead that honor went to fellow former talk show host Sherri Shepherd, whose eponymous talk show was canceled after four seasons.
paras.zh: 《凯莉·克拉克森秀》赢得了五项奖项，包括最佳日间脱口秀节目，但现已完成的脱口秀节目的歌手兼主持人似乎并未出现在日间艾美奖颁奖典礼上。克拉克森没有获得最佳日间脱口秀节目主持人奖。相反，这一荣誉颁给了前脱口秀主持人雪莉·谢泼德 (Sherri Shepherd)，她的同名脱口秀节目在播出四个季后就被取消了。

paras.en: Other notable winners include Tracee Ellis Ross, who won best travel and adventure program for her Solo Traveling show; Keke Palmer, who won for her work executive producing Glam Through the Ages; and Ina Garten, who won best culinary host for her Be My Guest Food Network series, which was named best culinary instructional series.
paras.zh: 其他著名获奖者包括特雷西·埃利斯·罗斯 (Tracee Ellis Ross)，她凭借个人旅行节目赢得了最佳旅行和冒险节目奖； Keke Palmer，因其执行制作《Glam Through the Ages》而获奖；伊娜·加滕 (Ina Garten) 凭借《Be My Guest Food Network》系列节目获得最佳烹饪主持人奖，该系列节目被评为最佳烹饪教学系列节目。

paras.en: Midway through the ceremony, NATAS chair Terry O’Reilly offered a timely, political speech, just days ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. Speaking about a congressman who was jailed in 1798 after criticizing the president in print, O’Reilly highlighed the power of the people.
paras.zh: 在仪式进行到一半时，距离 2026 年中期选举仅几天，NATAS 主席特里·奥莱利 (Terry O’Reilly) 发表了及时的政治演讲。谈到 1798 年一位因在报纸上批评总统而被监禁的国会议员，奥莱利强调了人民的力量。

paras.en: “The free press in 1800 was not saved by a court. It was saved by citizens who were engaged and informed,” he said.
paras.zh: “1800 年的新闻自由不是由法院拯救的。它是由积极参与和知情的公民拯救的，”他说。

paras.en: Turning to the present day, O’Reilly called out “the most sustained effort to control what Americans see and hear in this country that were faced in my lifetime.” He cited specifically journalists being banned from covering the Pentagon and president, the DOJ antitrust investigation into the White House TV press pool and the challenge to the news exemption enjoyed by late night and daytime programs, including The View.
paras.zh: 谈到当今，奥莱利呼吁“为控制美国人在这个国家的所见所闻而做出的最持久的努力，这是我一生中所面临的。”他特别提到了记者被禁止报道五角大楼和总统、司法部对白宫电视记者池进行反垄断调查，以及深夜和日间节目（包括《观点》）所享有的新闻豁免面临的挑战。

paras.en: “It is not much of a leap, from silencing political speech, to suppressing creative expression,” O’Reilly added. “The characters, the storylines, the points of view that someone in power decides are no longer welcome. Here, in the cradle of Hollywood, this town of all towns, we know where that can lead. We have seen what happens when those in power begin drawing up lists of people and pops and ideas that they are willing to label as un-American. We should never wish to see that again.”
paras.zh: 奥莱利补充道：“从压制政治言论到压制创意表达，这并不是一个很大的飞跃。” “当权者决定的人物、故事情节和观点不再受欢迎。在这里，在好莱坞的摇篮，这个小镇的城镇，我们知道这会导致什么结果。我们已经看到当当权者开始起草他们愿意贴上非美国标签的人物、流行音乐和想法清单时会发生什么。我们永远不希望再次看到这种情况。”

paras.en: Turning to the “consequential” midterms on Tuesday, O’Reilly issued a call to those in the audience: “Let’s stand together to resist those who would seek comfort in a quieter media.”
paras.zh: 谈到周二“重要的”中期选举，奥莱利向观众发出呼吁：“让我们站在一起，抵制那些在安静的媒体中寻求安慰的人。”

paras.en: And NATAS additionally inducted a number of individuals into its Gold and Silver Circle Society, recognizing industry leaders who’ve demonstrated enduring contributions to television through their 50 or 25 years in industry. The 2026 Gold Circle inductees are Allen Media Group CEO Byron Allen, performer Patrika Darbo, actor-director-producer Francesca James and host-producer Meredith Vieira. The Silver Circle inductees are Fox TV Stations executive vp, programming and development Stephen Brown and announcer warm-up host Rubin Ervin.
paras.zh: NATAS 还引入了一些个人加入其金银圈协会，表彰在行业 50 或 25 年中对电视做出持久贡献的行业领导者。 2026 年金圈入选者包括艾伦媒体集团首席执行官拜伦·艾伦 (Byron Allen)、演员帕特里卡·达博 (Patrika Darbo)、演员兼导演兼制片人弗朗西斯卡·詹姆斯 (Francesca James) 以及主持人兼制片人梅雷迪思·维埃拉 (Meredith Vieira)。银圈入选者包括福克斯电视台执行副总裁、节目制作和开发斯蒂芬·布朗（Stephen Brown）以及播音员热身主持人鲁宾·欧文（Rubin Ervin）。

paras.en: The Hollywood Reporter won its first Daytime Emmy, taking home the award for best arts and popular culture program for THR’s Off Script roundtable series.
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》凭借 THR 的场外圆桌系列节目赢得了首个日间艾美奖，并荣获最佳艺术和流行文化节目奖。

paras.en: Fellow PMC brand IndieWire additionally won best editing for a daytime studio program for its craft roundtables, with Trevor Wallace accepting for the brand.
paras.zh: PMC 品牌 IndieWire 还因其工艺圆桌会议赢得了日间工作室节目的最佳剪辑奖，特雷弗·华莱士 (Trevor Wallace) 代表该品牌获奖。

paras.en: The 53rd Daytime Emmy Awards ceremony took place on Friday, Oct. 30 at the Hollywood Palladium.
paras.zh: 第 53 届日间艾美奖颁奖典礼于 10 月 30 日星期五在好莱坞 Palladium 举行。

articles.title: Cramer’s week ahead: Expect more volatility as tech earnings, midterms loom

paras.en: CNBC's Jim Cramer warned on Friday that volatility on Wall Street may not be over.
paras.zh: CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 周五警告称，华尔街的波动可能尚未结束。

paras.en: Stocks endured a turbulent week as renewed concerns about the artificial intelligence trade weighed on technology shares. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite climbed 2.3% through Wednesday before plunging 2.9% Friday, ending the week down 2%. The S&P 500 followed a similar pattern, rising 1.6% through Wednesday before tumbling 1.8% Friday to finish the week down 0.6%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average also reversed course, gaining 0.5% through Wednesday before slipping 1.1% Friday to end the week down 0.9%.
paras.zh: 由于对人工智能交易的新担忧令科技股承压，股市经历了动荡的一周。以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数周三上涨 2.3%，周五暴跌 2.9%，本周收盘下跌 2%。标准普尔 500 指数也遵循类似的模式，周三上涨 1.6%，周五下跌 1.8%，本周收盘下跌 0.6%。道琼斯工业平均指数也出现逆转，周三上涨 0.5%，周五下跌 1.1%，本周收盘下跌 0.9%。

paras.en: "After a brutal week for tech, don't assume the worst is behind us," the "Mad Money" host said. "We've got the election, uncertainty overseas, the jobs report and another slew of earnings."
paras.zh: “科技行业经历了残酷的一周后，不要认为最糟糕的时期已经过去了，”《Mad Money》主持人说道。 “我们面临着选举、海外的不确定性、就业报告和其他大量的收益。”

paras.en: "My advice?" he added. "Don't try to call the bottom in the Nasdaq just yet. Pick up some high-quality companies that are being thrown away, and remember, in this market, even great earnings might not be enough to send a stock higher."
paras.zh: “我的建议？”他补充道。 “现在不要试图判断纳斯达克是否已经触底。挑选一些正在被抛弃的优质公司，并记住，在这个市场上，即使是巨大的盈利也可能不足以推高股价。”

paras.en: With that backdrop, Cramer turned to the week ahead.
paras.zh: 在此背景下，克莱默转向了未来一周。

paras.en: Apple reports after the bell. Shares recently hit an all-time high, helped by enthusiasm for its latest products, including the upcoming Duo foldable phone. Cramer remains bullish on the company but acknowledged that its valuation of almost 40 times earnings leaves little room for disappointment. "You can trade it, but I am going to own it," he said.
paras.zh: 苹果公司在响铃后报告。得益于对其最新产品（包括即将推出的 Duo 可折叠手机）的热情，该公司股价最近创下历史新高。克莱默仍然看好该公司，但承认其市盈率近 40 倍的估值几乎没有令人失望的空间。 “你可以交易它，但我将拥有它，”他说。

paras.en: Cramer also expects encouraging results from Palantir when it reports, citing strong customer feedback about the value of its AI software.
paras.zh: Cramer 还预计 Palantir 在发布报告时会取得令人鼓舞的结果，并引用了客户对其人工智能软件价值的强烈反馈。

paras.en: The midterm elections take center stage, with Cramer watching whether a shift in congressional control could threaten planned data center projects. He warned that growing political opposition to the facilities could delay construction and hurt companies whose growth depends heavily on AI infrastructure spending. However, he's "not going to write off the data center entirely because there are plenty of states that will welcome them."
paras.zh: 中期选举成为焦点，克莱默正在关注国会控制权的转变是否会威胁到计划中的数据中心项目。他警告说，对这些设施日益增长的政治反对可能会推迟建设，并损害那些增长严重依赖人工智能基础设施支出的公司。然而，他“不会完全取消数据中心，因为有很多州欢迎它们。”

paras.en: On the earnings front, Advanced Micro Devices reports, offering another important test for the semiconductor sector following Intel's disappointing results. Cramer expects AMD to report better numbers than rival Intel.
paras.zh: 在盈利方面，AMD 报告称，继英特尔令人失望的业绩之后，半导体行业面临又一次重要考验。克莱默预计 AMD 将报告比竞争对手英特尔更好的数据。

paras.en: Drugmakers Pfizer and Amgen also report. Cramer said both could benefit from renewed investor enthusiasm for pharmaceutical stocks.
paras.zh: 制药商辉瑞（Pfizer）和安进（Amgen）也报告了这一情况。克莱默表示，投资者对制药股的热情重​​新燃起，两者都可能受益。

paras.en: CVS Health reports, and Cramer remains intrigued by the company's position in the healthcare sector. However, he expressed concerns about its pharmacy benefit management business. "I wish it could disengage with that business; its stock would go higher," he said.
paras.zh: CVS Health 报道称，克莱默仍然对该公司在医疗保健领域的地位感兴趣。不过，他对其药品福利管理业务表示担忧。 “我希望它能够脱离该业务；它的股价会更高，”他说。

paras.en: McDonald's earnings will also be in focus. Cramer wants to see whether the company's restaurant improvement strategy is gaining traction amid reported concerns from franchisees.
paras.zh: 麦当劳的盈利也将成为焦点。克莱默希望了解该公司的餐厅改进策略是否在特许经营商的担忧中获得关注。

paras.en: Kimberly-Clark reports, with Cramer optimistic about the consumer products company's prospects following its planned merger with Kenvue. The stock has benefited from investors rotating into consumer staples, and Cramer remains bullish on the company. "If this one falls before then, I think you should pick some up," he said.
paras.zh: 金佰利克拉克 (Kimberly-Clark) 报道称，克莱默 (Cramer) 对这家消费品公司计划与 Kenvue 合并后的前景持乐观态度。该股受益于投资者转向消费必需品领域，克莱默仍然看好该公司。 “如果这个在那之前掉下来，我认为你应该捡起一些，”他说。

paras.en: The monthly jobs report will provide another important test for markets. Cramer expects strong hiring but limited wage growth, a combination that could help ease inflation concerns and explain the relative stability in Treasury yields.
paras.zh: 月度就业报告将为市场提供另一项重要考验。克莱默预计，招聘强劲，但工资增长有限，这可能有助于缓解通胀担忧，并解释美国国债收益率的相对稳定性。

paras.en: The CNBC Investing Club will also hold its annual meeting, where Cramer and Jeff Marks will discuss the portfolio, market risks and their biggest investment winners.
paras.zh: CNBC 投资俱乐部也将举行年会，克莱默和杰夫·马克斯将在会上讨论投资组合、市场风险和他们最大的投资赢家。

paras.en: Want to take a deep dive into Cramer's world? Hit him up!
paras.zh: 想深入了解克莱默的世界吗？打他！

articles.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns

paras.en: Meta's outlook has been revised downward by S&P Global Ratings on concerns surrounding cash flow and AI spending.
paras.zh: 由于对现金流和人工智能支出的担忧，标准普尔全球评级下调了 Meta 的前景。

paras.en: The credit agency said Friday that the outlook reflects "uncertainty" about Meta's elevated capex and its negative free cash flow.
paras.zh: 该信贷机构周五表示，前景反映出 Meta 资本支出增加及其负自由现金流的“不确定性”。

paras.en: Meta's credit rating was revised from AA- stable to AA- negative, S&P said. S&Ps highest credit rating is AAA. Anything below BBB falls into the junk bond category.
paras.zh: 标准普尔表示，Meta 的信用评级从 AA- 稳定调整为 AA- 负面。标准普尔最高信用评级为 AAA。任何低于 BBB 的债券都属于垃圾债券类别。

paras.en: The agency questioned "Meta's ability to monetize its AI investments" relative to its peers, which are also spending heavily on data center buildouts and going cash flow negative in the process.
paras.zh: 该机构质疑“Meta 将其人工智能投资货币化的能力”（相对于同行），这些同行也在数据中心建设上投入巨资，并在此过程中现金流为负。

paras.en: Although Meta has recently debuted its Muse AI agent app and related foundation models, S&P said "it is unclear when these revenue streams will generate material contributions that exceed their rising costs over the next few years."
paras.zh: 尽管 Meta 最近推出了 Muse AI 代理应用程序和相关基础模型，但标准普尔表示，“目前尚不清楚这些收入流何时会产生超过未来几年不断上涨的成本的物质贡献。”

paras.en: A Meta spokesperson pushed back on the revision.
paras.zh: Meta 发言人对这一修改进行了反驳。

paras.en: "We respectfully disagree with S&P's assertion about Meta's AI monetization capabilities," the spokesperson said in a statement. "We see significant product and business opportunities ahead of us, supporting our very strong credit profile."
paras.zh: 该发言人在一份声明中表示：“我们谨不同意标准普尔关于 Meta 人工智能货币化能力的说法。” “我们看到了重要的产品和商业机会，这支持了我们非常强大的信用状况。”

paras.en: Meta said in its third-quarter earnings report last week that it expects full-year capex to come in the range of $135 billion to $145 billion. The company also posted negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion, going in the red for the first time.
paras.zh: Meta 在上周的第三季度收益报告中表示，预计全年资本支出将在 1350 亿美元至 1450 亿美元之间。该公司还公布了21.2亿美元的负自由现金流，首次出现亏损。

paras.en: Investors sent Meta shares down 7% following the report despite a revenue beat. The stock finished October down 15%, its worst month in four years.
paras.zh: 尽管营收超出预期，但报告发布后，投资者仍令 Meta 股价下跌 7%。该股 10 月份收盘下跌 15%，是四年来表现最差的一个月。

paras.en: The company said on Monday that it plans to raise $95 billion to help fund its AI initiatives, with plans to first raise $35 billion in underwritten public equity offerings, followed by an additional $60 billion through an at-the-market program.
paras.zh: 该公司周一表示，计划筹集 950 亿美元为其人工智能计划提供资金，计划首先通过承销的公开股票发行筹集 350 亿美元，随后通过市场计划筹集 600 亿美元。

paras.en: S&P said that while it expects Meta's capex growth to start "flattening out beginning in 2028," the agency is "less certain that it will curtail its spending as previously anticipated."
paras.zh: 标准普尔表示，虽然预计 Meta 的资本支出增长将“从 2028 年开始趋于平稳”，但该机构“不太确定是否会像之前预期的那样削减支出”。

paras.en: WATCH: Mike Khouw likes this options strategy for Meta post-earnings.
paras.zh: 观看：Mike Khouw 喜欢 Meta 财报后的这种期权策略。

articles.title: Jim Cramer says it's time to look beyond tech. Here are 4 consumer stocks he likes

paras.en: Investors looking to diversify beyond the struggling artificial intelligence trade should consider consumer staples stocks, CNBC's Jim Cramer said Friday.
paras.zh: CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 周五表示，除了陷入困境的人工智能行业之外，寻求多元化投资的投资者应该考虑消费必需品股票。

paras.en: The Nasdaq-100, which tracks the biggest tech stocks, ended October down almost 7%. Investors rotated into other more defensive areas of the market. The S&P 500 Equal Weight gained roughly 5% for the month. (The equal weight index treats all the S&P 500 stocks the same, rather than weighting them by market cap.) The consumer staples index surged 11.4%, making it the second-best performing sector behind energy.
paras.zh: 追踪最大科技股的纳斯达克 100 指数 10 月底下跌近 7%。投资者转向市场的其他更具防御性的领域。标准普尔 500 等权重指数本月上涨约 5%。 （等权重指数对标准普尔 500 指数中的所有股票一视同仁，而不是按市值对它们进行加权。）必需消费品指数飙升 11.4%，成为仅次于能源的表现第二好的板块。

paras.en: "You've got to take what the market is giving you, and until we sort out some of the issues for the tech sector, some other groups might be better bets for the time being," the "Mad Money" host said. "I like the idea of camping out in the staples for a bit."
paras.zh: “你必须接受市场给你的东西，在我们解决科技行业的一些问题之前，其他一些群体暂时可能是更好的选择，”《Mad Money》主持人说。 “我喜欢在斯台普斯露营一会儿的想法。”

paras.en: Cramer highlighted four companies he finds particularly attractive in consumer staples — a group that features companies with household brand names that people tend to buy regardless of market conditions or economic environment.
paras.zh: 克莱默重点介绍了他认为在必需消费品领域特别有吸引力的四家公司，这些公司拥有家喻户晓的品牌，无论市场状况或经济环境如何，人们都倾向于购买这些公司。

paras.en: - Kimberly-Clark: The maker of Kleenex tissues and Huggies diapers is one of the newest holdings in Cramer's Charitable Trust, the portfolio run by CNBC's Investing Club. Cramer sees significant upside from its pending merger with Kenvue, which owns brands including Tylenol and Band-Aid. He expects the deal to generate efficiencies and create a consumer products powerhouse. Kimberly-Clark shares gained nearly 11% in October, but the stock still trades at less than 15 times earnings, with a 4.7% dividend yield. "I think the move is just getting started," Cramer said.
paras.zh: - Kimberly-Clark：Kleenex 纸巾和 Huggies 尿布制造商是 Cramer's Charitable Trust（由 CNBC 投资俱乐部运营的投资组合）最新持股之一。 Cramer 认为即将与 Kenvue 合并将带来巨大的好处，Kenvue 拥有泰诺 (Tylenol) 和创可贴 (Band-Aid) 等品牌。他预计这笔交易将提高效率并创建一个消费产品巨头。金佰利 (Kimberly-Clark) 股价 10 月份上涨近 11%，但其市盈率仍低于 15 倍，股息收益率为 4.7%。 “我认为此举才刚刚开始，”克莱默说。

paras.en: - Procter & Gamble: While the Investing Club exited its longtime P&G position in July, Cramer said the company remains an attractive defensive investment following better-than-expected quarterly results last week. He also expressed confidence in new CEO Shailesh Jejurikar. Shares of Procter & Gamble rallied 11% in October, though Cramer prefers Kimberly-Clark's lower valuation and higher dividend yield.
paras.zh: - 宝洁公司（Procter & Gamble）：尽管投资俱乐部在 7 月份退出了其长期持有的宝洁公司 (P&G) 头寸，但克莱默表示，由于上周的季度业绩好于预期，该公司仍然是一项有吸引力的防御性投资。他还对新任首席执行官 Shailesh Jejurikar 表示了信心。尽管克莱默更看好金佰利公司较低的估值和较高的股息收益率，但宝洁公司的股价 10 月份上涨了 11%。

paras.en: - Constellation Brands: The maker of Modelo and Pacifico beers is showing signs of a turnaround, with its core beer business gaining market share and its smaller wine and spirits division reporting 15% shipment growth last quarter. Shares of Constellation Brands surged 20% in October, but Cramer still sees value in the stock, which trades at roughly 11 times earnings and yields more than 3%. "It increasingly looks like the worst is behind Constellation Brands," Cramer said.
paras.zh: - Constellation Brands：Modelo 和 Pacifico 啤酒制造商显示出扭亏为盈的迹象，其核心啤酒业务不断扩大市场份额，规模较小的葡萄酒和烈酒部门报告上季度出货量增长 15%。 Constellation Brands 的股价 10 月份飙升了 20%，但克莱默仍然认为该股票有价值，其市盈率约为 11 倍，收益率超过 3%。克莱默表示：“星座品牌似乎正面临着最糟糕的情况。”

paras.en: - Coca-Cola: This is the one Cramer favors among the major soda makers. Coca-Cola delivered a strong quarterly report on Tuesday driven by higher volume rather than price increases. He also praised its innovation in zero-calorie beverages and its protein options with its Fairlife milk business. Shares gained 9% in October.
paras.zh: - 可口可乐：这是克莱默在主要汽水制造商中最喜欢的一款。可口可乐周二发布了强劲的季度报告，其推动因素是销量增加而不是价格上涨。他还赞扬了该公司在零热量饮料方面的创新以及 Fairlife 牛奶业务的蛋白质选择。 10 月份股价上涨 9%。
