articles.title: An aquanaut comes home: Returning to Earth from an undersea 'space station'
articles.author: Michaela Musilova

paras.en: Our time on our "space mission" underwater was coming to an end, and I felt like what I imagine an astronaut on the International Space Station (ISS) must feel before returning to Earth. On one hand, you are excited to return to your home and loved ones, as well as to fresh food and normal hygiene. On the other, you know you will miss your crew and the incredible experience of being in space.
paras.zh: 我们在水下的“太空任务”即将结束，我的感觉就像国际空间站（ISS）上的宇航员在返回地球之前必须感受到的那样。一方面，您很高兴回到自己的家和亲人，以及新鲜的食物和正常的卫生条件。另一方面，您知道您会想念您的机组人员以及在太空中令人难以置信的体验。

paras.en: While my SEA STAR crew and I had not left Earth during our mission, we were separated from the surface of our home planet for five days. All we saw was a green alien water world surrounding us. We did this to live and work like astronauts on the ISS. Instead of dealing with the challenges of space that astronauts face, we problem-solved sometimes equally difficult issues that divers have to manage when performing research in sea water.
paras.zh: 虽然我和我的 SEA STAR 船员在执行任务期间没有离开地球，但我们已经与母星表面分离了五天。我们所看到的只是我们周围的一个绿色的外星水世界。我们这样做是为了像国际空间站上的宇航员一样生活和工作。我们没有解决宇航员面临的太空挑战，而是解决了潜水员在海水中进行研究时必须处理的有时同样困难的问题。

paras.en: Our "wet ISS" was the Jules' Undersea Lab, which is located near Key Largo, Florida, at 22 feet (7 meters) underwater. By the end of our mission, we had all officially become aquanauts. An aquanaut is an undersea explorer who remains underwater for more than 24 hours, without returning to the surface, in a state known as saturation.
paras.zh: 我们的“湿国际空间站”是朱尔斯的海底实验室，位于佛罗里达州基拉戈岛附近，水下 22 英尺（7 米）处。任务结束时，我们都正式成为了潜水员。潜水员是指在水下停留超过 24 小时而不返回水面的海底探险家，这种状态称为饱和状态。

paras.en: In this sense, saturation refers to the physiological condition achieved by a person who breathes underwater long enough for the body's tissues to absorb the maximum possible amount of inert gas (like nitrogen), for a specific depth and pressure. The term aquanaut derives from the Latin word "aqua" (water) and the Greek "nautes" (sailor).
paras.zh: 从这个意义上说，饱和度是指一个人在水下呼吸足够长的时间以使身体组织在特定深度和压力下吸收最大可能量的惰性气体（如氮气）所达到的生理条件。 Aquanaut一词源自拉丁语“aqua”（水）和希腊语“nautes”（水手）。

paras.en: There were a lot of things I wasn't going to miss about being an aquanaut. They included the constant loud noises our life support systems made to keep us alive underwater, as well as bathroom plumbing issues and some health concerns linked to living under pressure. We also had to be very careful when performing our "spacewalks" (scuba dives), due to the low visibility of the environment around us.
paras.zh: 作为一名潜水员，有很多事情我不会错过。其中包括我们的生命维持系统为使我们在水下生存而发出的持续的巨大噪音，以及浴室管道问题和一些与生活压力有关的健康问题。由于我们周围环境的能见度很低，我们在进行“太空行走”（水肺潜水）时也必须非常小心。

paras.en: Nonetheless, I experienced a sort of "underview effect" during this mission. Most astronauts report experiencing an "overview effect" after seeing our whole planet from space, which usually makes them value our unique planet even more. I felt a similar thing when I saw the sun's rays come through the water. I couldn't reach them, but I enjoyed them from afar. My everyday life felt so close, yet so far away. It gave me both a feeling of longing and more determination to take even more care of our home world than before.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，我在这次任务中经历了一种“隐藏效应”。大多数宇航员表示，从太空看到整个地球后，他们会经历一种“概览效应”，这通常会让他们更加珍惜我们独特的星球。当我看到阳光透过水面时，我也有类似的感觉。我无法接近他们，但我从远处欣赏他们。我的日常生活感觉如此近，却又如此遥远。它给了我一种渴望的感觉，也让我更有决心比以前更加关心我们的家园。

paras.en: I'm grateful that we were able to perform all of the different scientific projects we planned for our mission. As the Commander of the crew, I usually have my work cut out for me managing the crew and overseeing their research projects, as had been the case for most of the 40 simulated space missions that I led previously. Fortunately, this time my crew was made up of experienced analog astronauts and divers, so the mission was mostly smooth sailing.
paras.zh: 我很感激我们能够执行为我们的任务计划的所有不同的科学项目。作为机组人员的指挥官，我的工作通常是管理机组人员并监督他们的研究项目，就像我之前领导的 40 次模拟太空任务中的大多数任务一样。幸运的是，这次我的机组人员由经验丰富的模拟宇航员和潜水员组成，所以任务大部分顺利。

paras.en: The research we chose for this mission was relevant for long-duration space missions. Since we can only send a small number of astronauts to the ISS with a limited number of research activities to perform, underwater stations provide us with a valuable way to conduct analog, or simulated, space missions instead. We also performed some environmental conservation work using a type of underwater vacuum device to help protect the nature around the Jules' Undersea Lab.
paras.zh: 我们为本次任务选择的研究与长期太空任务相关。由于我们只能派遣少量宇航员到国际空间站进行有限数量的研究活动，因此水下站为我们提供了一种执行模拟太空任务的宝贵方法。我们还使用一种水下真空装置进行了一些环境保护工作，以帮助保护朱尔斯海底实验室周围的自然环境。

paras.en: My scientific project was focused on studying whether our cognitive abilities and reaction times changed under pressure. This study is part of my collaboration with the Center for Hyperbaric Medicine, Faculty of Medicine of the University of Ostrava and City Hospital Ostrava in the Czech Republic. The whole crew definitely felt like their response times to these tests were slower during the mission than before it.
paras.zh: 我的科学项目专注于研究我们的认知能力和反应时间在压力下是否会发生变化。这项研究是我与捷克共和国俄斯特拉发大学医学院高压医学中心和俄斯特拉发城市医院合作的一部分。整个机组人员肯定觉得他们在任务期间对这些测试的响应时间比之前要慢。

paras.en: We were also interested in seeing how microgreens seeds were affected by the changes in pressure. Our Health & Safety Officer, Dr. Brandy Nunez, grew some of our kale and super salad mix before we started our mission, while other seeds started their growth journey underwater. All seeds were transferred to our underwater station using two varied pressure settings (gradual and sudden pressure release during their descent). After we harvested them, we could see that the latter types of seeds did indeed experience some barotrauma (damage caused by the sudden increase in air pressure).
paras.zh: 我们也有兴趣了解微型蔬菜种子如何受到压力变化的影响。在我们开始任务之前，我们的健康与安全官 Brandy Nunez 博士种植了一些羽衣甘蓝和超级沙拉混合物，而其他种子则在水下开始了它们的生长之旅。所有种子均使用两种不同的压力设置（在下降过程中逐渐释放压力和突然释放压力）转移到我们的水下站。当我们收获它们后，我们可以看到后一种类型的种子确实经历了一些气压伤（气压突然升高造成的损坏）。

paras.en: Executive Officer Paul Bakken's work was related to managing the internal pressure of logistical transfer containers when they are exposed to significant environmental changes in pressure. The fourth crewmember, Mission Specialist Jenn Pint, worked with Interstellar Performance Labs to develop a taxonomy for analyzing environmental and crew interaction factors during simulated space missions.
paras.zh: 执行官 Paul Bakken 的工作涉及在物流转运容器暴露于压力显着的环境变化时管理其内部压力。第四名机组成员是任务专家 Jenn Pint，他与星际性能实验室合作开发了一种分类法，用于分析模拟太空任务期间的环境和机组人员相互作用因素。

paras.en: On top of these projects, we also performed neutral buoyancy experiments during our underwater spacewalks, as well as the testing of environmental sensors developed by high school and university students in Slovakia. The sensors provided important supplemental information to the cognitive study about our simulated space habitat's living conditions.
paras.zh: 除了这些项目之外，我们还在水下太空行走期间进行了中性浮力实验，以及对斯洛伐克高中生和大学生开发的环境传感器进行了测试。这些传感器为有关我们模拟太空栖息地生活条件的认知研究提供了重要的补充信息。

paras.en: Just like astronauts on the ISS, we dedicated some of our time to outreach and educational work, too. In our case, we called Cosmic Region, a simulated space station in Slovakia, and gave the team there a tour of our underwater habitat. My crewmembers kindly went into the water at that time and performed a spacewalk to show what our work during the mission was like.
paras.zh: 就像国际空间站上的宇航员一样，我们也投入了一些时间进行外展和教育工作。在我们的案例中，我们致电斯洛伐克的一个模拟空间站“宇宙区域”，并让那里的团队参观了我们的水下栖息地。我的机组人员当时很友善地进入水中并进行了太空行走，以展示我们在任务期间的工作情况。

paras.en: As I put on my "spacesuit" (scuba diving gear) one last time, I breathed the stuffy undersea air once more and then dove out to return to "Earth." My crewmembers and I then took a long detour around the lagoon around us to help our bodies adjust to lower pressures. Even though we were only 22 feet underwater, there was still a small risk of decompression-related problems that aquanauts can face after living under saturation for some time. The final step was to breach the surface at long last. That's when we all enjoyed breathing fresh air again and feeling the sun on our faces, though the temperature in Florida made us quickly hide away from it again 😉.
paras.zh: 当我最后一次穿上“宇航服”（水肺潜水装备）时，我再次呼吸了闷热的海底空气，然后潜入“地球”。然后，我和我的船员绕着我们周围的泻湖走了很长一段路，以帮助我们的身体适应较低的压力。尽管我们的水深只有 22 英尺，但潜水员在饱和状态下生活一段时间后仍可能面临与减压相关的问题的小风险。最后一步是终于突破地表。那时我们都再次享受着新鲜空气的享受，感受着脸上的阳光，尽管佛罗里达的气温让我们很快又躲了起来😉。

paras.en: You can follow Dr. Michaela Musilova at her website and on social media: @astro_michaela (Instagram, TikTok and Threads), @Dr. Michaela Musilova (Facebook) and @astro-michaela.bsky.social (Bluesky).
paras.zh: 您可以在 Michaela Musilova 博士的网站和社交媒体上关注她：@astro_michaela（Instagram、TikTok 和 Threads）、@Dr. Michaela Musilova (Facebook) 和@astro-michaela.bsky.social (Bluesky)。

paras.en: Dr. Michaela Musilova is an award-winning astrobiologist, explorer, professional speaker and author. Michaela has been conducting space-related research at institutions around the world, including NASA, ESA, CalTech, the Canada-France-Hawaii telescope and many others. She was the Commander of 40 simulated missions to the Moon and Mars — the most missions led to date.
paras.zh: 米凯拉·穆西洛娃 (Michaela Musilova) 博士是一位屡获殊荣的天体生物学家、探险家、专业演讲家和作家。米凯拉一直在世界各地的机构进行与太空相关的研究，包括美国宇航局、欧洲航天局、加州理工学院、加拿大-法国-夏威夷望远镜等。她是 40 次月球和火星模拟任务的指挥官，这是迄今为止执行次数最多的任务。

articles.title: The world mourns the passing of 'Star Trek's' Patrick Stewart with a galaxy of tearful tributes
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: As we all begin to absorb the bitter news of Patrick Stewart's death at the age of 86, a flood of personal tributes are pouring in, reflecting this global treasure's wonderful life lived with a dignity and bravado that few mortals possess.
paras.zh: 当我们大家开始接受帕特里克·斯图尔特 (Patrick Stewart) 86 岁去世的悲痛消息时，大量的个人悼念如潮水般涌来，反映了这位全球瑰宝的精彩一生，他的尊严和勇敢是凡人中很少有人拥有的。

paras.en: We’re getting just a hint of what Patrick Stewart meant to those who worked with him or knew him throughout his stellar career. Whether on stage with the Royal Shakespeare Company, on TV as the dashing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in "Star Trek: The Next Generation," and in Hollywood spectacles like 1984's "Dune," four "Star Trek" feature films, and the many "X-Men" movies in which he portrayed Professor Charles Xavier, Stewart was always the consummate professional. His final screen performance arrives on Dec. 18 with "Avengers: Doomsday" where he’ll present his Charles Xavier character once more.
paras.zh: 我们只是得到了帕特里克·斯图尔特对那些在他辉煌的职业生涯中与他共事或认识他的人意味着什么的暗示。无论是在皇家莎士比亚剧团的舞台上，还是在电视剧《星际迷航：下一代》中饰演风度翩翩的让-吕克·皮卡德船长，以及在 1984 年的《沙丘》、四部《星际迷航》故事片以及多部饰演查尔斯·泽维尔教授的《X 战警》电影中，斯图尔特始终是一位完美的专业人士。他的最后一场银幕表演将于 12 月 18 日上映，他将在《复仇者联盟：世界末日》中再次演绎查尔斯·泽维尔这个角色。

paras.en: "Before everything else, Patrick was defined by being born and bred in Yorkshire, the proud county in the north of England which he loved to the end," Ian McKellen wrote on Instagram of his "X-Men" co-star and friend. "You could hear it in his accented voice and in the stern honesty with which he told you what he thought and felt. Yorkshiremen have no truck with half-truths or avoidance of big issues. He wore his heart on his sleeve, which made him a man to rely on, to admire and, in my case, love."
paras.zh: “最重要的是，帕特里克在约克郡出生和长大，这是他对英格兰北部引以自豪的郡县的热爱至死不渝，”伊恩·麦凯伦在 Instagram 上这样评价他的《X 战警》联合主演和朋友。 “你可以从他带着口音的声音和他告诉你他的想法和感受的严肃诚实中听出这一点。约克郡人不会半真半假或回避重大问题。他把自己的心放在袖子上，这使他成为一个值得依赖、钦佩的人，对我来说，也是一个值得爱的人。”

paras.en: William Shatner, a fellow Enterprise captain, offered his profound sense of loss on Stewart's passing. The legends shared the screen in 1994's "Star Trek: Generations."
paras.zh: 企业号船长威廉·夏特纳对斯图尔特的去世表示深切的失落感。两位传奇人物在 1994 年的《星际迷航：世代》中同台亮相。

paras.en: "What a heartbreaking week it has been. Sir Patrick Stewart was a friend, a colleague, and a magnificent actor," Shatner posted on Facebook. "From the stage to the bridge of the Enterprise, he brought intelligence, grace, and a deep sense of humanity to everything he did. Captain Picard stood for the best of us, and so did the man who played him. I was filled with affection and admiration for him and his work. My heart goes out to Sunny and his family. He will be deeply missed."
paras.zh: “这是多么令人心碎的一周。帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士是一位朋友、一位同事，也是一位出色的演员，”沙特纳在脸书上写道。 “从舞台到企业号的舰桥，他所做的每一件事都带来了智慧、优雅和深刻的人性。皮卡德船长代表了我们中最好的人，扮演他的人也是如此。我对他和他的工作充满了感情和钦佩。我的心与桑尼和他的家人同在。我们将深深怀念他。”

paras.en: Akiva Goldsman, co-creator of Paramount+'s "Star Trek: Picard" and "Star Trek: Strange New Worlds," delivered a sorrowful message in the aftermath of Stewart's death
paras.zh: 派拉蒙+《星际迷航：皮卡德》和《星际迷航：奇异新世界》的联合创作者阿齐瓦·高斯曼在斯图尔特去世后发表了悲伤的信息

paras.en: "Patrick was not only a true lion of the profession, he was the rarest of alchemists, one who could literally turn the written word into flesh and blood," Goldsman wrote. "Patrick was kind, strong, fiercely intelligent, collaborative, vulnerable and wise. His Captain Jean-Luc Picard permanently expanded the universe of 'Star Trek' without measure. He will be deeply missed by this one fan and by so many more."
paras.zh: “帕特里克不仅是这个行业真正的雄狮，他还是最稀有的炼金术士，他可以将文字变成血肉，”高斯曼写道。 “帕特里克善良、坚强、非常聪明、善于合作、脆弱且明智。他的船长让-吕克·皮卡德无限地扩展了《星际迷航》的宇宙。这个粉丝和更多的粉丝都会深深地怀念他。”

paras.en: Stewart's "Star Trek: The Next Generation" family shared their grief and offered up poignant words to try to describe what effect he had on their lives and profession.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特在《星际迷航：下一代》中的家人分享了他们的悲伤，并用辛酸的话语试图描述他对他们的生活和职业的影响。

paras.en: "There's no one on this planet that I have acted with or directed more often than my late great friend Patrick Stewart," revealed actor and director Jonathan Frakes, who co-starred for over 35 years with Stewart as Commander Will Riker, in a touching statement. "He will be with me forever. May he rest in Peace."
paras.zh: 演员兼导演乔纳森·弗雷克斯 (Jonathan Frakes) 在一份感人的声明中透露，“这个星球上没有人比我已故的好朋友帕特里克·斯图尔特 (Patrick Stewart) 合作或执导的次数更频繁。”他与斯图尔特共同主演威尔·赖克 (Will Riker) 指挥官超过 35 年，他在一份感人的声明中透露。 “他将永远和我在一起。愿他安息。”

paras.en: Finally, Marina Sirtis posted a teary-eyed video in which she explained how much of an impact Stewart had on her life during their time together on "The Next Generation" series and films, in which she portrayed Counselor Deanna Troi beside him.
paras.zh: 最后，玛丽娜·瑟蒂斯发布了一段热泪盈眶的视频，在视频中她解释了斯图尔特在“下一代”系列和电影中对她的生活产生了多大的影响，在视频中她在斯图尔特旁边扮演了辅导员迪安娜·特洛伊。

paras.en: "Patrick, I loved you with all my heart," she said on Instagram. "I know you're up there now, reunited with all those that you've loved. But to say that you'll be missed down here is probably the understatement of the century. It was an honor to work with Patrick. It was more than an honor; it was the privilege of my life to work with him."
paras.zh: “帕特里克，我全心全意地爱你，”她在 Instagram 上说道。 “我知道你现在在上面，与所有你所爱的人重聚。但是说你会在这里想念可能是本世纪的轻描淡写。与帕特里克一起工作是一种荣幸。这不仅仅是一种荣幸；与他一起工作是我一生的荣幸。”

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: Happy Halloween! SpaceX launches 27 Starlink satellites to orbit from California
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: SpaceX celebrated Halloween with an early-morning launch from California.
paras.zh: SpaceX 清晨从加利福尼亚州发射火箭来庆祝万圣节。

paras.en: A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base today (Oct. 31) at 12:04 a.m. EDT (0404 GMT; 9:04 p.m. on Oct. 30 local time), sending 27 of the company's Starlink internet satellites to low Earth orbit (LEO).
paras.zh: 美国东部时间今天（10 月 31 日）凌晨 12:04（格林尼治标准时间 0404；当地时间 10 月 30 日晚上 9:04）猎鹰 9 号火箭从范登堡太空部队基地升空，将公司的 27 颗星链互联网卫星送入近地轨道 (LEO)。

paras.en: The Falcon 9's first stage came back to Earth as planned, touching down about 8.5 minutes after launch on the SpaceX drone ship "Of Course I Still Love You," which was stationed in the Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 猎鹰 9 号的第一级按计划返回地球，在发射后约 8.5 分钟在驻扎在太平洋的 SpaceX 无人机船“当然我仍然爱你”上着陆。

paras.en: It was the 18th flight for this particular booster, which is designated B1093. The record for a SpaceX first stage is 37, set this past August by the booster B1067.
paras.zh: 这是这款特殊助推器的第 18 次飞行，该助推器被指定为 B1093。 SpaceX 第一阶段的记录是 37 次，是去年 8 月由助推器 B1067 创造的。

paras.en: The Falcon 9's upper stage did its job as well today, deploying the 27 Starlink satellites into LEO about 62 minutes after launch. They're joining more than 11,000 spacecraft in the Starlink megaconstellation, which is by far the largest satellite network ever assembled.
paras.zh: 猎鹰 9 号的上级今天也完成了自己的工作，在发射后约 62 分钟将 27 颗星链卫星部署到近地轨道。他们正在加入星链巨型星座中超过 11,000 颗航天器的行列，该星座是迄今为止规模最大的卫星网络。

paras.en: Today's launch was the 118th Falcon 9 flight of 2026 so far. More than 70% of these missions have been devoted to building out the Starlink network.
paras.zh: 今天的发射是 2026 年迄今为止猎鹰 9 号的第 118 次飞行。其中超过 70% 的任务致力于建设星链网络。

paras.en: SpaceX has also launched its Falcon Heavy and Starship rockets three times apiece this year. Falcon Heavy is an operational vehicle, but Starship remains in the test-flight phase. The company is currently gearing up for another Starship launch, which is expected to take place sometime in November.
paras.zh: SpaceX 今年还分别发射了三次猎鹰重型火箭和星际飞船火箭。重型猎鹰是一种可操作的飞行器，但星际飞船仍处于试飞阶段。该公司目前正在准备另一次 Starship 发射，预计将于 11 月某个时候进行。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Rethinking networks in space with Aalyria’s Brian Barritt
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss talks with the CEO of Aalyria Brian Barritt about how networks are evolving, what scaling the company means and the role of software interoperability for space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Aalyria 首席执行官 Brian Barritt 讨论了网络如何发展、公司规模扩张意味着什么以及软件互操作性在太空中的作用。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.

articles.title: Flexell Space Establishes French Subsidiary to Strengthen European Presence
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Paris-based FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS creates a local business hub in Europe
paras.zh: – 总部位于巴黎的 FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS 在欧洲创建本地商业中心

paras.en: – New entity to support ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers, from technical reviews to supply planning
paras.zh: – 新实体支持与欧洲客户正在进行的合同和批量生产讨论，从技术审查到供应计划

paras.en: Paris, France – Flexell Space, a space solar solution company, announced the establishment of its French entity, FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS, in Paris to strengthen support for ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎——太空太阳能解决方案公司 Flexell Space 宣布在巴黎成立其法国实体 FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS，以加强对与欧洲客户正在进行的合同和批量生产讨论的支持。

paras.en: The move comes as the company’s business discussions in Europe advance. Flexell Space is currently in talks with multiple European customers regarding collaboration agreements and volume supply of space solar cells and power solutions. Through its local presence, the company aims to accelerate customer communication and strengthen its ability to support business activities ranging from technical reviews to negotiations on supply terms.
paras.zh: 此举正值该公司在欧洲的业务讨论取得进展之际。 Flexell Space 目前正在与多个欧洲客户就合作协议以及空间太阳能电池和电力解决方案的批量供应进行谈判。通过其本地业务，该公司旨在加速客户沟通，并增强其支持从技术审查到供应条款谈判等业务活动的能力。

paras.en: - Advancing Contract and Production Discussions with European Customers
paras.zh: - 推进与欧洲客户的合同和生产讨论

paras.en: Space solar cells require close coordination on performance, dimensions, reliability, and delivery schedules, depending on each customer’s spacecraft design and operating environment. Beyond initial product introductions, discussions involve technical documentation reviews, sample evaluations, environmental test results, and design adjustments. Progressing toward volume supply also requires alignment on production schedules and quality management processes.
paras.zh: 太空太阳能电池需要在性能、尺寸、可靠性和交付时间表方面密切协调，具体取决于每个客户的航天器设计和操作环境。除了最初的产品介绍之外，讨论还涉及技术文档审查、样品评估、环境测试结果和设计调整。实现批量供应还需要调整生产计划和质量管理流程。

paras.en: Flexell Space said that as discussions with European customers move toward contracts and volume production, a local presence has become increasingly important for responding promptly to customer needs. The French entity will support these activities and serve as a link between European customers and the company’s R&D and manufacturing teams in Korea.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 表示，随着与欧洲客户的讨论转向合同和批量生产，本地业务对于迅速响应客户需求变得越来越重要。法国实体将支持这些活动，并充当欧洲客户与该公司在韩国的研发和制造团队之间的纽带。

paras.en: The company plans to deepen engagement with customers and partners across Europe, including France, Germany, Italy, and Lithuania. By gaining a closer understanding of each customer’s development schedule and technical requirements, it aims to facilitate timely decisions and follow-up actions throughout the collaboration process.
paras.zh: 该公司计划加深与欧洲各地客户和合作伙伴的接触，包括法国、德国、意大利和立陶宛。通过更深入地了解每个客户的开发进度和技术要求，旨在促进整个协作过程中的及时决策和后续行动。

paras.en: - Connecting Next-Generation Space Solar Technology with Production Readiness
paras.zh: - 将下一代太空太阳能技术与生产准备相结合

paras.en: Flexell Space develops next-generation tandem solar cells and related power solutions for space applications. Its tandem architecture combines solar cells with different characteristics to deliver the performance, low weight, and cost competitiveness required for space missions.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 为太空应用开发下一代串联太阳能电池和相关电源解决方案。其串联架构结合了具有不同特性的太阳能电池，以提供太空任务所需的性能、低重量和成本竞争力。

paras.en: The company is expanding beyond solar cell development into modules and arrays tailored to customer missions and satellite platforms. Its preparations for commercialization and volume production address not only product performance, but also reliability in the space environment, manufacturing process repeatability, quality management, and supply stability.
paras.zh: 该公司正在将太阳能电池开发扩展到为客户任务和卫星平台量身定制的模块和阵列。其商业化和批量生产的准备工作不仅涉及产品性能，还涉及太空环境的可靠性、制造过程的可重复性、质量管理和供应稳定性。

paras.en: With the establishment of its French entity, Flexell Space plans to incorporate feedback from European technical discussions into product development and supply planning more quickly. It will strengthen coordination between its Korean R&D teams and European customers by communicating required specifications and evaluation criteria, while sharing development progress and validation results.
paras.zh: 随着法国实体的成立，Flexell Space 计划更快地将欧洲技术讨论的反馈纳入产品开发和供应规划中。它将通过沟通所需的规格和评估标准，同时共享开发进度和验证结果，加强韩国研发团队和欧洲客户之间的协调。

paras.en: The company will also continue discussions on supply scope, development schedules, production volumes, and delivery timelines to translate ongoing negotiations into concrete business outcomes.
paras.zh: 该公司还将继续讨论供应范围、开发计划、产量和交付时间表，将正在进行的谈判转化为具体的业务成果。

paras.en: - Building Long-Term Partnerships Across Europe
paras.zh: - 在欧洲建立长期合作伙伴关系

paras.en: Flexell Space plans to operate its French entity as a hub for developing long-term relationships with European customers. Alongside supporting existing customer projects, it will explore new product applications and joint development opportunities with local space companies and research institutions.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 计划将其法国实体作为与欧洲客户发展长期关系的中心进行运营。除了支持现有客户项目外，还将探索新产品应用以及与当地航天公司和研究机构的联合开发机会。

paras.en: As satellite missions and platforms become more diverse, space power solutions increasingly require development and supply arrangements tailored to specific operating conditions. Flexell Space’s strategy is to maintain close contact with customers and connect their requirements with R&D and manufacturing preparations to expand its European business.
paras.zh: 随着卫星任务和平台变得更加多样化，空间电源解决方案越来越需要针对特定​​操作条件进行定制的开发和供应安排。 Flexell Space的战略是与客户保持密切联系，将他们的需求与研发和制造准备工作联系起来，以扩大其欧洲业务。

paras.en: “We are currently discussing contracts and volume supply with multiple European customers. As these discussions progress, being closer to our customers has become increasingly important in turning them into tangible results,” said Keo-san Lee, CFO of Flexell Space. “Our French entity will help accelerate technical discussions and business execution, while enabling us to respond more closely to our customers’ development and production schedules.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 首席财务官 Keo-san Lee 表示：“我们目前正在与多个欧洲客户讨论合同和批量供应。随着这些讨论的进展，为了将其转化为切实成果，与客户的距离变得越来越重要。” “我们的法国实体将有助于加快技术讨论和业务执行，同时使我们能够更密切地响应客户的开发和生产计划。”

paras.en: “In the space industry, technical capability must be accompanied by confidence in a supplier’s ability to deliver products reliably,” Lee added. “By connecting our R&D and manufacturing capabilities in Korea with local customer support in Europe, we aim to build stronger, longer-term partnerships.”
paras.zh: “在航天工业中，技术能力必须伴随着对供应商可靠交付产品能力的信心，”李补充道。 “通过将我们在韩国的研发和制造能力与欧洲当地客户支持联系起来，我们的目标是建立更强大、更长期的合作伙伴关系。”

articles.title: ESI supplying solar array components to missile defense programs
articles.author: ESI Motion

paras.en: Oct. 30, 2026 – ESI Motion Inc. is proud to announce that it is supplying the Solar Array Drive Electronics (SADE) to Lockheed Martin for its work on the Space Development Agency’s Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) programs.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 30 日 – ESI Motion Inc. 自豪地宣布，它正在向洛克希德·马丁公司提供太阳能阵列驱动电子设备 (SADE)，用于其太空发展局扩散作战空间架构 (PWSA) 项目的工作。

paras.en: Under the agreement, ESI Motion’s SADE technology will support SDA as the PWSA is developed.
paras.zh: 根据协议，随着 PWSA 的开发，ESI Motion 的 SADE 技术将支持 SDA。

paras.en: Defending our nation in space is more important than ever. The Space Development Agency’s PWSA programs provide the military with a network of satellites with secure communication, missile tracking and space-based support to make sure our troops have the latest and greatest technology.
paras.zh: 在太空中保卫我们的国家比以往任何时候都更加重要。太空发展局的 PWSA 计划为军队提供了一个卫星网络，提供安全通信、导弹跟踪和天基支持，以确保我们的部队拥有最新、最先进的技术。

paras.en: The SADE consists of our Space-rated, flight heritage, SuperNova and Pulsar motor controllers. These motion controllers ensure all mission parameters are fulfilled, with high-reliable technology.
paras.zh: SADE 由我们的太空级、飞行传统、SuperNova 和 Pulsar 电机控制器组成。这些运动控制器采用高可靠性技术，确保满足所有任务参数。

paras.en: ESI Motion Inc., U.S. Company, is a trusted supplier and partner, supporting mission operations for space, military and industrial customers around the world for over 20 years. Please visit our website; www.esimotion.com
paras.zh: ESI Motion Inc.，美国公司，是值得信赖的供应商和合作伙伴，20 多年来为世界各地的太空、军事和工业客户的任务运营提供支持。请访问我们的网站； www.esimotion.com

articles.title: Halloween Aboard the International Space Station
articles.author: Sumer Loggins

paras.en: Although no ghouls, goblins, or trick-or-treaters come knocking at the International Space Station’s front hatch, crew members aboard the orbiting laboratory still like to get in the Halloween spirit. Whether individually or as an entire crew, they dress up in sometimes spooky, sometimes scary, but always creative costumes, often designed from materials available aboard the space station.
paras.zh: 尽管没有食尸鬼、妖精或“不给糖就捣蛋”的人来敲击国际空间站的前舱门，但轨道实验室上的工作人员仍然喜欢融入万圣节气氛。无论是个人还是整个团队，他们都穿着有时怪异、有时可怕但总是富有创意的服装，通常是用空间站上可用的材料设计的。

paras.en: Take a look at how the station crews have celebrated in years past.
paras.zh: 看看过去几年车站工作人员是如何庆祝的。

paras.en: Follow the astronauts aboard the space station to see how they celebrate holidays in space.
paras.zh: 跟随空间站上的宇航员，看看他们如何在太空庆祝节日。

paras.en: The space station remains a vital scientific platform, providing the foundation needed to survive and thrive as humanity ventures into the unexplored territories of our universe.
paras.zh: 空间站仍然是一个重要的科学平台，为人类冒险进入宇宙未探索的领域提供生存和繁荣所需的基础。

paras.en: Explore stories, images, and research from more than 25 years of continuous human presence aboard the space station.
paras.zh: 探索人类在空间站上持续存在超过 25 年的故事、图像和研究。

articles.title: NASA Releases MAX POWER Key Events for Media, Participants
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: America’s newest aerospace expo and air show – MAX POWER – is fast approaching, and NASA has announced key events beginning Friday, Nov. 6, and running through Sunday, Nov. 8, hosted on and near the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: 美国最新的航空航天博览会和航空展——MAX POWER——即将到来，NASA 宣布将于 11 月 6 日星期五开始，一直持续到 11 月 8 日星期日，在该机构位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心及其附近举办重要活动。

paras.en: Through multiple park experiences at MAX POWER, NASA and a variety of external collaborators will showcase the newest aircraft, autonomous vehicles, technologies, and more defining the future of air and space. NASA will display its quiet supersonic X-59 plane, and agency partners will showcase Moon rovers, spacecraft, and more. The expo also is a culmination of the agency’s recent Inspiration Tour, which included numerous flyovers to highlight NASA’s fleet of aircraft.
paras.zh: 通过 MAX POWER 的多个公园体验，NASA 和各种外部合作者将展示最新的飞机、自动驾驶车辆、技术以及更多定义空气和太空未来的内容。 NASA 将展示其安静的超音速 X-59 飞机，机构合作伙伴将展示月球车、航天器等。此次博览会也是该机构最近的灵感之旅的高潮，其中包括多次飞越以突出美国宇航局的飞机机队。

paras.en: A current schedule of events is available on the agency’s website.
paras.zh: 该机构的网站上提供了当前的活动时间表。

paras.en: MAX POWER includes opportunities to meet leadership, astronauts, engineers, scientists, and other subject matter experts during the family-friendly public events with gates opening at 9 a.m. EST on Nov. 7 and Nov. 8.
paras.zh: MAX POWER 提供在适合家庭的公共活动期间与领导层、宇航员、工程师、科学家和其他主题专家会面的机会，活动将于美国东部时间 11 月 7 日和 11 月 8 日上午 9 点开放。

paras.en: NASA also will share multiple news updates during the weekend, including hosting a news conference at 5 p.m. on Nov. 7, to provide its latest Moon Base update. Located near the lunar South Pole, the Moon Base is humanity’s first outpost for long-term lunar exploration.
paras.zh: NASA 还将在周末分享多项新闻更新，包括在下午 5 点举办新闻发布会。 11 月 7 日，提供最新的月球基地更新。月球基地位于月球南极附近，是人类第一个长期月球探索的前哨基地。

paras.en: Live coverage of the news conference will stream on a variety of platforms online. Learn where to watch:
paras.zh: 新闻发布会将在多个网络平台进行现场直播。了解在哪里观看：

paras.en: Media credentialing for this event is closed. Media approved for this event must request interviews in advance. Space in the news conference is limited, and first come, first served. Media also may participate in the news conference virtually. To request call details or an interview, please contact Lauren Low in the NASA Headquarters newsroom at: lauren.e.low@nasa.gov.

articles.title: Afghanistan opium production jumps fivefold as farmers find ways round Taliban ban

paras.en: Afghanistan opium production jumps fivefold as farmers find ways round Taliban ban
paras.zh: 农民想方设法绕过塔利班禁令，阿富汗鸦片产量猛增五倍

paras.en: The UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) found that the area planted with opium poppy grew by 330 per cent, to more than 43,000 hectares, up from about 10,000 hectares in 2025.
paras.zh: 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 (UNODC) 发现，罂粟种植面积从 2025 年的约 10,000 公顷增长了 330%，达到 43,000 多公顷。

paras.en: Estimated production rose by 400 per cent, from about 300 tonnes to just under 1,500 tonnes.
paras.zh: 预计产量增加 400%，从约 300 吨增至近 1,500 吨。

paras.en: Both figures remain well below levels before the ban, when some 232,000 hectares were under cultivation.
paras.zh: 这两个数字仍远低于禁令实施前的水平，当时的种植面积约为 232,000 公顷。

paras.en: For decades, Afghanistan was the world’s biggest source of illicit opium. Before the ban, it accounted for around 80 per cent of global supply.
paras.zh: 几十年来，阿富汗一直是世界上最大的非法鸦片来源地。在禁令实施之前，它占全球供应量的 80% 左右。

paras.en: The Taliban seized power in August 2021. In April 2022, they outlawed poppy cultivation and all narcotics, citing religious grounds.
paras.zh: 塔利班于 2021 年 8 月掌权。2022 年 4 月，他们以宗教为由，宣布罂粟种植和所有毒品为非法。

paras.en: The de facto authorities say they eradicated 22,000 hectares of poppy this year. But UNODC said many farmers appear to have adapted to evade enforcement. Some are hiding small plots within cereal fields or inside walled compounds. Others are planting and harvesting at staggered intervals to avoid detection.
paras.zh: 事实当局称，今年他们铲除了 22,000 公顷罂粟。但毒品和犯罪问题办公室表示，许多农民似乎已经适应逃避执法。有些人将小块土地隐藏在麦田内或围墙内。其他人则错开种植和收获的时间，以避免被发现。

paras.en: “The fourfold increase in opium poppy cultivation shows the difficulty in sustaining decreases in illicit opium cultivation when poor farmers have no alternatives to feed their families,” said UNODC Executive Director Monica Juma.
paras.zh: 毒品和犯罪问题办公室执行主任莫妮卡·朱马表示：“罂粟种植面积增加了四倍，这表明当贫困农民没有其他办法养活家人时，维持非法鸦片种植的减少是很困难的。”

paras.en: She urged the de facto authorities and the international community to work together to support farming communities, by investing in livelihoods, farm infrastructure and access to markets.
paras.zh: 她敦促事实上的当局和国际社会共同努力，通过投资于生计、农业基础设施和市场准入来支持农业社区。

paras.en: Cultivation spread to 16 of Afghanistan’s 34 provinces, five more than last year. Three in every four hectares were in the northeast, now firmly the country’s main growing area. Before the ban, most poppy was grown in the southwest.
paras.zh: 阿富汗 34 个省份中有 16 个省份进行了种植，比去年增加了 5 个省份。每四公顷中有三公顷位于东北部，现在是该国的主要种植区。在禁令实施之前，大多数罂粟种植在西南部。

paras.en: Prices dipped from $570 a kilogramme last year to $500 but remain far above pre-ban levels of under $100. UNODC said large regional price differences may encourage trafficking from the northeast to the southwest.
paras.zh: 价格从去年的每公斤 570 美元跌至 500 美元，但仍远高于禁令前 100 美元以下的水平。毒品和犯罪问题办公室表示，巨大的地区价格差异可能会鼓励从东北部向西南方向的贩运。

paras.en: The survey said traffickers in the region appear to have relied on opium stockpiles to keep supplies moving since the ban.
paras.zh: 调查称，自禁令实施以来，该地区的贩运者似乎一直依靠鸦片库存来维持供应。

paras.en: But recent seizure data suggest those stocks are running down. The 2026 World Drug Report also found early signs that heroin supplies in Europe are falling.
paras.zh: 但最近的缉获数据表明这些库存正在减少。 《2026 年世界毒品报告》还发现了欧洲海洛因供应量正在下降的早期迹象。

paras.en: With demand holding up and prices high, shrinking supplies could push cultivation in Afghanistan higher still.
paras.zh: 由于需求坚挺且价格高企，供应减少可能会进一步推高阿富汗的种植面积。

paras.en: “International cooperation is needed to investigate and dismantle transnational drug trafficking networks both in Afghanistan and the rest of the world,” Ms. Juma said.
paras.zh: “需要国际合作来调查和摧毁阿富汗和世界其他地区的跨国贩毒网络，”朱马女士说。

paras.en: UNODC said continued monitoring would show whether this year’s jump is temporary or the start of a resurgence in opium and heroin production.
paras.zh: 毒品和犯罪问题办公室表示，持续监测将表明今年鸦片和海洛因生产的增长是暂时的还是开始复苏。

articles.title: Ukraine: Oleshky ceasefire offers ‘hope’ for civilians as attacks on aid vehicles continue

paras.en: Ukraine: Oleshky ceasefire offers ‘hope’ for civilians as attacks on aid vehicles continue
paras.zh: 乌克兰：奥列什基停火为平民带来“希望”，救援车辆袭击仍在继续

paras.en: Each day the ceasefire in Oleshky holds means hope for civilians in the city, the UN’s top humanitarian official said, stressing that those wishing to leave must be able to do so safely and voluntarily.
paras.zh: 联合国高级人道主义官员表示，奥列什基停火的每一天都意味着该市平民的希望，并强调那些希望离开的人必须能够安全、自愿地离开。

paras.en: “Let this pave the way for vital aid to get in, and more humanitarian access on both sides of the frontline,” Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher said in a social media post, also relayed by the Secretary-General’s Spokesperson on Friday.
paras.zh: 紧急救济协调员汤姆·弗莱彻在社交媒体上发帖表示：“这将为重要援助的进入以及前线两侧的更多人道主义准入铺平道路。”秘书长发言人周五也转发了该帖子。

paras.en: The ceasefire aimed at relieving the humanitarian emergency faced by trapped residents on the Russian-controlled left bank of the Dnipro, was brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump and announced by the White House on 23 October. It is due to end on the evening of 1 November.
paras.zh: 这项停火旨在缓解俄罗斯控制的第聂伯河左岸被困居民面临的人道主义紧急情况，由美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋，并于 10 月 23 日由白宫宣布。该活动将于 11 月 1 日晚结束。

paras.en: Asked whether the UN had played any role in the evacuation of hundreds of people from Oleshky – close to the city of Kherson – spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said it had not, but that it was providing humanitarian aid to evacuees on the receiving end, as they reach the Ukrainian side of the frontline.
paras.zh: 当被问及联合国是否在从靠近赫尔松市的奥列什基疏散数百人的过程中发挥了任何作用时，发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克表示，并没有发挥任何作用，但在撤离人员到达乌克兰前线一侧时，联合国正在向他们提供人道主义援助。

paras.en: Meanwhile, two humanitarian vehicles came under drone attack on Thursday, according to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA).
paras.zh: 与此同时，据联合国人道主义事务协调办公室（OCHA）称，周四，两辆人道主义车辆遭到无人机袭击。

paras.en: In the Zaporizhzhia region, a clearly marked civilian bus was struck, killing a woman and injuring passengers and the driver.
paras.zh: 在扎波罗热地区，一辆标记明显的民用巴士被撞，导致一名妇女死亡，乘客和司机受伤。

paras.en: The service, supported by the OCHA-managed Ukraine Humanitarian Fund, provides essential transport for a community of more than 1,600 people. In Sloviansk, in the Donetsk region, an armoured evacuation vehicle was hit, injuring two evacuees.
paras.zh: 这项服务由 OCHA 管理的乌克兰人道主义基金提供支持，为 1,600 多人的社区提供必要的交通服务。在顿涅茨克地区的斯洛维安斯克，一辆装甲疏散车被击中，造成两名疏散人员受伤。

paras.en: “Attacks against civilians, attacks against civilian infrastructure and attacks targeting humanitarians are unacceptable and must stop,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 发言人表示：“针对平民的袭击、针对民用基础设施的袭击以及针对人道主义人员的袭击是不可接受的，必须停止。”

paras.en: Aid organizations are also responding to the latest wave of deadly attacks in the Chernihiv, Kharkiv and Poltava regions, providing hot meals, cash assistance, legal aid, emergency shelter materials and temporary repairs to damaged homes.
paras.zh: 援助组织还在应对切尔尼戈夫、哈尔科夫和波尔塔瓦地区最新一波致命袭击，提供热餐、现金援助、法律援助、紧急避难所材料以及对受损房屋的临时修复。

paras.en: According to Ukrainian authorities, strikes in Chernihiv region killed two children and injured 37 people over the past day, while in Kremenchuk, in Poltava region, three people were killed and 28 injured.
paras.zh: 据乌克兰当局称，过去一天，切尔尼戈夫地区的罢工导致两名儿童死亡、37人受伤，而波尔塔瓦地区克列缅丘克的罢工则造成3人死亡、28人受伤。

paras.en: Attacks on energy infrastructure have also caused further power outages, with 190,000 consumers in Dnipro region still without electricity on Friday morning, OCHA said, calling for the protection of civilians and critical infrastructure as colder weather sets in.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅表示，对能源基础设施的袭击还导致进一步停电，周五早上第聂伯罗地区仍有 19 万消费者断电，并呼吁在天气转冷时保护平民和关键基础设施。

paras.en: Responding to a question about Thursday’s deadly drone attack on the main railway station in Dnipro, Spokesperson Dujarric said the Secretary-General strongly condemns the Russian strike, in which civilians, including children, were killed.
paras.zh: 在回答有关周四第聂伯罗主要火车站发生致命无人机袭击的问题时，发言人杜雅里克表示，秘书长强烈谴责俄罗斯的袭击，此次袭击造成包括儿童在内的平民死亡。

paras.en: The death toll now stands at 15, according to media reports.
paras.zh: 据媒体报道，目前死亡人数为 15 人。

paras.en: “This is not an isolated case,” added Mr. Dujarric noting that it came on the heels of Russian attacks on cities including Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa and Zaporizhzhia. “All of these attacks are violations of international humanitarian law, and they must stop.”
paras.zh: 杜雅里克补充说：“这不是一个孤立的案例。”他指出，这是在俄罗斯袭击基辅、哈尔科夫、敖德萨和扎波罗热等城市之后发生的。 “所有这些袭击都违反了国际人道主义法，必须停止。”

articles.title: World News in Brief: 300,000 displaced in Lebanon, Türk ‘deeply concerned’ over Novaya Gazeta closure, $50 million refugee appeal, World Cities Day

paras.en: World News in Brief: 300,000 displaced in Lebanon, Türk ‘deeply concerned’ over Novaya Gazeta closure, $50 million refugee appeal, World Cities Day
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：黎巴嫩 30 万流离失所者、土耳其“深切关注”《新报》关闭、5000 万美元难民呼吁、世界城市日

paras.en: Despite civilians’ willingness to return home, continued Israeli military activity and presence in the south are making it very difficult, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told journalists on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克周五对记者表示，尽管平民愿意返回家园，但以色列持续的军事活动和在南部的存在使返回家园变得非常困难。

paras.en: This week alone, further demolitions, fires and strikes by Israeli forces were reported across Southern Lebanon, both within the so-called combat zone declared by Israel – from which residents were ordered to evacuate – and beyond it.
paras.zh: 仅本周，据报道，以色列军队在黎巴嫩南部各地进行了进一步的拆除、纵火和袭击，这些事件都发生在以色列宣布的所谓战区（居民被命令撤离）及其以外。

paras.en: Although close to 970,000 people have returned to their communities in the south, their situation is often dire: homes have been damaged, while essential services are disrupted and making a living has become ever more challenging.
paras.zh: 尽管近 97 万人已返回南部社区，但他们的处境往往很严峻：家园遭到破坏，基本服务中断，谋生变得更加困难。

paras.en: In Nabatieh Governorate, for example, insecurity and restrictions on access to agricultural land are disrupting the olive harvest there.
paras.zh: 例如，在纳巴提耶省，不安全局势和对农业用地的限制正在扰乱那里的橄榄收成。

paras.en: In some villages, farmers have been able to harvest for only two days before being forced by the Israeli army to stop doing so.
paras.zh: 在一些村庄，农民只能收获两天，就被以色列军队强迫停止这样做。

paras.en: As part of the humanitarian response, OCHA’s Lebanon Humanitarian Fund has allocated $91 million to support displaced people, returnees, refugees and other communities affected by this year's escalation.
paras.zh: 作为人道主义应对措施的一部分，人道协调厅的黎巴嫩人道主义基金已拨款 9100 万美元，以支持流离失所者、回返者、难民和其他受今年冲突升级影响的社区。

paras.en: Russia: Türk ‘deeply concerned’ by forced closure of Novaya Gazeta
paras.zh: 俄罗斯：土耳其对《新报》被迫关闭表示“深切关注”

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk said on Friday he was deeply concerned and saddened by the announcement that Novaya Gazeta, a “highly respected” independent Russian newspaper, is being forced to close.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周五表示，他对“备受尊敬的”俄罗斯独立报纸《新报》被迫关闭的消息深感担忧和悲伤。

paras.en: He called it “yet another devastating blow for remaining independent media in the Russian Federation”.
paras.zh: 他称其为“对俄罗斯联邦剩余独立媒体的又一次毁灭性打击”。

paras.en: Independent journalism in Russia has faced mounting restrictions for many years, Mr. Türk said, but the pressure has intensified significantly since the country’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 图尔克表示，俄罗斯的独立新闻业多年来一直面临着越来越多的限制，但自该国全面入侵乌克兰以来，压力已大大加剧。

paras.en: That has come through increasingly restrictive legislation, tighter State controls and the harassment and persecution of journalists.
paras.zh: 这是通过日益严格的立法、更严格的国家控制以及对记者的骚扰和迫害实现的。

paras.en: Novaya Gazeta’s journalists have made an exceptional contribution to independent reporting and the defence of human rights, often at great personal risk, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，《新报》的记者常常冒着巨大的个人风险，为独立报道和捍卫人权做出了杰出贡献。

paras.en: They have faced harassment, lawsuits, threats and direct violence.
paras.zh: 他们面临骚扰、诉讼、威胁和直接暴力。

paras.en: “Among them was Anna Politkovskaya, who was murdered in 2006 following her reporting on human rights violations during Russia’s military operations in Chechnya,” said the High Commissioner.
paras.zh: “其中包括安娜·波利特科夫斯卡娅 (Anna Politkovskaya)，她在报道俄罗斯在车臣军事行动期间侵犯人权行为后于 2006 年被谋杀，”高级专员表示。

paras.en: He called on Russian authorities to stop measures that stifle reporting on issues of legitimate public concern, and to allow full and free debate with a diversity of voices.
paras.zh: 他呼吁俄罗斯当局停止压制对公众合法关心的问题进行报道的措施，并允许不同声音进行充分和自由的辩论。

paras.en: $50 million appeal to help 9 million survive winter
paras.zh: 呼吁筹集 5000 万美元帮助 900 万人度过冬天

paras.en: The UN's refugee agency, UNHCR, launched a $50 million appeal on Friday to help nine million people survive winter across Afghanistan, Ukraine, Syria and Lebanon.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署联合国难民署周五发起了一项 5000 万美元的呼吁，以帮助阿富汗、乌克兰、叙利亚和黎巴嫩的 900 万人度过冬天。

paras.en: The funding will help people like Svetlana in Dnipro, Ukraine, whose apartment was targeted and heavily damaged in a drone strike last winter.
paras.zh: 这笔资金将帮助像乌克兰第聂伯罗的斯韦特兰娜这样的人，她的公寓在去年冬天的一次无人机袭击中成为目标并严重受损。

paras.en: Moments before the attack, Svetlana grabbed her son and ran to the basement. When they emerged, they no longer had anywhere to live.
paras.zh: 袭击发生前不久，斯维特兰娜抓住她的儿子跑到地下室。当他们出来时，他们已经无处可住。

paras.en: “A donation means something very tangible. A heater, blankets, warm clothes, cash to pay for fuel, or tarpaulin and tape to repair a blown out window. For some, it may avoid taking on more debt or keep their children off the streets and safe in school,” said UNHCR’s Dominique Hyde.
paras.zh: “捐款意味着一些非常有形的东西。取暖器、毯子、保暖的衣服、支付燃料的现金，或者修复被炸毁的窗户的防水布和胶带。对于一些人来说，这可能会避免承担更多债务，或者让他们的孩子远离街头并在学校安全，”联合国难民署的多米尼克·海德说。

paras.en: The agency highlighted equally dramatic needs in Afghanistan, which has seen an estimated 6.5 million people returning in recent years, most of them involuntarily.
paras.zh: 该机构强调了阿富汗同样巨大的需求，近年来估计有 650 万人返回阿富汗，其中大多数是非自愿的。

paras.en: Many of the new arrivals have very little and need to build their lives from scratch, Ms. Hyde said.
paras.zh: 海德女士说，许多新来者几乎一无所有，需要从头开始建立自己的生活。

paras.en: She noted that in Syria, around 3.6 million refugees and internally displaced people have returned to what remains of their homes since December 2024, while 15.6 million inside the country need humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 她指出，自 2024 年 12 月以来，叙利亚约有 360 万难民和境内流离失所者已返回家园，而该国境内有 1560 万人需要人道主义援助。

paras.en: Urban regeneration key to tackling global housing crisis
paras.zh: 城市复兴是应对全球住房危机的关键

paras.en: Government leaders and urban stakeholders gathered in China’s Fuzhou on Friday to discuss the “immense” global housing crisis, in the words of the UN’s urban development agency UN-Habitat – spotlighting regeneration as a key solution.
paras.zh: 用联合国城市发展机构联合国人居署的话说，政府领导人和城市利益相关者周五齐聚中国福州，讨论“严重”的全球住房危机，强调重建是一个关键的解决方案。

paras.en: As the world marks World Cities Day, up to 3.4 billion people face inadequate housing conditions, including more than a billion living in informal settlements and slums.
paras.zh: 值此世界城市日之际，多达 34 亿人面临住房条件不足的问题，其中超过 10 亿人生活在非正规住区和贫民窟。

paras.en: At the same time, ageing infrastructure, soaring housing costs and worsening climate change are placing further strain on cities and their residents.
paras.zh: 与此同时，老化的基础设施、飙升的住房成本和日益恶化的气候变化给城市及其居民带来了进一步的压力。

paras.en: Urban regeneration aims to revitalise declining or neglected urban areas through economic, social and environmental improvements
paras.zh: 城市复兴旨在通过经济、社会和环境的改善来振兴衰落或被忽视的城市地区

paras.en: “[It] offers a path forward. By revitalizing existing urban areas, we can create more housing, upgrade infrastructure and improve public spaces, making cities more resilient, inclusive and connected,” said the UN Secretary General in his message for the day.
paras.zh: “[它]提供了一条前进的道路。通过振兴现有城市地区，我们可以建造更多住房、升级基础设施和改善公共空间，使城市更具弹性、包容性和联系性，”联合国秘书长在当天的致辞中表示。

articles.title: Leclerc seals Mexico City practice double as Hamilton suffers technical issue

paras.en: Mexico City GP: Charles Leclerc completes Friday practice double as Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton suffers technical failure
paras.zh: 墨西哥城大奖赛：查尔斯·勒克莱尔完成周五练习双打，法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿遭遇技术故障

paras.en: Charles Leclerc tops both Friday practice sessions for Ferrari; Lewis Hamilton suffers technical failure; Max Verstappen collides with Liam Lawson; watch every Mexico City GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 9pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
paras.zh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔 (Charles Leclerc) 在周五的法拉利练习赛中均名列前茅；刘易斯·汉密尔顿遭遇技术故障；马克斯·维斯塔潘与利亚姆·劳森相撞；观看天空体育 F1 直播的每场墨西哥城大奖赛，周六晚上 9 点排位赛，周日晚上 8 点正赛

paras.en: Charles Leclerc completed a Friday practice double at the Mexico City Grand Prix but Ferrari's strong showing was dampened by Lewis Hamilton suffering a technical issue.
paras.zh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔在墨西哥城大奖赛上完成了周五的练习双打，但法拉利的强劲表现因刘易斯·汉密尔顿遭遇技术问题而受到削弱。

paras.en: Leclerc produced a time of 1:17.827s to finish just over a tenth clear of McLaren's Lando Norris and Mercedes' George Russell, with the British pair among 10 drivers who had earlier sat out the opening session to make way for rookie drivers.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔以 1:17.827 秒的成绩完成比赛，仅比迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯和梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔领先十分之一多一点，这对英国车手是早些时候缺席首场比赛为新秀车手让路的 10 名车手之一。

paras.en: Kimi Antonelli, who only needs to finish ninth in Sunday's race to become Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion, was a tenth down on his team-mate Russell in fourth.
paras.zh: 基米·安东内利只需在周日的比赛中获得第九名即可成为一级方程式历史上最年轻的世界冠军，他落后第四名的队友拉塞尔第十名。

paras.en: - How Antonelli can win world title at Mexico City GP on Sunday
paras.zh: - 安东内利如何在周日的墨西哥城大奖赛上赢得世界冠军

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Hamilton had been on course to go fastest as the session approached its midway point before suffering what appeared to be an engine issue in the final sector of his push lap, leaving him 11th.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在赛段接近中段时原本打算跑得最快，但在推圈的最后一个赛段却遭遇了发动机问题，最终排名第 11。

paras.en: He completed the lap but was then swiftly told by his engineer to pull over on track, ending his session early and denying him valuable information that his rivals were able to gather with their race simulations.
paras.zh: 他完成了这一圈，但随后工程师迅速告诉他在赛道上靠边停车，提前结束了他的训练，并剥夺了他的竞争对手能够通过比赛模拟收集到的宝贵信息。

paras.en: Max Verstappen, another to have sat out first practice, was three tenths off the pace in fifth, with his team-mate Isack Hadjar slotting in behind him.
paras.zh: 另一位缺席第一次练习赛的马克斯·维斯塔潘（Max Verstappen）在第五名时落后了十分之三，他的队友伊萨克·哈贾尔（Isack Hadjar）紧随其后。

paras.en: Verstappen was involved in a bizarre collision with his former team-mate Liam Lawson in the early stages of the session as the four-time world champion attempted to overtake the Racing Bulls driver, and both drivers received a one-grid place penalty for the incident.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在比赛的早期阶段与他的前队友利亚姆·劳森发生了奇怪的碰撞，当时四届世界冠军试图超越这位公牛队车手，两名车手都因此事件而受到一发车位的处罚。

paras.en: Lawson defended and retained track position, only for the battle to continue on for several more corners before the pair made contact, leaving debris on the track that caused a red flag to be thrown so it could be cleared.
paras.zh: 劳森捍卫并保持了赛道位置，但在两人发生接触之前，战斗继续进行了几个弯道，在赛道上留下了碎片，导致抛出红旗，以便可以清除。

paras.en: The stewards said both drivers "behaved in a manner that was considered unacceptable" and that a warning had been given at the team managers meeting earlier on Friday about overtaking in the final sector, which led to their decision to give Verstappen and Lawson a grid penalty for Sunday's race.
paras.zh: 赛会干事表示，两名车手的“行为方式被认为是不可接受的”，并且在周五早些时候的车队经理会议上就最后一个赛段的超车发出了警告，这导致他们决定在周日的比赛中对维斯塔潘和劳森进行发车处罚。

paras.en: Lawson was ninth in second practice, two places behind his team-mate Arvid Linbdlad with Alpine's Pierre Gasly splitting the Racing Bulls.
paras.zh: 劳森在第二次练习赛中排名第九，落后他的队友阿维德·林德拉德两位，阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利则平分了公牛队。

paras.en: Oscar Piastri endured another disappointing day as he could only manage 10th, finishing more than half a second down on his McLaren team-mate Norris.
paras.zh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里 (Oscar Piastri) 又经历了令人失望的一天，他仅获得第十名，落后迈凯伦队友诺里斯半秒多。

paras.en: Fernando Alonso produced an encouraging result for Aston Martin as he finished within eight tenths of Leclerc in 12th.
paras.zh: 费尔南多·阿隆索为阿斯顿·马丁取得了令人鼓舞的成绩，他以第十二名的成绩落后勒克莱尔十分之八。

paras.en: "Overall, our performance looks quite alright but we still need to work on some of our limiting factors. It was quite tricky on track today, as the surface was slippery, so we will work on that to find some improvements for tomorrow," said Leclerc.
paras.zh: “总的来说，我们的表现看起来相当不错，但我们仍然需要解决一些限制因素。今天的赛道非常棘手，因为路面很滑，所以我们将努力为明天找到一些改进，”勒克莱尔说。

paras.en: Antonelli had a low-key day considering he's expected to become world champion on Sunday as he never threatened to challenge Leclerc's pace.
paras.zh: 安东内利度过了低调的一天，考虑到他有望在周日成为世界冠军，因为他从未威胁要挑战勒克莱尔的速度。

paras.en: "There are definitely more things we can improve going into tomorrow and we have some work to do overnight," said Antonelli, who won last time out in Austin.
paras.zh: “明天我们肯定还有更多的事情可以改进，我们还有一些工作要做，”上次在奥斯汀获胜的安东内利说。

paras.en: "Ferrari looked very quick, but we will focus on ourselves, see where we can find more performance and hopefully put ourselves in a good position for tomorrow."
paras.zh: “法拉利看起来速度很快，但我们将专注于自己，看看我们可以在哪里找到更多表现，并希望为明天做好准备。”

paras.en: Should Antonelli fail to score points on Sunday, he can still become world champion if Hamilton or Russell fail to win the race.
paras.zh: 如果周日安东内利未能得分，如果汉密尔顿或拉塞尔未能赢得比赛，他仍然可以成为世界冠军。

paras.en: Hamilton was off the pace throughout Friday compared to team-mate Leclerc but said he was "feeling really good in the car" before his technical issue.
paras.zh: 与队友勒克莱尔相比，汉密尔顿整个周五的速度都落后了，但他表示，在出现技术问题之前，他“在赛车中感觉非常好”。

paras.en: "I think we did a really good job in getting the setup in a better place and just really unfortunate. I think we are really competitive this weekend as a team.
paras.zh: “我认为我们在把比赛安排到一个更好的位置方面做得非常好，但非常不幸。我认为我们作为一个团队这个周末真的很有竞争力。

paras.en: "I don't think I need to make many changes to the setup. I will probably leave it pretty much the same because we were very quick.
paras.zh: “我认为我不需要对设置进行太多改变。我可能会保持不变，因为我们速度非常快。

paras.en: "I already had a loss of power earlier in the lap and we were still quick. I will give it everything tomorrow and try to do the best with whatever I have."
paras.zh: “我在这一圈的早些时候就已经失去了动力，但我们仍然很快。明天我会全力以赴，尽我所能做到最好。”

articles.title: Moloney-MacDonald stars as Red Roses return to winning ways with USA thrashing

paras.en: USA 12-55 England: Red Roses return to winning ways as Claudia Moloney-MacDonald scores four tries in WXV Global Series
paras.zh: 美国 12-55 英格兰：克劳迪娅·莫洛尼·麦克唐纳 (Claudia Moloney-MacDonald) 在 WXV 全球系列赛中四次尝试中得分，红玫瑰重返胜利之路

paras.en: England's Red Roses score nine tries through Claudia Moloney-MacDonald (four), Meg Jones, Mia Venner, Bryony Field, Maddie Feaunati, Sadia Kabeya in WXV Global Series thrashing of USA in New Jersey; win sees Red Roses respond following shock back-to-back losses in Canada
paras.zh: 英格兰红玫瑰队在新泽西州举行的 WXV 全球系列赛中，通过克劳迪娅·莫洛尼-麦克唐纳 (Claudia Moloney-MacDonald)（四次）、梅格·琼斯 (Meg Jones)、米娅·文纳 (Mia Venner)、布赖尼·菲尔德 (Bryony Field)、麦迪·费奥纳蒂 (Maddie Feaunati) 和萨迪亚·卡贝亚 (Sadia Kabeya) 九次尝试得分，击败了美国队；红玫瑰队在加拿大遭遇连败后做出了回应

paras.en: England's Red Roses responded to shock back-to-back defeats in Canada with a crushing 55-12 WXV Global Series victory over the USA in New Jersey, returning to winning ways.
paras.zh: 英格兰红玫瑰队在加拿大的WXV全球系列赛中以55-12大胜美国队，以55比12大胜美国队，重回胜利之路。

paras.en: John Mitchell's side entered the contest off the back of losing two Tests in a row for the first time in a decade, and having lost their 41-Test, four-year unbeaten run in Toronto.
paras.zh: 约翰·米切尔 (John Mitchell) 的球队在十年来首次连续输掉两次测试赛后进入了这场比赛，并且在多伦多的 41 场测试赛中连续四年不败。

paras.en: A competitive first half against the USA saw 10 points in it at half-time, but the second half proved largely one-way traffic as England's superiority showed.
paras.zh: 对阵美国队的上半场比赛，半场结束时就已经拿到了10分，但下半场却证明了英格兰队的优势主要是单向的。

paras.en: In all, the Red Roses scored nine tries through wing Claudia Moloney-MacDonald (four), centre Meg Jones, wing Mia Venner, replacement hooker Bryony Field and back-rows Maddie Feaunati and Sadia Kabeya.
paras.zh: 红玫瑰队通过侧翼克劳迪娅·莫洛尼-麦克唐纳（四次）、中锋梅格·琼斯、侧翼米娅·文纳、替补胡克·布赖尼·菲尔德以及后排麦迪·费奥纳蒂和萨迪娅·卡贝亚总共获得九次尝试。

paras.en: The USA scored two tries through loosehead prop Hope Rogers and replacement back Kate Zackary, but shipped three second-half tries in nine minutes with prop Mona Tupou in the sin-bin due to repeat scrum penalties.
paras.zh: 美国队通过松散的投手霍普·罗杰斯和替补后卫凯特·扎卡里两次尝试得分，但在下半场九分钟内完成了三次尝试，由于重复的争球处罚，投手莫娜·图普在罪箱中。

paras.en: Jones: We'll review this tour - we're hungry to get better
paras.zh: 琼斯：我们会回顾这次巡演 - 我们渴望变得更好

paras.en: Red Roses captain Meg Jones said post-match:
paras.zh: 红玫瑰队队长梅格·琼斯赛后表示：

paras.en: "First of all, credit to the USA, I think they've come off the back of some amazing wins and gained so much momentum. They are doing such a good effort there, building and growing the game.
paras.zh: “首先，要归功于美国队，我认为他们已经取得了一些惊人的胜利，并获得了如此大的动力。他们在那里做出了很大的努力，建立和发展了这项运动。

paras.en: "For us, we just wanted to control the game and impose ourselves on them.
paras.zh: “对我们来说，我们只是想控制比赛并将自己强加给他们。

paras.en: "When we got into it, we kept the ball and everyone was a threat at the line. That's when we were unstoppable.
paras.zh: “当我们进入比赛时，我们控球，每个人都对罚球线构成威胁。那时我们势不可挡。

paras.en: "Off the back of two losses, we just wanted to learn, and we'll continue to learn. We've got so much feedback from this tour.
paras.zh: “在经历了两场失利后，我们只是想学习，我们将继续学习。我们从这次巡演中得到了很多反馈。

paras.en: "We'll go and review it, reflect, and see where we can keep growing. Because I know there is so much growth in this team.
paras.zh: “我们会去回顾、反思，看看我们可以在哪里继续成长。因为我知道这个团队有很大的成长。

paras.en: Moloney-MacDonald: Tonight was about proving it to ourselves
paras.zh: 莫洛尼-麦克唐纳：今晚是为了向我们自己证明这一点

paras.en: Player-of-the-match Moloney-MacDonald said:
paras.zh: 本场最佳球员莫洛尼-麦克唐纳说道：

paras.en: "This week was all about proving it to ourselves.
paras.zh: “本周的目的就是向我们自己证明这一点。

paras.en: "We've obviously had three really tough games against Canada, and the last two weeks did not go the way we wanted it to go.
paras.zh: “我们显然已经与加拿大队进行了三场非常艰难的比赛，过去两周并没有按照我们希望的方式进行。

paras.en: "For us, it was about learning as much as we possibly could from those two performances. A challenge we've never really been faced with previously.
paras.zh: “对我们来说，这是从这两场表演中尽可能多地学习。这是我们以前从未真正面临过的挑战。

paras.en: "We spoke a lot about going out there and being fearless tonight. That's exactly what we did. We attacked it from minute zero to minute 80.
paras.zh: “我们谈论了很多关于今晚要无所畏惧的事情。这正是我们所做的。我们从零分钟到第 80 分钟一直在进攻。

paras.en: "I'm just so proud of the girls, the way we turned up today.
paras.zh: “我为今天的女孩们感到骄傲。

paras.en: "That's what the Red Roses is all about."
paras.zh: “这就是红玫瑰的意义所在。”

paras.en: Perris-Redding: We were in the game in first half - result does not take away our growth
paras.zh: 佩里斯-雷丁：我们上半场就在比赛中——结果并没有带走我们的成长

paras.en: USA co-captain Georgie Perris-Redding said:
paras.zh: 美国队联队长乔吉·佩里斯-雷丁说道：

paras.en: "We were in it in the first half, and that was really tough because I was so proud of the girls.
paras.zh: “上半场我们就陷入了困境，这真的很艰难，因为我为女孩们感到骄傲。

paras.en: "We came into this game confident, you've seen the streak we've had and we've been building.
paras.zh: “我们满怀信心地进入了这场比赛，你已经看到了我们已经取得的连胜，并且我们一直在建立这种连胜。

paras.en: "We lost it a bit in the second half, so it's frustrating.
paras.zh: “我们在下半场输掉了一些比赛，所以这很令人沮丧。

paras.en: "But I am so proud of the growth this team has made. Today's result does not take that away."
paras.zh: “但我对这支球队所取得的成长感到非常自豪。今天的结果并没有消除这一点。”

articles.title: Verstappen, Lawson receive grid penalties after 'unacceptable' practice collision

paras.en: Max Verstappen, Liam Lawson receive grid penalties for 'unacceptable' practice collision at Mexico City Grand Prix
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘、利亚姆·劳森因在墨西哥城大奖赛上发生“不可接受的”练习碰撞而受到发车区处罚

paras.en: Max Verstappen and Liam Lawson have both been handed a one-place grid penalty for their collision in second practice at the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying in Mexico at 9pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘和利亚姆·劳森都因在墨西哥城大奖赛第二次练习赛中发生碰撞而被罚退一位发车位；周六晚上 9 点观看墨西哥排位赛，周日晚上 8 点观看正赛

paras.en: Max Verstappen and Liam Lawson have both received one-grid place penalties for an "unacceptable" collision in second practice at the Mexico City Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘和利亚姆·劳森在墨西哥城大奖赛第二次练习赛中因“不可接受的”碰撞而受到退一发车位的处罚。

paras.en: Verstappen tried to overtake Lawson up the inside at Turn 12 going into the old baseball stadium but the Racing Bulls driver held his ground, so the pair went side by side through Turn 13 and made contact at Turn 14 with a piece of debris falling off the Dutchman's car and causing a red flag.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘试图在 12 号弯内侧超越劳森，进入旧棒球场，但公牛队车手坚守阵地，因此两人并排通过 13 号弯，并在 14 号弯发生碰撞，一块碎片从荷兰人的车上掉落，引发红旗。

paras.en: Collisions of this nature between drivers in practice are extremely rare, and the stewards stated both drivers "behaved in a manner that was considered unacceptable" and that a warning had been given at the team managers meeting earlier on Friday about overtaking in the final sector.
paras.zh: 在实践中，车手之间这种性质的碰撞极为罕见，赛事干事表示，两名车手“的行为方式被认为是不可接受的”，并且在周五早些时候的车队经理会议上就最后一个赛段的超车发出了警告。

paras.en: The stewards also said that Verstappen and Lawson both admitted the moves were "unnecessary and clumsy".
paras.zh: 干事们还表示，维斯塔潘和劳森都承认这些举动是“不必要且笨拙的”。

paras.en: They added: "Noting that there had been similar incidents this year of actions between drivers in Free Practice, the stewards have decided to escalate the penalty from that of a formal warning to a grid position penalty particularly in view of the warning that had been provided at the Team Managers meeting and consistent with other incidents involving contact between the cars in Free Practice in previous years."
paras.zh: 他们补充道：“注意到今年自由练习赛中车手之间发生过类似事件，赛会干事决定将处罚从正式警告升级为发车位置处罚，特别是考虑到车队经理会议上发出的警告以及与往年自由练习赛中涉及赛车之间接触的其他事件一致。”

paras.en: 'Not smart when you're fighting for your seat' - Verstappen hits out at Lawson
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘猛烈抨击劳森：“当你为自己的座位而战时并不聪明”

paras.en: The incident was made even more surprising by the fact the two teams have the same owners, with Racing Bulls considered Red Bull's junior squad.
paras.zh: 更令人惊讶的是，两支球队拥有相同的老板，而公牛队被认为是红牛的青年队。

paras.en: Racing Bulls have yet to confirm their 2027 driver line-up and Lawson's future is up in the air despite the New Zealander sitting ninth in the standings, 39 points ahead of his team-mate Arvid Lindblad and occupying the 'best of the rest' position behind the top four teams.
paras.zh: 公牛队尚未确定 2027 年的车手阵容，劳森的未来仍悬而未决，尽管新西兰人在积分榜上排名第九，领先队友阿维德·林德布拉德 39 分，并在前四名球队之后占据“其余最佳”位置。

paras.en: Asked about the incident before the stewards' verdict, Verstappen said: "I don't think it's called unlucky. Maybe not very smart behaviour what he was trying to do there.
paras.zh: 在赛会裁判做出裁决前被问及这一事件时，维斯塔潘表示：“我不认为这被称为不幸。他在那里试图做的事情也许不是很明智的行为。”

paras.en: "At the end of the day, it's not going to change my weekend.
paras.zh: “归根结底，这不会改变我的周末。

paras.en: "If I would be him, I would act a little bit smarter. Also, when you are fighting for your seat, it's not very smart behaviour."
paras.zh: “如果我是他，我会表现得更聪明一点。而且，当你争夺席位时，这不是很聪明的行为。”

paras.en: Red Bull junior Nikola Tsolov, who made his F1 practice debut on Friday in Mexico, is second in the Formula 2 championship and remains in contention for a Racing Bulls seat next year.
paras.zh: 红牛少年尼古拉·佐洛夫周五在墨西哥首次亮相 F1 练习赛，在二级方程式锦标赛中排名第二，并仍在争夺明年公牛队席位。

paras.en: Verstappen, who wields major power at Red Bull and over the summer signed a new long-term deal with the team, appeared to be referencing that situation with his comments.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在红牛拥有主要权力，并在今年夏天与车队签署了一份新的长期协议，他的评论似乎参考了这种情况。

paras.en: In a separate interview, the four-time world champion added: "When he saw me coming, he suddenly started to accelerate. I don't know what was going through his head, that he wanted to drive me off the track in the hairpin.
paras.zh: 在另一次采访中，这位四届世界冠军补充道：“当他看到我过来时，他突然开始加速。我不知道他脑子里在想什么，他想把我赶出发夹弯的赛道。”

paras.en: "That's not very sensible behaviour from someone in his position, to pick a fight with me."
paras.zh: “对于处于他这个位置的人来说，与我发生冲突并不是非常明智的行为。”

paras.en: Lawson, who was Verstappen's team-mate for the first two rounds of the 2025 season before being brutally dropped by Red Bull, was not obliged to speak to the media after Friday's track action.
paras.zh: 劳森是维斯塔潘 2025 赛季前两轮的队友，后来被红牛残酷淘汰。在周五的田径赛后，他没有义务接受媒体采访。

paras.en: However, in the immediate aftermath of the incident, Lawson said on the radio that Verstappen "literally drove into me" and added "if I back out every single time, what the **** do I do? He actually came off the track into the side of me".
paras.zh: 然而，事件发生后，劳森在广播中表示，维斯塔潘“真的撞到了我”，并补充道，“如果我每次都退出，我到底该怎么办？他实际上冲出了赛道，撞到了我的身边”。

paras.en: Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane said both drivers were at fault for the "completely unnecessary" collision.
paras.zh: 公牛队领队艾伦·佩尔曼表示，两名车手都对这场“完全不必要”的碰撞负有责任。

paras.en: "I don't know what Max has said, I haven't heard or seen anything," Permane said.
paras.zh: “我不知道马克斯说了什么，我没有听到或看到任何事情，”佩尔曼说。

paras.en: "I'm sure he's got his opinion and Liam's got his opinion but mine is, it's just not needed and they can both do better."
paras.zh: “我确信他有他的意见，利亚姆也有他的意见，但我的意见是，这是没有必要的，他们都可以做得更好。”

paras.en: Three-time W Series champion and Sky Sports F1's Jamie Chadwick agreed with Verstappen's comments on the incident, given the situation he is in.
paras.zh: 考虑到维斯塔潘所处的情况，三届 W 系列赛冠军、天空体育 F1 的杰米·查德威克同意维斯塔潘对这一事件的评论。

paras.en: "If it's any other driver on the grid, you can stand your ground a little bit but when it's the senior team, the team that also have an influence on the decision that goes into your race seat, does he need to do that? Probably not," she said.
paras.zh: “如果是发车区上的任何其他车手，你可以稍微坚持一下自己的立场，但当是高级车队时，这个车队也对进入你的比赛席位的决定有影响，他需要这样做吗？可能不需要，”她说。

paras.en: "But he was the same even when he raced Max as team-mates - he raced him very hard and they know exactly what that team is about, so I don't think that was the wisest thing from potentially either of them, but particularly Liam's side."
paras.zh: “但即使当他作为队友与马克斯比赛时，他也是一样的——他非常努力地与他比赛，他们确切地知道这支球队的意义，所以我不认为这对他们任何一个人来说都是最明智的事情，尤其是利亚姆这边。”

paras.en: Former McLaren and Aston Martin strategist Bernie Collins says both drivers will "regret their decisions".
paras.zh: 前迈凯轮和阿斯顿·马丁策略师伯尼·柯林斯表示，两位车手都会“后悔自己的决定”。

paras.en: "Both drivers had an opportunity to do something different there and both drivers will think 'was that corner, really worth that?'," she said.
paras.zh: “两位车手都有机会在那里做一些不同的事情，两位车手都会想‘那个弯道真的值得吗？’”她说。

paras.en: Lawson is the highest placed midfield driver in the F1 Drivers' Championship, with only the Mercedes, McLaren, Ferrari and Red Bull drivers ahead of him in the standings.
paras.zh: 劳森是 F1 车手锦标赛中排名最高的中场车手，积分榜上只有梅赛德斯、迈凯轮、法拉利和红牛车手领先于他。

paras.en: He has bounced back from a disappointing two races with Red Bull at the start of 2025 and did enough to be handed a full season at Racing Bulls this year, where he has outperformed rookie Arvid Lindblad.
paras.zh: 他从 2025 年初与红牛队的两场令人失望的比赛中恢复过来，并在今年为公牛队完成了一个完整的赛季，在那里他的表现超过了新秀阿维德·林德布拉德。

paras.en: Lawson has scored twice as many points as Lindblad and Sky Sports F1's Karun Chandhok thinks it would be "unjust" if Lawson lost his seat.
paras.zh: 劳森的得分是林德布拉德的两倍，天空体育 F1 的卡伦·钱多克 (Karun Chandhok) 认为，如果劳森失去席位将是“不公平的”。

paras.en: "He's done a fantastic job this season. He's come back carrying the mental baggage of being sacked from the Red Bull top team, went back to the Red Bull earlier this year for three races [when Isack Hadjar was injured] and did a good job there. And he's delivered really, really well," said Chandhok.
paras.zh: “他本赛季的表现非常出色。他带着被红牛顶级车队解雇的精神包袱回来了，今年早些时候回到红牛参加了三场比赛（当伊萨克·哈贾尔受伤时），并且在那里做得很好。而且他表现得非常非常好，”钱多克说。

paras.en: "I get the junior team is a university to prepare drivers for the top team. Today, they are a strong midfield team, have their own identity, own sponsors, own reasons to be competitive and not just be there to train drivers up."
paras.zh: “我认为初级车队是一所大学，为顶级车队培养车手。如今，他们是一支强大的中场车队，有自己的身份、自己的赞助商、自己的竞争理由，而不仅仅是在那里训练车手。”

paras.en: Collins added: "There are two aspects to a feeder team. One is getting very young talent in, getting them ready for the big team but what Liam showed is he can step up into that big team seat and that's important to have someone current that can just step up at any moment.
paras.zh: 柯林斯补充道：“一支支线球队有两个方面。一是吸引非常年轻的天才球员，让他们为大球队做好准备，但利亚姆所展示的是他可以进入大球队的席位，而拥有一个可以随时挺身而出的人很重要。

paras.en: "I don't really know what he can do and I'm a bit surprised we are talking about it because looking from the outside what's happened at Racing Bulls this year, the points he's scored and the races he's done, he should have done enough, more than enough.
paras.zh: “我真的不知道他能做什么，我对我们谈论这件事感到有点惊讶，因为从外部来看今年公牛队发生的事情，他获得的积分和他完成的比赛，他应该做得足够多，绰绰有余。

paras.en: "If anything, we should be discussing Arvid Lindblad's seat because he's the one who hasn't scored as many points. He's had a good year by rookie standards but if you're just looking at the scoresheet, which is what's important to the teams, that's the one you should be discussing - has he done enough against Liam Lawson?"
paras.zh: “如果有的话，我们应该讨论阿维德·林德布拉德的席位，因为他是得分不多的人。以新秀的标准来看，他今年表现不错，但如果你只看得分表，这对球队来说很重要，那就是你应该讨论的——他在对阵利亚姆·劳森的比赛中做得足够多吗？”

articles.title: U.S. set to deport Afghan refugees to Pakistan, despite risk they’ll be returned to Taliban
articles.author: Jennifer Jett

paras.en: The Trump administration is preparing to deport dozens of Afghan immigrants and asylum seekers to Pakistan on the first such flight of its kind, a senior administration official told NBC News — a move critics say could put their lives at risk.
paras.zh: 一名高级政府官员告诉 NBC 新闻，特朗普政府正准备将数十名阿富汗移民和寻求庇护者驱逐到巴基斯坦，这是此类航班的首次，批评者称此举可能会让他们面临生命危险。

paras.en: The proposed deportation flight, which has not been publicly announced, could take place as early as Monday, according to rights advocates and families of detainees.
paras.zh: 据维权人士和被拘留者家属称，拟议的驱逐航班最早可能于周一进行，但尚未公开宣布。

paras.en: Among those facing deportation are relatives of Afghans who worked with the U.S. military in its 20-year war against the Taliban, which is now back in power. The deportees could face severe repercussions should Pakistan return them to Taliban-ruled Afghanistan as is widely expected.
paras.zh: 面临驱逐的人中有一些阿富汗人的亲属，他们曾在美国军队与塔利班的长达 20 年的战争中工作过，如今塔利班又重新掌权。如果巴基斯坦像人们普遍预期的那样将被驱逐者遣返回塔利班统治的阿富汗，他们可能会面临严重后果。

paras.en: Afghans driven from their country by war and political instability have been welcomed by the U.S. for decades, including tens of thousands who fled the country following the chaotic withdrawal of U.S.-led forces in 2021. President Donald Trump halted admissions for Afghans and other refugees when he returned to office last year as part of a broader immigration crackdown.
paras.zh: 几十年来，因战争和政治不稳定而被赶出自己国家的阿富汗人一直受到美国的欢迎，其中包括2021年美国领导的军队混乱撤军后逃离该国的数万人。作为更广泛的移民镇压行动的一部分，唐纳德·特朗普总统去年重新上任后停止接纳阿富汗人和其他难民。

paras.en: His administration has deported thousands of people to countries that are not their own, many of them in Africa, in what immigration lawyers say is an effort to skirt international laws against returning asylum seekers to the countries they fled from. The legality of these so-called third-country deportation agreements is set to be debated by the Supreme Court in December.
paras.zh: 他的政府已将数千人驱逐到非本国国家，其中许多人在非洲，移民律师称此举是为了规避国际法，禁止将寻求庇护者遣返回他们逃离的国家。这些所谓的第三国驱逐协议的合法性将于 12 月由最高法院进行辩论。

paras.en: It is not clear what kind of formal agreement the U.S. may have with Pakistan, but the senior administration official said the U.S. charter flight would not be able to land there without the Pakistan government’s knowledge and approval. The deportation plan was earlier reported by Bloomberg and The New York Times.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚美国可能与巴基斯坦达成何种正式协议，但这位高级政府官员表示，如果没有巴基斯坦政府的知情和批准，美国包机将无法降落在那里。彭博社和《纽约时报》早些时候报道了这一驱逐计划。

paras.en: Bloomberg cited a federal government official familiar with the plans as a source for its report, while The New York Times cited three U.S. officials.
paras.zh: 彭博社援引一位熟悉该计划的联邦政府官员作为其报告的来源，而《纽约时报》则援引了三名美国官员的消息。

paras.en: Shawn VanDiver, president of the San Diego-based advocacy group AfghanEvac, said it had confirmed that in recent days at least 80 Afghans have been moved to Louisiana from 34 other ICE facilities around the country, 19 of them without legal representation.
paras.zh: 总部位于圣地亚哥的倡导组织 AfghanEvac 主席肖恩·范迪弗 (Shawn VanDiver) 表示，该组织已证实，最近几天至少有 80 名阿富汗人从全国其他 34 个 ICE 设施转移到路易斯安那州，其中 19 人没有法律代表。

paras.en: He said it was possible that there were hundreds of Afghans at the Central Louisiana ICE Processing Center, which has served as a hub for ICE detainees before their deportation from the U.S.
paras.zh: 他说，路易斯安那州中部 ICE 处理中心可能有数百名阿富汗人，该中心在 ICE 被拘留者被驱逐出美国之前一直是他们的中心。

paras.en: If the U.S. sends Afghan detainees to Pakistan, they are not likely to be there long. Pakistan, which has hosted millions of Afghan refugees for decades, launched a sweeping crackdown in 2023, pressuring hundreds of thousands of Afghans to leave the country and forcibly deporting others.
paras.zh: 如果美国将阿富汗被拘留者送往巴基斯坦，他们不太可能在那里呆太久。数十年来收容了数百万阿富汗难民的巴基斯坦于 2023 年发起了全面镇压，迫使数十万阿富汗人离开该国，并强行驱逐其他人。

paras.en: They are arriving to an Afghanistan battered by multiple humanitarian crises, including widespread malnutrition, as well as an ongoing military conflict with neighboring Pakistan and a dramatic rollback of women’s rights under the Taliban’s hard-line Islamic policies.
paras.zh: 他们抵达的阿富汗饱受多重人道主义危机的打击，包括普遍的营养不良、与邻国巴基斯坦持续的军事冲突以及塔利班强硬伊斯兰政策下妇女权利的大幅倒退。

paras.en: VanDiver said the Trump administration would most likely be aware that Afghans sent to Pakistan would be at high risk of being returned to Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 范迪弗表示，特朗普政府很可能意识到，被送往巴基斯坦的阿富汗人被送回阿富汗的风险很高。

paras.en: “You don’t have to be that smart to figure out that they’re sending them to Pakistan so that Pakistan will finish the job,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“你不必那么聪明，就能知道他们要把他们送到巴基斯坦，以便巴基斯坦完成这项工作。”

paras.en: Regardless of whether they worked with the U.S. military, VanDiver said, any Afghans flown from the U.S. would be viewed with suspicion by the Taliban and at risk of persecution, imprisonment or worse.
paras.zh: 范迪弗说，无论他们是否与美国军方合作，任何从美国飞来的阿富汗人都会受到塔利班的怀疑，并面临遭受迫害、监禁或更糟的风险。

paras.en: That does not appear to be a major concern for the White House, said the senior administration official, who declined to be identified because they were not authorized to speak to the media.
paras.zh: 这位拒绝透露姓名的高级政府官员表示，这似乎并不是白宫主要担心的问题。因为他们无权向媒体发表讲话。

paras.en: “The administration’s position is, ‘These individuals do not have status in our country, therefore we don’t really care what happens to them,’” the official said.
paras.zh: “政府的立场是，‘这些人在我们国家没有地位，因此我们并不真正关心他们会发生什么，’”这位官员说。

paras.en: VanDiver and others say the Trump administration’s treatment of Afghan allies could also have long-term consequences for U.S. national security by discouraging people in other countries from working with U.S. forces in future conflicts.
paras.zh: 范迪弗等人表示，特朗普政府对待阿富汗盟友的方式也可能对美国国家安全产生长期影响，因为这会阻止其他国家的人们在未来的冲突中与美军合作。

paras.en: Asked whether the Trump administration was concerned about that, the official said, “I don’t think they care.”
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普政府是否对此感到担忧时，这位官员表示，“我认为他们不在乎。”

paras.en: The White House referred a request for comment to the Department of Homeland Security, whose spokesperson said the agency could not confirm removal operations “for operational security reasons.” ICE did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 白宫向国土安全部提出了置评请求，该部发言人表示，“出于运营安全原因”，该机构无法确认拆除行动。 ICE 没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: A State Department spokesperson said the agency had “no plans to announce.”
paras.zh: 美国国务院发言人表示，该机构“没有计划宣布这一消息”。

paras.en: “We reaffirm our position that all countries must be able to manage their borders and immigration processes in a manner that ensures the safety, security and prosperity of their citizens,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 发言人表示：“我们重申我们的立场，即所有国家都必须能够以确保其公民的安全、保障和繁荣的方式管理其边境和移民程序。”

paras.en: Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs and its embassy in Washington did not respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦外交部及其驻华盛顿大使馆没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: The senior administration official said the Afghans on the flight could include people with deportation orders, people who were turned down for asylum and people whose temporary protected status was terminated by the Trump administration. Many of the Afghans facing deportation requested asylum after crossing into the U.S. from Mexico, VanDiver said, and some of their cases are still pending.
paras.zh: 这位高级政府官员表示，飞机上的阿富汗人可能包括收到驱逐令的人、被拒绝庇护的人以及被特朗普政府终止临时保护身份的人。范迪弗说，许多面临驱逐的阿富汗人从墨西哥进入美国后请求庇护，其中一些案件仍在审理中。

paras.en: Charlotte, a U.S. citizen whose Afghan husband has been in ICE detention since early 2025, said he had been moved to the Louisiana facility from Pennsylvania this month and told he would be deported in early November. She declined to be identified by her full name out of concern that her husband could be targeted by the Taliban.
paras.zh: 夏洛特是一名美国公民，她的阿富汗丈夫自 2025 年初以来一直被 ICE 拘留。她表示，他本月已从宾夕法尼亚州转移到路易斯安那州的拘留所，并被告知将于 11 月初被驱逐出境。由于担心她的丈夫可能成为塔利班的目标，她拒绝透露自己的全名。

paras.en: Charlotte said she and her husband, whose asylum case has been pending for nine years, were visiting family in Maryland last year when he accidentally crossed into West Virginia and was pulled over. Though he was carrying his valid Illinois driver’s license, he did not have his work permit with him.
paras.zh: 夏洛特说，她和她的丈夫去年在马里兰州探望家人时，不小心越境进入西弗吉尼亚州并被拦下。她的庇护案已经悬而未决九年了。尽管他持有有效的伊利诺伊州驾驶执照，但他没有工作许可证。

paras.en: “When he was pulled over,” she said, “the sheriff actually said, ‘I’m an ICE agent. You’re going to immigration custody. I don’t care if the charges are dismissed, or I don’t care if you have a five-year work permit or Social Security card. I don’t care if you’re legal. Trump’s administration just took over — you’re going directly to immigration custody.’”
paras.zh: “当他被拦下时，”她说，“警长实际上说，‘我是 ICE 特工。你将被移民拘留。我不在乎这些指控是否被驳回，或者我不在乎你是否有五年工作许可证或社会保障卡。我不在乎你是否合法。特朗普政府刚刚接管，你将直接被移民拘留。’”

paras.en: Charlotte sold their home in Illinois and moved to Maryland with their son, now 6, in order to be able to visit her husband at the ICE facility where he was held in Pennsylvania, about 100 miles away.
paras.zh: 夏洛特卖掉了他们在伊利诺伊州的房子，带着现年 6 岁的儿子搬到了马里兰州，以便能够探望她的丈夫，他被关押在大约 100 英里外的宾夕法尼亚州的 ICE 设施中。

paras.en: “I lost my nice house, our car, we left everything behind,” she said.
paras.zh: “我失去了我漂亮的房子，我们的车，我们把一切都抛在了身后，”她说。

paras.en: Over the next 20 months, when she took her son to see his father at the Moshannon Valley Processing Center, they were always separated by plexiglass.
paras.zh: 接下来的20个月里，当她带着儿子去莫山农谷处理中心见父亲时，他们总是被有机玻璃隔开。

paras.en: “They never let him hug him one time,” Charlotte said. “We just sat there and cried every time.”
paras.zh: “他们从来没有让他拥抱过他一次，”夏洛特说。 “我们每次都坐在那儿哭。”

paras.en: But at least they knew where he was and that he was OK, she said. Now that he’s in Louisiana, she said, “we can’t even visit or even say goodbye, he’s over 1,200 miles away.”
paras.zh: 但至少他们知道他在哪里并且他没事，她说。现在他在路易斯安那州，她说，“我们甚至不能去看望他，甚至不能说再见，他已经在 1,200 英里之外了。”

paras.en: With her husband potentially being sent to Pakistan or Afghanistan — a country he hasn’t been to since 2016 — the uncertainty is even greater; Charlotte said he is growing his beard to comply with the Taliban’s strict rules for men’s facial hair.
paras.zh: 由于她的丈夫可能被送往巴基斯坦或阿富汗——他自 2016 年以来就没有去过这两个国家——不确定性就更大了；夏洛特说，他留胡子是为了遵守塔利班对男性面部毛发的严格规定。

paras.en: “I’m just terrified that he’s not going to be safe,” she said, “or he’s going to be held in the jail and there’s nothing I can do.”
paras.zh: “我只是担心他会不安全，”她说，“或者他会被关在监狱里，而我却无能为力。”

paras.en: Charlotte said she believed her husband had been targeted for deportation because of a past conviction for a nonviolent crime that has since been resolved.
paras.zh: 夏洛特说，她相信她的丈夫之所以成为驱逐出境的目标，是因为她过去曾因非暴力犯罪被定罪，但现已得到解决。

paras.en: “I still don’t think this should end our entire life, for a child not to see his dad,” she said.
paras.zh: “我仍然不认为这应该结束我们的一生，因为一个孩子见不到他的父亲，”她说。

paras.en: “He’s completely devastated and traumatized,” she said of their son. “He wants to fight. He wants to go protest. He wants to speak to Donald Trump. He basically knows so much more than he should.”
paras.zh: “他彻底崩溃了，受到了创伤，”她谈到他们的儿子时说道。 “他想要战斗。他想要抗议。他想要与唐纳德·特朗普交谈。他基本上知道的比他应该知道的多得多。”

paras.en: The preparations for the deportation flight come nearly a year after a shooting in Washington that killed one National Guard member and seriously injured another. The suspect, an Afghan national who served alongside U.S. troops in Afghanistan and was evacuated to the U.S. in 2021, had been granted asylum by the Trump administration.
