Immigration restrictions were tightened after the shooting.
paras.zh: 驱逐航班的准备工作是在华盛顿发生枪击事件近一年后进行的，该枪击事件造成一名国民警卫队成员死亡，另一名国民警卫队成员重伤。嫌疑人是一名阿富汗国民，曾在阿富汗与美军并肩作战，并于 2021 年撤离到美国，已获得特朗普政府的庇护。枪击事件发生后，移民限制收紧。

paras.en: VanDiver said the Trump administration may also be using the Pakistan flight as a test case for Camp As Sayliyah, a U.S.-run camp in Qatar where more than 1,000 Afghans who had been slated for resettlement in the U.S. have been stranded since Trump returned to office last year.
paras.zh: 范迪弗表示，特朗普政府也可能利用巴基斯坦航班作为萨利耶营地的测试案例，萨利耶营地是美国在卡塔尔运营的营地，自特朗普去年重返办公室以来，已有 1000 多名原本计划在美国重新安置的阿富汗人被困在那里。

paras.en: Asked about VanDiver’s claim, the White House referred a request for comment to the Department of Homeland Security, whose spokesperson again said the agency could not confirm removal operations “for operational security reasons.”
paras.zh: 当被问及范迪弗的说法时，白宫向国土安全部提出了置评请求，国土安全部发言人再次表示，“出于运营安全原因”，该机构无法确认移除行动。

paras.en: According to AfghanEvac, the camp was housing 287 men as of July, 319 women and 433 children. Most of them have been approved for U.S. resettlement after extensive vetting, and many of the adults worked alongside U.S. forces in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 据 AfghanEvac 称，截至 7 月，该营地共有 287 名男性、319 名女性和 433 名儿童。经过广泛审查后，他们中的大多数人已获准在美国重新安置，其中许多成年人曾在阿富汗与美军一起工作。

paras.en: The group at Camp As Sayliyah also includes 150 relatives of U.S. military service members, AfghanEvac said.
paras.zh: AfghanEvac 表示，萨利耶营地的这群人还包括 150 名美国军人的亲属。

paras.en: Afghan refugees in Qatar protest over travel suspension
paras.zh: 卡塔尔的阿富汗难民抗议旅行暂停

paras.en: The State Department said earlier this year that everyone would be removed from the camp by March 31, a deadline that was later extended to Sept. 30. In September, the Trump administration delayed its closure by another nine months, The Associated Press reported.
paras.zh: 美国国务院今年早些时候表示，将在 3 月 31 日之前将所有人撤离营地，最后期限后来延长至 9 月 30 日。据美联社报道，9 月，特朗普政府将关闭营地又推迟了 9 个月。

paras.en: Earlier this year, the administration considered sending the Afghans at Camp As Sayliyah to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is experiencing the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，政府考虑将萨利耶营地的阿富汗人送往刚果民主共和国，该国正在经历历史上增长最快的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: In a statement on Friday, AfghanEvac accused the Trump administration of planning the Afghan deportation flight as the country is distracted by next week’s midterm election, “hoping no one is watching.”
paras.zh: 阿富汗疏散公司在周五的一份声明中指责特朗普政府计划驱逐阿富汗人，因为该国正因下周的中期选举而分心，“希望没有人在关注”。

paras.en: “The government won’t say where these flights land, because it knows what happens to the people on them when they do,” the group said. “A government confident in what it is doing does not hide it.”
paras.zh: 该组织表示：“政府不会透露这些航班降落在哪里，因为它知道飞机降落时机上人员会发生什么。” “一个对其所做的事情充满信心的政府不会隐藏它。”

articles.title: More than $3m spent on government merch, including condoms and lollies
articles.author: Jack McKay

paras.en: The Commonwealth has banned federal agencies from using taxpayer funds to buy promotional merchandise "without exemption".
paras.zh: 英联邦已​​禁止联邦机构“无豁免”地使用纳税人的资金购买促销商品。

paras.en: Figures provided to the Senate reveal government entities spent more than $3.4 million on merchandise last financial year.
paras.zh: 向参议院提供的数据显示，上一财年政府实体在商品上的支出超过 340 万美元。

paras.en: The new rules took effect from July, with departments required to report their expenditure on merchandise in their annual reports.
paras.zh: 新规定从7月起生效，要求各部门在年度报告中报告其商品支出。

paras.en: The Albanese government has launched a clampdown on taxpayer-funded merchandise in a bid to rein in the millions of dollars spent on promotional knick-knacks.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚政府对纳税人资助的商品发起了严厉打击，以控制在促销小玩意上花费的数百万美元。

paras.en: Stress balls, condoms, lollies, tote bags, pens and beanies were among thousands of branded or promotional products bought by federal entities in the past financial year.
paras.zh: 在上个财政年度，联邦实体购买了数千种品牌或促销产品，其中包括压力球、避孕套、棒棒糖、手提袋、钢笔和无檐小便帽等。

paras.en: The total cost across a range of government departments, agencies, independent statutory authorities, regulators and other entities came in at more than $3.4 million.
paras.zh: 一系列政府部门、机构、独立法定机构、监管机构和其他实体的总成本超过 340 万美元。

paras.en: But under a new edict that came into effect from July, the government has banned agencies from using taxpayer funds to purchase promotional merchandise unless they seek approval.
paras.zh: 但根据自 7 月起生效的一项新法令，政府禁止各机构使用纳税人资金购买促销商品，除非获得批准。

paras.en: There are some exemptions, such as if items are sold for profit or if they are considered critical to the government's policy objectives.
paras.zh: 有一些豁免，例如物品是否以盈利为目的出售，或者是否被认为对政府的政策目标至关重要。

paras.en: The policy, which was part of this year's budget, mandates that agencies must also publicly report details of their merchandise spend in their annual reports.
paras.zh: 该政策是今年预算的一部分，要求各机构还必须在年度报告中公开报告其商品支出的详细信息。

paras.en: "The Department of Finance has issued guidance to agencies to support implementation of the government's policy," a government spokesperson told the ABC.
paras.zh: “财政部已向各机构发布指导意见，以支持政府政策的实施，”政府发言人告诉澳大利亚广播公司。

paras.en: The Department of Defence was among the biggest spenders in 2025–26, putting more than $1.4 million towards merchandise, according to figures provided to the Senate.
paras.zh: 根据提供给参议院的数据，国防部是 2025-26 年最大的支出国之一，在商品上投入了超过 140 万美元。

paras.en: This included gifts for foreign militaries and dignitaries, as well as items for recruitment activities, employment expos and base open days.
paras.zh: 其中包括送给外国军队和政要的礼物，以及用于招募活动、就业博览会和基地开放日的物品。

paras.en: A Defence spokesperson said officials must ensure spending on merchandise represented an efficient, effective, economic and ethical use of public resources.
paras.zh: 国防部发言人表示，官员们必须确保商品支出代表了对公共资源的高效、有效、经济和道德的使用。

paras.en: Another $383,000 was also spent at the health department, which included 40,000 condoms in an initiative aimed at preventing sexually transmitted infections.
paras.zh: 卫生部门还花费了 383,000 美元，其中包括 40,000 个安全套，用于预防性传播感染的举措。

paras.en: It also purchased 7,000 campaign-branded "condom wallets".
paras.zh: 它还购买了 7,000 个活动品牌的“安全套钱包”。

paras.en: Among the other items the department bought were 5,000 stress balls, 5,000 mints packs, and 220 yo-yos — all with anti-vaping messages.
paras.zh: 该部门购买的其他物品包括 5,000 个压力球、5,000 包薄荷糖和 220 个溜溜球——所有物品都带有反电子烟信息。

paras.en: A department spokesperson defended its spend on merchandise, saying it was procured in limited circumstances for public health campaigns or strategies.
paras.zh: 该部门发言人为其商品支出进行了辩护，称这些商品是在有限的情况下出于公共卫生活动或战略而采购的。

paras.en: "Evaluation of these campaigns consistently show they are highly engaging, are well recognised by their target audiences and meet the campaign objectives," they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“对这些活动的评估一致表明，它们具有高度吸引力，得到目标受众的广泛认可并达到了活动目标。”

paras.en: "Merchandise plays an important role in this.
paras.zh: “商品在这方面发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: "When used, merchandise carries important health messages and information, such as vaccine schedules, reminders of the importance of STI testing and scheduling, and strategies to assist in how to quit vaping and smoking."
paras.zh: “使用时，商品带有重要的健康信息和信息，例如疫苗接种时间表、性传播感染检测和安排重要性的提醒，以及帮助戒烟和戒烟的策略。”

paras.en: The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) also incurred $176,000 in merchandise costs last financial year, with most of it aimed at spruiking this year's census.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚统计局 (ABS) 上一财年还产生了 176,000 澳元的商品成本，其中大部分旨在宣传今年的人口普查。

paras.en: This included census-themed beanies, mini AFL footballs, socks, reusable shopping bags, pencils, pens and "I heart census" button badge pins.
paras.zh: 其中包括以人口普查为主题的无檐小便帽、迷你 AFL 橄榄球、袜子、可重复使用的购物袋、铅笔、钢笔和“我关注人口普查”按钮徽章别针。

paras.en: An ABS spokesperson said its agency had not purchased any further promotional material since the government's new merchandise policy came into effect.
paras.zh: ABS 发言人表示，自政府新商品政策生效以来，该机构尚未购买任何进一步的宣传材料。

paras.en: "Census merchandise was used at community events, information hubs, during remote community engagement activities and to support the enumeration of people experiencing homelessness," they said.
paras.zh: 他们说：“人口普查商品被用于社区活动、信息中心、远程社区参与活动，并支持对无家可归者进行统计。”

paras.en: The Australian Federal Police (AFP) spent more than $251,000, with a spokesperson saying it uses "standardised promotional material" for career expos and fairs.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚联邦警察局 (AFP) 花费了超过 251,000 澳元，发言人表示，他们使用“标准化宣传材料”进行职业博览会和博览会。

paras.en: The spokesperson also said it was "reasonable to expect" some of its reported expenditure on merchandise was used to purchase items from the AFP Legacy Shop.
paras.zh: 该发言人还表示，“有理由预计”其报告的部分商品支出将用于从法新社旧版商店购买商品。

paras.en: "The AFP has formal governance on the acquisition of merchandise and has recently tightened this governance further to ensure a greater proportion of our merchandise has an educational element, rather than branded generic keepsakes," they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“法新社对商品采购有正式的监管，并且最近进一步加强了监管，以确保我们更大比例的商品具有教育元素，而不是品牌通用纪念品。”

articles.title: Criticism of One Nation cartoon of ex-Victorian premier Jacinta Allan
articles.author: Alex Sinnott and Lexie Jeuniewic

paras.en: A new One Nation cartoon has depicted former Victorian premier Jacinta Allan as a witch, earning a rebuke from deputy premier Gabrielle Williams, who described it as misogynistic.
paras.zh: 一部新的一国漫画将维多利亚州前总理杰辛塔·艾伦描绘成女巫，遭到副总理加布里埃尔·威廉姆斯的斥责，她称这是厌恶女性的行为。

paras.en: The party's satirical cartoons recently drew criticism across the political spectrum for making light of crossbench senator Jacqui Lambie's vaginal prolapse.
paras.zh: 该党的讽刺漫画最近因轻描淡写中立议员杰奎·兰比的阴道脱垂而招致了整个政界的批评。

paras.en: Meanwhile, One Nation MP David Farley has said he "reluctantly" turned down an unsolicited offer from the prime minister for more staff.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一国党议员戴维·法利表示，他“不情愿”地拒绝了总理主动提出的增加工作人员的提议。

paras.en: Victoria's deputy premier has slammed a new cartoon released by One Nation this morning, which depicts former premier Jacinta Allan as a witch.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州副总理猛烈抨击了一国组织今天早上发布的一部新漫画，该漫画将前总理杰辛塔·艾伦描绘成女巫。

paras.en: The six-minute Halloween-themed video covers a range of political issues and includes other characters such as Premier Ben Carroll, ex premier Dan Andrews and Opposition Leader Jess Wilson.
paras.zh: 这段以万圣节为主题的六分钟视频涵盖了一系列政治问题，其中包括总理本·卡罗尔、前总理丹·安德鲁斯和反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊等其他人物。

paras.en: The cartoon critique coincides with the state government releasing more than 190 annual reports yesterday, ahead of next month's election.
paras.zh: 昨天，在下个月的选举之前，州政府发布了 190 多份年度报告。

paras.en: Deputy Premier Gabrielle Williams was critical of the cartoon at a press conference this morning.
paras.zh: 副总理加布里埃尔·威廉姆斯在今天早上的新闻发布会上批评了这部漫画。

paras.en: "We're now seeing them again buy in to tired old misogynistic tropes," Ms Williams said.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯女士说：“我们现在看到他们再次接受陈旧的厌恶女性的说法。”

paras.en: "They've got to decide if they are a serious political party interested in policy and what they're going to deliver for the Victorian community or whether they're a bunch of school kids drawing cartoons at the back of the class."
paras.zh: “他们必须决定他们是否是一个对政策感兴趣的严肃政党以及他们将为维多利亚社区提供什么，或者他们是否是一群在课堂后面画漫画的小学生。”

paras.en: Federal leader of One Nation Pauline Hanson was asked about the cartoon in Perth today, and made no apologies for its contents, telling reporters she was "glad" Ms Williams had seen it.
paras.zh: 今天，一国党联邦领导人波琳·汉森在珀斯被问及这部漫画时，她没有对其内容表示歉意，并告诉记者，她“很高兴”威廉姆斯女士看到了它。

paras.en: "She might be learning a bit about it. And when you look at the cartoon, it is satirical, right?,"
paras.zh: “她可能正在了解一些。当你看漫画时，它是讽刺的，对吧？”

paras.en: One Nation's cartoon series has received criticism across the political spectrum in recent weeks, most notably for making light of Tasmanian senator Jacqui Lambie's vaginal prolapse, a health condition she revealed during a speech in the Senate in August.
paras.zh: 最近几周，一国党的漫画系列受到了各个政治派别的批评，其中最引人注目的是对塔斯马尼亚参议员杰奎·兰比的阴道脱垂的轻描淡写，她在八月份在参议院的一次演讲中透露了这一健康状况。

paras.en: Senator Hanson initially defended the cartoon before admitting she had not seen it. The One Nation leader later apologised and said it "wasn't as tastefully done as it could have been".
paras.zh: 汉森参议员最初为这部漫画辩护，然后承认她没有看过它。这位一国党领导人后来道歉并表示，这“做得不够高雅”。

paras.en: However, Melbourne-based cartoon creator Mark Nicholson, who is running as a One Nation candidate at the Victorian state election, continued to defend the Lambie satire in an interview with the ABC this week.
paras.zh: 然而，作为一国党候选人参加维多利亚州选举的墨尔本漫画创作者马克·尼科尔森本周在接受美国广播公司采访时继续为兰比的讽刺作品辩护。

paras.en: "We're just trying to do the best thing for the country and for satire," Mr Nicholson told 7.30.
paras.zh: “我们只是想为国家和讽刺做最好的事情，”尼科尔森先生告诉 7.30。

paras.en: In July, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese led bipartisan criticism of a mobile billboard depicting then-premier Allan as a witch.
paras.zh: 7 月，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 领导了两党对一块将时任总理艾伦描绘成女巫的移动广告牌提出批评。

paras.en: A Melbourne brothel funded the billboard, which Ms Allan at the time described "as part of a secret and well-funded political campaign".
paras.zh: 墨尔本一家妓院资助了这个广告牌，艾伦女士当时将其描述为“这是一场秘密且资金充足的政治运动的一部分”。

paras.en: Ms Wilson also condemned the sign on behalf of the Coalition, saying it was "sexist" and "inappropriate".
paras.zh: 威尔逊女士还代表联盟谴责了这个标志，称其是“性别歧视”且“不恰当”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, One Nation MP David Farley has said he "reluctantly" turned down an unsolicited offer from the prime minister for more staff.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一国党议员戴维·法利表示，他“不情愿”地拒绝了总理主动提出的增加工作人员的提议。

paras.en: This week, Anthony Albanese wrote to the Farrer MP offering him an additional staffer, prompting Pauline Hanson to accuse Mr Albanese of political meddling.
paras.zh: 本周，安东尼·阿尔巴内塞写信给法雷尔议员，向他提供了一名额外的工作人员，促使宝琳·汉森指责阿尔巴内塞先生干涉政治。

paras.en: Appearing on a new episode of Topher Field's podcast, Mr Farley told the self-described libertarian political commentator he does need extra resources.
paras.zh: 法利先生出现在托弗·菲尔德播客的新一集中，对这位自称自由主义政治评论员的人说，他确实需要额外的资源。

paras.en: "But it would be totally disingenuous for me to step in front of my leader and say, 'Well look at me, I've got an extra staffer, keep batting away for yourself,'" Mr Farley told Mr Field, referring to Senator Hanson's own push for more staff.
paras.zh: “但如果我走到我的领导面前说，‘好吧，看看我，我有一个额外的工作人员，你就继续为自己奋斗吧，’”法利先生告诉菲尔德先生，他指的是汉森参议员自己争取更多工作人员的努力。

paras.en: Later in the episode, Mr Farley reflected on his fight to unlock environmental water for agriculture and why his relationship with Mr Albanese, who he described as "reasonable, practical, and approachable", is somewhat unconventional.
paras.zh: 在这一集中，法利先生反思了他为农业释放环境用水而进行的斗争，以及为什么他与阿尔巴内斯先生的关系有些非传统，他形容阿尔巴内斯先生“合理、务实、平易近人”。

paras.en: "In history and over time, the relationship would've been one-on-one with Pauline [Hanson] and Anthony Albanese," Mr Farley said.
paras.zh: “从历史上看，随着时间的推移，这种关系将是与宝琳[汉森]和安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一对一的关系，”法利先生说。

paras.en: "From today on, the relationship with the prime minister needs to be with the leader of the party."
paras.zh: “从今天开始，与总理的关系需要是与党的领导人的关系。”

paras.en: Asked whether he could defect to Labor in the future, Mr Farley said "no".
paras.zh: 当被问及他未来是否可以叛逃到工党时，法利先生说“不”。

paras.en: "The job I've got in front of me isn't a job for wimps, pimps, and banjo players,"
paras.zh: “我面前的工作不是懦夫、皮条客和班卓琴演奏家的工作，”

paras.en: "This is a job that requires courage and tenacity, and the party's got it. But more importantly, Pauline Hanson's got it in spades."
paras.zh: “这是一项需要勇气和毅力的工作，党做到了。但更重要的是，宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）确实做到了。”

articles.title: Three arrested after allegedly stolen car driven wildly across Brisbane

paras.en: Police have charged three people after a series of armed robberies involving an allegedly stolen vehicle across multiple Brisbane suburbs.
paras.zh: 布里斯班多个郊区发生一系列涉嫌盗窃车辆的武装抢劫案，警方已对三人提出指控。

paras.en: Police were called to a home in Kuraby in Brisbane's south about 3:15pm Friday after receiving reports a man and a woman had threatened a female resident with a knife before attempting to steal a vehicle.
paras.zh: 周五下午 3 点 15 分左右，警方接到报告称，一名男子和一名女子在试图偷车之前用刀威胁一名女性居民，警方接到报告后赶到布里斯班南部库拉比的一处住宅。

paras.en: It is alleged the same offenders were involved in an attempted armed robbery in Sunnybank Hills earlier in the day.
paras.zh: 据称，当天早些时候，同一群罪犯还参与了在桑尼班克山 (Sunnybank Hills) 的一次武装抢劫未遂事件。

paras.en: Police allege the offenders fled the scene in a black Haval H6 which had been stolen from a car wash in Goodna on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 警方称，犯罪者驾驶一辆黑色哈弗 H6 逃离现场，这辆汽车是周三从古德纳洗车场被盗的。

paras.en: The vehicle was spotted in Waterford about 5pm and a police helicopter began tracking its movements.
paras.zh: 下午 5 点左右，这辆车在沃特福德被发现，一架警用直升机开始追踪其动向。

paras.en: Police video shows the vehicle driving dangerously through multiple suburbs including Forest Lake, Sumner Park, Corinda and Indooroopilly.
paras.zh: 警方的视频显示，这辆车危险地行驶穿过多个郊区，包括森林湖、萨姆纳公园、科林达和因杜卢皮利。

paras.en: At one point the car cuts through a service station, narrowly avoiding a cyclist.
paras.zh: 有一次，汽车穿过一个服务站，险些避开了一名骑自行车的人。

paras.en: A tyre deflation device was used on the vehicle in Milton about 6:13pm and it came to a stop on Gailey Road in the neighbouring suburb of St Lucia seven minutes later.
paras.zh: 下午6点13分左右，这辆车在米尔顿使用了轮胎放气装置，七分钟后停在邻近圣卢西亚郊区的盖利路。

paras.en: Two women and a man were taken into custody.
paras.zh: 两名女子和一名男子被拘留。

paras.en: A 26-year-old Morningside woman and a 22-year-old Kingston woman have been charged with multiple offences, including armed robbery and unlawful use of a motor vehicle.
paras.zh: 一名 26 岁的 Morningside 女子和一名 22 岁的 Kingston 女子被指控犯有多项罪行，包括武装抢劫和非法使用机动车辆。

paras.en: A 24-year-old Forest Lake man has been charged with 12 offences.
paras.zh: 一名 24 岁的森林湖男子被指控犯有 12 项罪名。

paras.en: All three were due to appear in the Brisbane Magistrates Court on Saturday.
paras.zh: 这三人将于周六在布里斯班地方法院出庭。

paras.en: Police have appealed for any witnesses, including anyone with relevant dashcam video, to get in touch.
paras.zh: 警方呼吁任何目击者，包括任何拥有相关行车记录仪视频的人与我们联系。

articles.title: North American stocks sink, Wall Street suffers worst day since June amid tech sell-off
articles.author: Stan Choe

paras.en: North American stocks sink, Wall Street suffers worst day since June amid tech sell-off
paras.zh: 北美股市下挫，科技股遭抛售，华尔街遭遇六月以来最糟糕的一天

paras.en: In Canada, the S&P/TSX composite index finished the day about 1.7 per cent lower
paras.zh: 在加拿大，S&P/TSX 综合指数当天收盘下跌约 1.7%

paras.en: A sell-off for tech stocks got even worse Friday on worries that Wall Street's frenzy around artificial-intelligence technology sent prices too high.
paras.zh: 由于担心华尔街对人工智能技术的狂热导致价格过高，周五科技股的抛售变得更加严重。

paras.en: The S&P 500 tumbled about 1.8 per cent Friday for its worst day since June. The weakness of technology stocks dragged the Nasdaq composite down a market-leading 2.9 per cent, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.1 per cent.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数周五下跌约 1.8%，为 6 月以来最糟糕的一天。科技股的疲软拖累纳斯达克综合指数下跌 2.9%，领先市场，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 1.1%。

paras.en: Canada's main index, the S&P/TSX composite, bounced back from its afternoon drop of 2.3 per cent to close down 1.7 per cent.
paras.zh: 加拿大主要指数 S&P/TSX 综合指数从下午 2.3% 的跌幅中反弹，收盘下跌 1.7%。

paras.en: Intel's stock led the way lower and plunged 28.6 per cent for its worst drop since 1974. The chipmaker gave a forecast for profit in the final three months of this year that fell short of analysts' expectations, as CEO Lip-Bu Tan said the personal-computer industry continues to feel pressure. The drop came even though Intel reported a stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected.
paras.zh: 英特尔股价领跌，暴跌 28.6%，创 1974 年以来最大跌幅。该芯片制造商对今年最后三个月的利润预测低于分析师预期，首席执行官 Lip-Bu Tan 表示个人电脑行业继续面临压力。尽管英特尔公布的最新季度利润高于分析师预期，但业绩还是出现了下降。

paras.en: Amazon sank 1.4 per cent after reporting a weaker profit for the summer than analysts expected. Potentially more concerning for investors was Amazon's reporting that it burned through $42.4 billion US of cash over the prior 12 months, according to a measure called free cash flow. It spent $94.8 billion US on property and equipment, primarily through investments in artificial-intelligence technology.
paras.zh: 亚马逊公布夏季利润低于分析师预期，股价下跌 1.4%。投资者可能更担心的是亚马逊的报告称，根据一项称为自由现金流的指标，该公司在过去 12 个月内消耗了 424 亿美元的现金。它在财产和设备上花费了 948 亿美元，主要是通过对人工智能技术的投资。

paras.en: A day earlier, Alphabet's stock dropped more than 12 per cent to its worst day on record and almost single-handedly dragged the S&P 500 lower after telling investors it burned through more cash during the summer than the spring. The company behind Google and YouTube cited similar, mammoth investments in AI.
paras.zh: 一天前，Alphabet 告诉投资者该公司夏季消耗的现金多于春季，该公司股价下跌超过 12%，创有记录以来最糟糕单日，几乎单枪匹马拖累标准普尔 500 指数走低。谷歌和 YouTube 背后的公司也提到了类似的、在人工智能领域的巨额投资。

paras.en: Worries are rising about whether all those hundreds of billions of dollars will produce enough profit and productivity to make the investment worth it. At the same time, stocks of computer chip companies and other winners from the frenzy to build AI data centres have come under pressure on concerns that high interest rates may slow the further build out of data centres.
paras.zh: 人们越来越担心这数千亿美元能否产生足够的利润和生产力，使投资物有所值。与此同时，由于担心高利率可能会减缓数据中心的进一步建设，计算机芯片公司和其他人工智能数据中心建设热潮中的赢家的股票也面临压力。

paras.en: "We're moving out of the hopes and dreams phase of the AI trade and into the 'show me' phase," said Joe Tigay, portfolio manager at Equity Armor Investments, in a note to investors.
paras.zh: Equity Armor Investments 的投资组合经理 Joe Tigay 在给投资者的一份报告中表示：“我们正在走出人工智能交易的希望和梦想阶段，进入‘展示’阶段。”

paras.en: A drop of 4.2 per cent for Nvidia, the chip company that became the poster child of the AI frenzy, was the heaviest force pulling the S&P 500 downward, outweighing even Intel.
paras.zh: 成为人工智能热潮典型代表的芯片公司英伟达(Nvidia)下跌4.2%，是拉动标准普尔500指数下跌的最大力量，甚至超过了英特尔。

paras.en: In the cryptocurrency industry, meanwhile, stocks tumbled following a hack on the world's biggest crypto exchange. The price of bitcoin fell toward $77,000 US from more than $86,000 US earlier this month, and a U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm said a North Korean unit was likely behind the attack that affected more than $6 billion US worth of crypto at Binance.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在加密货币行业，全球最大的加密货币交易所遭到黑客攻击后，股市暴跌。本月早些时候，比特币价格从超过 86,000 美元跌至 77,000 美元，一家美国区块链情报公司表示，朝鲜单位可能是此次攻击的幕后黑手，此次攻击影响了币安价值超过 60 亿美元的加密货币。

paras.en: Outside of tech, stocks were more resilient as many rallied after reporting stronger profits for the summer than analysts expected. Nearly as many stocks rose in the S&P 500 index as fell.
paras.zh: 除科​​技股外，股市更具弹性，许多股市在公布夏季利润强于分析师预期后出现反弹。标准普尔 500 指数中上涨的股票与下跌的股票几乎一样多。

paras.en: ExxonMobil climbed 2.2 per cent, and Chevron added 1.8 per cent after the oil giants both reported stronger profit for the summer than analysts expected.
paras.zh: 埃克森美孚股价上涨 2.2%，雪佛龙股价上涨 1.8%，两家石油巨头均报告夏季利润强于分析师预期。

paras.en: Mondelez International rose 3.9 per cent due to better than expected growth and Colgate-Palmolive climbed 2.3 per cent after higher prices for its products helped it deliver better revenue and profit than analysts expected.
paras.zh: 亿滋国际 (Mondelez International) 因增长好于预期而上涨 3.9%，高露洁棕榄 (Colgate-Palmolive) 上涨 2.3%，因为其产品价格上涨帮助其实现了好于分析师预期的收入和利润。

paras.en: Expectations are high for U.S. companies' ability to make bigger profits, even though people around the world are feeling discouraged about high inflation and high fuel prices. Such expectations are what drove the S&P 500 to its record earlier this month.
paras.zh: 尽管世界各地的人们对高通胀和高燃油价格感到沮丧，但人们对美国公司赚取更大利润的能力抱有很高的期望。这种预期推动标准普尔 500 指数在本月早些时候创下历史新高。

paras.en: In the bond market, Treasury yields eased in a signal that investors were buying U.S. government bonds in search of a safer option. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.93 per cent from 4.98 per cent late Thursday and from more than 5.30 per cent earlier this month.
paras.zh: 在债券市场，美国国债收益率下跌，表明投资者正在购买美国政府债券以寻求更安全的选择。 10年期国债收益率从周四晚间的4.98%和本月初的5.30%以上跌至4.93%。

paras.en: In stock markets abroad, indexes were mostly lower in Europe following sharper swings in Asia. South Korea's Kospi dropped due to AI worries, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng climbed slightly.
paras.zh: 在国外股市，继亚洲股市大幅波动之后，欧洲股指大多走低。由于对人工智能的担忧，韩国综合股价指数下跌，而香港恒生指数小幅上涨。

articles.title: U.S. charges 5 more Canadians with voter fraud offences amid Trump administration crackdown
articles.author: Thomas Daigle

paras.en: U.S. charges 5 more Canadians with voter fraud offences amid Trump administration crackdown
paras.zh: 在特朗普政府镇压期间，美国又指控 5 名加拿大人犯有选民欺诈罪

paras.en: At least 20 Canadians now charged or sentenced in U.S. election integrity investigations this year
paras.zh: 今年至少有 20 名加拿大人在美国选举诚信调查中被指控或判刑

paras.en: The U.S. Department of Justice says charges have been laid against five more Canadians for voting fraud-related offences, the latest in a flurry of similar prosecutions ahead of next week's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 美国司法部表示，又有五名加拿大人因投票欺诈相关罪行而受到指控，这是下周中期选举前一系列类似起诉中的最新一起。

paras.en: According to a tally compiled by CBC News, at least 20 Canadians have now been either charged or sentenced in the U.S. this year in federal election integrity investigations. Most charges have been filed since last month, with allegations typically dating back several years.
paras.zh: 据 CBC News 统计，今年至少有 20 名加拿大人在美国联邦选举诚信调查中被指控或判刑。大多数指控是自上个月以来提出的，指控通常可以追溯到几年前。

paras.en: The five latest cases were announced in a series of news releases Thursday and Friday from U.S. attorney's offices in Missouri, Tennessee, North Carolina and Wisconsin. They all involve Canadians living in the U.S. — most of them listed as lawful permanent residents — accused of falsely claiming citizenship to cast a ballot, or illegally voting in a past election.
paras.zh: 密苏里州、田纳西州、北卡罗来纳州和威斯康星州的美国检察官办公室周四和周五发布了一系列新闻稿，宣布了这五起最新案件。这些案件都涉及居住在美国的加拿大人——其中大多数被列为合法永久居民——被指控谎称公民身份来投票，或在过去的选举中非法投票。

paras.en: The defendants in the latest cases are between 58 and 68 years old, according to the Department of Justice.
paras.zh: 据司法部称，最新案件中的被告年龄在 58 岁至 68 岁之间。

paras.en: "The right to vote is fundamental to American citizenship and a cornerstone of our republic," Dan Bishop, the U.S. attorney for the Middle District of North Carolina, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 北卡罗来纳州中区联邦检察官丹·毕肖普在一份声明中表示：“投票权是美国公民的基础，也是我们共和国的基石。”

paras.en: Bishop said the recent charges "serve notice that those who violate our election laws, including non-citizens who register and vote, will be investigated and prosecuted."
paras.zh: 毕夏普表示，最近的指控“表明那些违反我们选举法的人，包括登记和投票的非公民，将受到调查和起诉。”

paras.en: U.S. federal prosecutors and Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) — a branch of Immigration and Customs Enforcement — have in recent weeks repeatedly highlighted their efforts to crack down on voter fraud.
paras.zh: 美国联邦检察官和国土安全调查局（HSI）——移民和海关执法局的一个部门——最近几周反复强调他们打击选民欺诈的努力。

paras.en: "Anyone who unlawfully votes will be found and brought to justice!" HSI said Friday in a post on X.
paras.zh: “任何非法投票的人都会被找到并绳之以法！”恒指周五在 X 上发帖表示。

paras.en: This photo released by U.S. authorities claims to show a 69-year-old Canadian woman charged with 'illegal voting by an alien' during her arrest after dark. (U.S. Department of Homeland Security)
paras.zh: 美国当局发布的这张照片声称，一名 69 岁的加拿大妇女在天黑后被捕，被指控“外国人非法投票”。 （美国国土安全部）

paras.en: In one instance last week, a 69-year-old Canadian, a lawful permanent resident living in Florida, was indicted on charges of making a false statement claiming U.S. citizenship to vote and "illegal voting by an alien," prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 检察官称，上周，一名居住在佛罗里达州的合法永久居民、69 岁的加拿大人被指控做出虚假陈述，声称自己拥有美国公民投票权和“外国人非法投票”。

paras.en: The woman allegedly registered to vote in 2021 and then cast a ballot in the 2022 U.S. general election.
paras.zh: 据称，该女子在 2021 年登记投票，然后在 2022 年美国大选中投票。

paras.en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security released a photo of the woman during her arrest with her face blurred. The image appeared to show her dressed in a housecoat and slippers, surrounded by federal agents outside a home after dark.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部公布了该女子被捕时的一张脸部模糊的照片。这张照片似乎显示，天黑后，她穿着家居服和拖鞋，在一所房子外面被联邦特工包围。

paras.en: Several of the charges were brought by federal prosecutors named by the Trump administration, such as Ellis Boyle in Raleigh, N.C.
paras.zh: 其中几项指控是由特朗普政府指定的联邦检察官提出的，例如北卡罗来纳州罗利市的埃利斯·博伊尔(Ellis Boyle)。

paras.en: "This is the worst type of constitutional assault on our independence and liberty," Boyle told reporters earlier this month.
paras.zh: “这是对我们的独立和自由最严重的宪法攻击，”博伊尔本月早些时候告诉记者。

paras.en: U.S. attorney Ellis Boyle at a news conference in Washington, D.C., on April 28. (Cliff Owen/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 4 月 28 日，美国检察官埃利斯·博伊尔 (Ellis Boyle) 在华盛顿特区举行的新闻发布会上。（Cliff Owen/美联社）

paras.en: U.S. authorities have announced similar charges against citizens of several other countries including Australia, Colombia, Cuba, Jamaica and the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 美国当局已宣布对澳大利亚、哥伦比亚、古巴、牙买加和英国等其他几个国家的公民提出类似指控。

paras.en: The efforts align with U.S. President Donald Trump's long-running false claims of widespread voter fraud in federal elections.
paras.zh: 这些努力与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普长期以来关于联邦选举中普遍存在选民舞弊的虚假说法是一致的。

paras.en: "The timing tells us why it's likely they're doing this," said David Becker, executive director of the non-partisan Center for Election Innovation and Research, in a recent interview.
paras.zh: 无党派选举创新与研究中心执行主任戴维·贝克尔在最近的一次采访中表示：“时机告诉我们为什么他们可能会这样做。”

paras.en: He insisted what little non-citizen voting occurs in the U.S. has not affected the outcomes of elections.
paras.zh: 他坚称，美国很少有非公民投票，但这并不影响选举结果。

paras.en: "This is likely an attempt to try to sow doubts about the election, in advance of an election in which the president and his administration might fear the voters might reject them," Becker said.
paras.zh: 贝克尔说：“这可能是试图在选举之前制造对选举的怀疑，总统和他的政府可能担心选民可能会拒绝他们。”

paras.en: Last week, the U.S. Embassy in Ottawa said in a statement Canadians account for the "second highest total of prosecutions for fraudulent or illegal voting of any country."
paras.zh: 上周，美国驻渥太华大使馆在一份声明中表示，加拿大人“对欺诈或非法投票的起诉总数位居所有国家第二位”。

paras.en: The embassy pointedly warned "all Canadians should refrain from attempting to participate in or influence U.S. elections in any way. Americans decide America's elections."
paras.zh: 大使馆尖锐警告“所有加拿大人应避免试图以任何方式参与或影响美国选举。美国人决定美国的选举。”

paras.en: Bill Essayli, the most senior federal prosecutor in Los Angeles, said last week that 156 individuals had been charged with “voting fraud-related offences” across the country since the start of the current Trump administration.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶最资深的联邦检察官比尔·埃萨利 (Bill Essayli) 上周表示，自特朗普政府上任以来，全国已有 156 人被指控犯有“与投票欺诈相关的罪行”。

paras.en: It’s a relatively small figure, given the number of people who cast a ballot in the U.S.
paras.zh: 考虑到在美国投票的人数，这个数字相对较小。

paras.en: According to the U.S. Election Assistance Commission, more than 211 million citizens were active registered voters for the country’s 2024 general election.
paras.zh: 据美国选举援助委员会称，超过 2.11 亿公民是该国 2024 年大选的活跃登记选民。

articles.title: Decision clearing path for Russia to join world juniors in Alberta is 'very unwelcome,' minister says
articles.author: Rhianna Schmunk

paras.en: Decision clearing path for Russia to join world juniors in Alberta is 'very unwelcome,' minister says
paras.zh: 部长表示，为俄罗斯加入阿尔伯塔省世界青少年赛扫清道路的决定“非常不受欢迎”

paras.en: Anita Anand says 'all options are on the table' for Canada before hockey championship
paras.zh: 安妮塔·阿南德表示，在冰球锦标赛之前，加拿大“所有选择都已摆在桌面上”

paras.en: Two Canadian ministers say the decision to let Russia back into the ice hockey world championships came as a disappointment on Friday, as the country's ongoing invasion of Ukraine stretches toward its fifth year.
paras.zh: 两名加拿大部长表示，周五让俄罗斯重返冰球世界锦标赛的决定令人失望，因为该国对乌克兰的持续入侵已进入第五个年头。

paras.en: Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand said the Canadian government is still assessing the ruling from the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), but said she was "not comfortable" with potentially allowing a Russian team to attend this year's World Junior Ice Hockey Championships in Alberta.
paras.zh: 外交部长安妮塔·阿南德表示，加拿大政府仍在评估体育仲裁法院（CAS）的裁决，但表示她对允许俄罗斯队参加今年在阿尔伯塔省举行的世界青少年冰球锦标赛感到“不安”。

paras.en: "Make no mistake, this is a very unwelcome decision given the geopolitical situation, given the actions of Russia," Anand told CBC's Power & Politics. "All options are on the table and I will say, again, I greet this decision with great disappointment."
paras.zh: 阿南德对加拿大广播公司的《权力与政治》节目表示：“毫无疑问，考虑到地缘政治局势和俄罗斯的行为，这是一个非常不受欢迎的决定。” “所有选择都摆在桌面上，我要再说一遍，我对这个决定感到非常失望。”

paras.en: The CAS cleared the path on Friday for Russia to return to the ice hockey world championships, overturning an exclusion in place since the country invaded Ukraine in early 2022.
paras.zh: CAS 周五为俄罗斯重返冰球世锦赛扫清了道路，推翻了自 2022 年初俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以来的排除规定。

paras.en: Hockey Canada echoed Anand's disappointment, as did Canada's Secretary of State for Sport Adam van Koeverden.
paras.zh: 加拿大冰球协会和加拿大体育大臣亚当·范·科弗登（Adam van Koeverden）也表达了阿南德的失望之情。

paras.en: "Canada maintains, as it has since 2022, that Russia should not be represented in international sport competitions while Russia's illegal and unjustifiable full-scale invasion against Ukraine continues," van Koeverden wrote in his own statement.
paras.zh: 范·科埃弗登在自己的声明中写道：“加拿大自 2022 年以来一直坚持认为，在俄罗斯继续非法且无理地全面入侵乌克兰的情况下，俄罗斯不应参加国际体育比赛。”

paras.en: The court's ruling overturned International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) decisions, which had banned Russia and Belarus from international tournaments since Feb. 28, 2022. The federation, while disappointed with the decision, said on Friday it would "act in accordance" with the ruling.
paras.zh: 法院的裁决推翻了国际冰球联合会 (IIHF) 的决定，该决定自 2022 年 2 月 28 日起禁止俄罗斯和白俄罗斯参加国际比赛。该联合会虽然对这一决定感到失望，但周五表示将“按照”裁决行事。

paras.en: This year's world juniors are scheduled for Dec. 26, 2026, to Jan. 5, 2027, in Alberta in Red Deer and Edmonton.
paras.zh: 今年的世界青少年赛定于2026年12月26日至2027年1月5日在艾伯塔省的红鹿市和埃德蒙顿举行。

paras.en: Ministers boycott group photo with Russian counterpart at G20
paras.zh: 部长们抵制在G20峰会上与俄罗斯外长合影

paras.en: Also on Friday, the United States cancelled a traditional group photo the G20 Foreign Ministers Meeting in Atlanta after several European officials threatened to boycott the picture over the inclusion of Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov.
paras.zh: 同样在周五，美国取消了在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团（G20）外长会议上的传统合影，此前几名欧洲官员因俄罗斯外长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫（Sergey Lavrov）的加入而威胁要抵制合影。

paras.en: In her interview, Anand said she was going to miss the picture because she was on a flight to the Canada–EU summit in Montreal, but, had she been there, she said she would've joined her fellow ministers in skipping the picture in protest.
paras.zh: 阿南德在接受采访时表示，她会错过这张照片，因为她正在飞往蒙特利尔举行的加拿大-欧盟峰会的航班上，但如果她在那里，她说她会和部长们一起跳过这张照片以示抗议。

paras.en: "It is not my preference at all to be in a picture with Sergey Lavrov," she said.
paras.zh: “我根本不喜欢与谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫合影，”她说。

paras.en: Speaking on the issue of hockey in Atlanta, Anand told reporters Canada would "continue to maintain our own restrictions on the participation of Russian athletes at events hosted in Canada that receive federal funding."
paras.zh: 阿南德在亚特兰大谈到曲棍球问题时告诉记者，加拿大将“继续维持我们对俄罗斯运动员参加在加拿大举办的接受联邦资助的赛事的限制”。

paras.en: The federal government had not yet committed any money to the 2027 world junior tournament, according to Hockey Canada.
paras.zh: 据加拿大冰球协会称，联邦政府尚未为 2027 年世界青少年锦标赛投入任何资金。

paras.en: Russia's Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, centre, attends the G20 Foreign Ministers Meeting in Atlanta on Friday. (Megan Varner/Pool/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫（中）周五出席在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团外长会议。 （梅根·瓦尔纳/普尔/美联社）

paras.en: Anand said she sat directly across from Lavrov during the meetings in Atlanta, looked the Russian minister "straight in the eye" and told him Russian's ongoing attacks in Ukraine are "absolutely reprehensible and contrary to international law."
paras.zh: 阿南德说，在亚特兰大举行的会议期间，她坐在拉夫罗夫的对面，“直视俄罗斯部长的眼睛”，并告诉他俄罗斯在乌克兰的持续袭击“绝对应受谴责，违反国际法”。

paras.en: Some G20 countries had already expressed concern at the U.S. having invited Russia to the meetings, especially after U.S. President Donald Trump drove his administration's relationship with Ukraine to deeper lows by waiving fresh sanctions on Moscow and temporarily limiting logistical and intelligence assistance.
paras.zh: 一些G20国家已经对美国邀请俄罗斯参加会议表示担忧，特别是在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普通过放弃对莫斯科的新制裁并暂时限制后勤和情报援助，将其政府与乌克兰的关系推向更深层次之后。

paras.en: The Canadian government has expressed solidarity with Ukraine from the outset and the two countries declared a 100-year partnership last month.
paras.zh: 加拿大政府从一开始就表达了对乌克兰的声援，两国上个月宣布建立100年伙伴关系。

articles.title: Germany takes cautious approach on Israeli election results

paras.en: Though it has been two days since Israel's parliamentary elections, German politicians are still being cautious to respond, as it is still unclear who will lead Israel's new government.
paras.zh: 尽管以色列议会选举已经过去两天，但德国政界人士仍谨慎回应，因为目前尚不清楚谁将领导以色列新政府。

paras.en: Although the right-wing bloc, including religious hardliners, led by incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is ahead of the opposition bloc led by former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, neither has a clear path to a governing majority in the Knesset.
paras.zh: 尽管由现任总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的包括宗教强硬派在内的右翼集团领先于前军事首长加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派集团，但两者都没有明确的途径获得议会多数席位。

paras.en: Forming a coalition government is likely to be extremely difficult.
paras.zh: 组建联合政府可能极其困难。

paras.en: Martin Giese, spokesperson for German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul, declined to comment at Wednesday's regular government press conference in Berlin.
paras.zh: 德国外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔发言人马丁·吉斯拒绝在周三于柏林举行的政府例行新闻发布会上发表评论。

paras.en: But he did stress that Germany has been in contact with numerous officials and politicians in Israel via Germany's ambassador. "The Jewish state and Germany are inextricably linked by our history, and we will do everything we can to work well with any future government," Wadephul said.
paras.zh: 但他确实强调，德国一直通过德国大使与以色列的众多官员和政界人士保持联系。瓦德菲尔说：“犹太国家和德国在历史上有着千丝万缕的联系，我们将尽一切努力与未来的政府良好合作。”

paras.en: Alabali Radovan: 'Winter in Gaza will be difficult'
paras.zh: 阿拉巴利·拉多万：“加沙的冬天将会很艰难”

paras.en: One concern for the German government is providing aid to the people in Gaza, and protracted coalition negotiations could delay necessary progress.
paras.zh: 德国政府担心的一个问题是向加沙人民提供援助，而旷日持久的联盟谈判可能会推迟必要的进展。

paras.en: "Winter is coming, and it will be difficult," Development Minister Reem Alabali Radovan, currently visiting Lebanon, warned in an interview with Politico. She underlined that there must be more opportunities for aid organizations to provide crucial assistance in Gaza and that it cannot wait for coalition negotiations.
paras.zh: 目前正在访问黎巴嫩的发展部长雷姆·阿拉巴利·拉多万在接受 Politico 采访时警告说：“冬天即将到来，这将是困难的。”她强调，援助组织必须有更多机会在加沙提供关键援助，不能等待联盟谈判。

paras.en: In interviews with DW and broadcaster RTL, she spoke about the recent increase in attacks by Israeli settlers on Palestinians in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 在接受德国之声和RTL广播公司采访时，她谈到了以色列定居者最近在被占领的约旦河西岸和东耶路撒冷对巴勒斯坦人的袭击有所增加。

paras.en: "The radical settler violence must be stopped. The Netanyahu government remains in office on an interim basis, and this means that this situation must still be brought to an end," she said.
paras.zh: “激进的定居者暴力行为必须停止。内塔尼亚胡政府仍暂时执政，这意味着这种情况仍然必须结束，”她说。

paras.en: All settlement activity in the occupied Palestinian territories is considered illegal under international law.
paras.zh: 根据国际法，巴勒斯坦被占领土上的所有定居活动都被视为非法。

paras.en: More distanced from Netanyahu's government
paras.zh: 与内塔尼亚胡政府的距离越来越远

paras.en: Relations between Germany and Israel are traditionally close, in part because of Germany's historical responsibility for Nazi Germany's murder of millions of Jews during the Holocaust.
paras.zh: 德国和以色列之间的关系历来密切，部分原因是德国对纳粹德国在大屠杀期间杀害数百万犹太人负有历史责任。

paras.en: Recently, however, the German government has distanced itself from Netanyahu's policies, at least in its public rhetoric.
paras.zh: 然而，最近德国政府与内塔尼亚胡的政策保持了距离，至少在公开言论上是这样。

paras.en: Most recently, Wadephul said after a major Israeli military operation near the city of Hebron: "Under international law, Israel is quite clearly obligated to uphold and protect the rights of Palestinians as well." Around 3,000 Palestinians were driven from their homes during the operation, which followed the reported killing of two Israeli soldiers by Palestinians.
paras.zh: 最近，瓦德菲尔在以色列在希伯伦市附近发动重大军事行动后表示：“根据国际法，以色列也有明确义务维护和保护巴勒斯坦人的权利。”据报道，两名以色列士兵被巴勒斯坦人杀害，行动期间约有 3,000 名巴勒斯坦人被赶出家园。

paras.en: In Berlin, there has long been speculation about whether Germany's policy toward Israel might change after Israel's 2026 election.
paras.zh: 在柏林，长期以来人们一直猜测德国对以色列的政策是否会在以色列2026年大选后发生变化。

paras.en: So far, one thing is clear: Unlike numerous other countries, including some in Europe, Germany does not intend to recognize a Palestinian state for the time being.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，有一件事是明确的：与包括欧洲一些国家在内的许多其他国家不同，德国暂时不打算承认巴勒斯坦国。

paras.en: At the same time, Germany hopes that the future government will no longer include religious extremists, and in some cases far-right, politicians such as the current Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich.
paras.zh: 与此同时，德国希望未来的政府不再包括宗教极端分子，在某些情况下还包括现任财政部长贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇等极右政客。

paras.en: "I think it would be best for Israel to form a government that is closer to the center of the political spectrum," Jürgen Hardt, foreign policy expert for the conservative Christian Democratic Union (CDU) in the Bundestag, told DW. "Of course, that's something the people, and above all the elected politicians, will have to figure out. But it's encouraging that so many people participated in the election."
paras.zh: 德国联邦议院保守派基督教民主联盟（CDU）外交政策专家于尔根·哈特（Jürgen Hardt）告诉德国之声：“我认为以色列最好组建一个更接近政治光谱中心的政府。” “当然，这是人民，尤其是当选的政客必须弄清楚的事情。但令人鼓舞的是，有这么多人参与了选举。”

paras.en: The Arab-majority parties led by Palestinian citizens of Israel made large gains in this election. They are usually classified as part of the current opposition camp. The historic results by these parties could lead them to play a kingmaker role in coalition formation.
paras.zh: 以色列巴勒斯坦公民领导的阿拉伯占多数的政党在这次选举中取得了巨大进展。他们通常被归类为当前反对派阵营的一部分。这些政党取得的历史性成果可能会导致他们在组建联合政府中发挥造王者的作用。

paras.en: However, Netanyahu’s bloc have ruled out working with the Arab-majority parties.
paras.zh: 然而，内塔尼亚胡集团已经排除了与阿拉伯占多数的政党合作的可能性。

paras.en: Eisenkot's opposition bloc has not yet said whether it would be willing to form such a coalition, but one of the Arab-majority parties, United Arab List/Ra'am, featured a Jewish candidate, and has stated its willingness to work with Eisenkot’s bloc to unseat Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的反对派集团尚未表示是否愿意组建这样的联盟，但阿拉伯占多数的政党之一阿拉伯联合名单/拉姆党以一名犹太候选人为特色，并表示愿意与艾森科特的集团合作推翻内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Hardt believes a minority government led by Eisenkot and supported by parties representing Arab Israelis is conceivable.
paras.zh: 哈特认为，由艾森科特领导并得到代表阿拉伯以色列人的政党支持的少数派政府是可以想象的。

paras.en: "The major campaign carried out by Netanyahu's camp, aimed primarily against Arab Israelis, greatly mobilized the opposition, to the point where his camp no longer has a majority."
paras.zh: “内塔尼亚胡阵营主要针对阿拉伯以色列人开展的重大运动极大地动员了反对派，以至于他的阵营不再占多数。”

paras.en: The vice president of the German Bundestag, Green Party politician Omid Nouripour, told DW: "Frankly, after all the turmoil that has occurred — for example, regarding judicial reform — this is good news for Israeli democracy."
paras.zh: 德国联邦议院副议长、绿党政治家奥米德·努里普尔(Omid Nouripour)对德国之声表示：“坦率地说，在发生了所有动荡之后——例如司法改革——这对以色列民主来说是个好消息。”

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Smuggling, power, profit: Irregular migration out of eastern Libya

paras.en: This year, almost 20,000 people have already tried to make the perilous crossing from Libya in north Africa to the Greek island of Crete.
paras.zh: 今年，已有近两万人尝试从北非利比亚危险地穿越希腊克里特岛。

paras.en: The route, which runs from the east coast of Libya to Greece, has become an increasingly significant corridor for irregular migration into Europe, Greek daily Kathimerini recently reported.
paras.zh: 据希腊日报《Kathimerini》最近报道，这条从利比亚东海岸通往希腊的路线已成为非正常移民进入欧洲的一条日益重要的走廊。

paras.en: On Oct. 20 alone, Greek authorities registered 710 people in 14 boats. Hundreds more arrived the next day.
paras.zh: 仅 10 月 20 日，希腊当局就登记了 14 艘船上的 710 人。第二天又有数百人抵达。

paras.en: Many of the boats depart from areas around Tobruk, a port city on Libya's eastern Mediterranean coast. According to Kathimerini, migrants pay as much as $4,000 (€3,600) for the crossing, which takes around a day and a half.
paras.zh: 许多船只从利比亚地中海东部沿岸港口城市托布鲁克周边地区出发。 Kathimerini 表示，移民需要支付高达 4,000 美元（3,600 欧元）的过境费用，大约需要一天半的时间。

paras.en: This particular route is becoming more popular in part because of crackdowns on alternative passages.
paras.zh: 这条特殊路线变得越来越受欢迎，部分原因是对替代通道的打击。

paras.en: After eastern Libyan armed forces acted against people smugglers heading for Italy in 2023, the smuggling networks changed their methods, using smaller boats and sailing them towards Crete instead.
paras.zh: 2023年，利比亚东部武装部队打击前往意大利的人口走私者后，走私网络改变了方法，改用较小的船只，将其驶向克里特岛。

paras.en: According to the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime, a think tank based in Switzerland, other groups have since entered the people smuggling business too, including those who previously mostly moved goods, vehicles or drugs.
paras.zh: 总部位于瑞士的智囊团“打击跨国有组织犯罪全球倡议”表示，此后其他组织也涉足人口走私业务，其中包括以前主要从事货物、车辆或毒品运输的组织。

paras.en: Human trafficking in Libya is closely connected with what is known as the "conflict economy."
paras.zh: 利比亚的人口贩运与所谓的“冲突经济”密切相关。

paras.en: This sees armed actors gaining economic resources and political influence by controlling informal markets and transport routes. It also sees local power brokers using measures against smuggling to obtain financial or political support for themselves.
paras.zh: 这使得武装分子通过控制非正规市场和运输路线获得经济资源和政治影响力。它还看到当地权力掮客利用打击走私的措施为自己获取财政或政治支持。

paras.en: "Conflict and subsequent instability in Libya have created a fertile environment for migrant smuggling and TIP [trafficking in persons] activities to develop, in turn leading to the growth of smuggling in other locations along an established route," researchers at British think tank Chatham House wrote, after looking in depth at three different transit hubs across Libya. "This has led to an increase in the number of migrants entering Libya and the expansion of Libya's conflict economy."
paras.zh: 英国智库查塔姆研究所的研究人员在深入研究了利比亚三个不同的交通枢纽后写道：“利比亚的冲突和随后的不稳定局势为移民偷运和人口贩运活动的发展创造了肥沃的环境，进而导致既定路线上其他地点的偷运活动增加。” “这导致进入利比亚的移民人数增加以及利比亚冲突经济的扩张。”

paras.en: "It remains the case that an entire business has developed around smuggling routes, regardless of whether that [smuggling] involves weapons, goods, people or drugs," Hager Ali, a researcher at the German Institute for Global and Area Studies, or GIGA, told DW.
paras.zh: 德国全球与地区研究所（GIGA）研究员哈格·阿里（Hager Ali）告诉德国之声：“整个行业仍然围绕着走私路线发展起来，无论走私是否涉及武器、货物、人口或毒品。”

paras.en: If there are already contacts, transportation and security arrangements in place, then these can also be used for illegal activities like people trafficking, Ali said. Since 2014, Libya has been split into two. In the west, a United Nations-backed administration is based in Tripol; and in the east, in Tobruk, the second Libyan leadership is backed by former warlord-turned-politician Khalifa Haftar.
paras.zh: 阿里说，如果已经有联系、交通和安全安排，那么这些也可以用于贩运人口等非法活动。自2014年以来，利比亚分裂为两部分。在西方，联合国支持的政府总部设在的黎波里；在东部的托布鲁克，利比亚第二届领导层得到了前军阀出身的政治家哈利法·哈夫塔尔的支持。

paras.en: Haftar has managed to consolidate control over various armed militias, ruling with an iron fist. His sons also hold important positions. However, there are no proven links between the Haftars' networks and people smugglers on that coast.
paras.zh: 哈夫塔尔成功巩固了对各种武装民兵的控制，实行铁腕统治。他的儿子们也担任重要职务。然而，哈夫塔尔网络与该海岸的人口走私者之间没有经过证实的联系。

paras.en: But, as Ali explained, even the appearance of having some influence over these sectors can confer political influence.
paras.zh: 但是，正如阿里所解释的那样，即使表面上对这些部门有一定的影响力也可以带来政治影响力。

paras.en: "The more apparent control one has over this market, the greater one's influence," Ali told DW.
paras.zh: 阿里告诉德国之声：“一个人对这个市场的控制力越明显，他的影响力就越大。”

paras.en: Those Libyans who can influence, or even prevent, departures are demonstrating their importance to other actors. For example, high profile operations against the smuggling networks can serve as a sign of political legitimacy. "They present themselves as somebody who can restore order and curb migration," Ali noted.
paras.zh: 那些能够影响甚至阻止撤离的利比亚人正在向其他行动者展示自己的重要性。例如，针对走私网络的高调行动可以作为政治合法性的标志。阿里指出：“他们把自己描绘成能够恢复秩序和遏制移民的人。”

paras.en: There's also increasing geopolitical competition in the eastern Mediterranean. In late October, the Tobruk government signed a maritime agreement with Turkey, a deal that Turkey had actually originally concluded with Libya's other government in Tripoli.
paras.zh: 地中海东部地区的地缘政治竞争也日益加剧。 10月下旬，托布鲁克政府与土耳其签署了一项海事协议，该协议实际上是土耳其最初与利比亚在的黎波里的另一个政府达成的。

paras.en: Turkey previously fought Haftar-sponsored militias during the Libyan civil war, and this deal represents rapprochement between the two. It is also a way for Turkey to get what it wants in a rivalrous situation in this maritime area — Greece rejects the agreement, saying that it infringes on Greek economic rights around islands like Crete and Rhodes.
paras.zh: 土耳其此前曾在利比亚内战期间与哈夫塔尔支持的民兵作战，这项协议代表了两国之间的和解。这也是土耳其在该海域竞争局势中获得其想要的一种方式——希腊拒绝该协议，称其侵犯了希腊在克里特岛和罗德岛等岛屿周围的经济权利。

paras.en: A direct link between the new agreement and rising numbers of irregular migrants in Crete is not clear. However, Ali suggested that it wouldn't be inconceivable that irregular migrants could be used as leverage in these kinds of geopolitical conflicts.
paras.zh: 新协议与克里特岛非正规移民数量增加之间的直接联系尚不清楚。然而，阿里表示，非正规移民被用作此类地缘政治冲突的杠杆并非不可想象。

paras.en: The European Union has been cooperating with Libyans to prevent irregular migrants from getting to Europe — despite the Libyan actors' links to armed groups and their disputed political legitimacy.
paras.zh: 欧盟一直在与利比亚人合作，防止非正常移民进入欧洲——尽管利比亚行为者与武装团体有联系，其政治合法性也存在争议。

paras.en: There's an obvious contradiction in that, argued Andreas Dittmann, a retired professor from Giessen University and expert on human geography and development. Such cooperation between the EU and Libyans can serve as a control on irregular migration but it also adds to the Libyans' local power.
paras.zh: 吉森大学退休教授、人文地理学和发展专家安德烈亚斯·迪特曼认为，这其中存在明显的矛盾。欧盟和利比亚人之间的这种合作可以起到控制非正常移民的作用，但它也增强了利比亚人的当地力量。

paras.en: "If those in charge in eastern Libya are actually able to influence the scale and timing of such [migrant] movements, they're demonstrating their own strategic importance to European governments," Dittmann told DW.
paras.zh: 迪特曼对德国之声表示：“如果利比亚东部的负责人确实能够影响此类[移民]流动的规模和时间，那么他们就向欧洲各国政府展示了自己的战略重要性。”

paras.en: A report by the United Nations' International Organization for Migration, or IOM, illustrated how precarious the situation is for many migrants.
paras.zh: 联合国国际移民组织（IOM）的一份报告说明了许多移民的处境是多么不稳定。

paras.en: According to the report, which is based on data from May and June this year, around 950,000 migrants and refugees were registered as living in Libya. Many have only limited access to healthcare and tend not to have residence or work permits, all of which increases their dependence on informal markets as well as the risk of exploitation.
paras.zh: 这份基于今年五月和六月数据的报告称，约有95万名移民和难民登记居住在利比亚。许多人获得医疗保健的机会有限，而且往往没有居住或工作许可证，所有这些都增加了他们对非正规市场的依赖以及被剥削的风险。

paras.en: This story was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初以德语发表。

articles.title: Canadian PM Mark Carney discusses talks with the EU, overdependence on the US and how to deal with Donald Trump in a DW interview.

paras.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke to DW on Friday after talks in Montreal with European Union leaders seeking to hammer out details of a new, closer partnership between Canada and the EU.
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼周五在蒙特利尔与欧盟领导人会谈后接受德国之声采访，寻求敲定加拿大与欧盟之间新的、更紧密的伙伴关系的细节。

paras.en: Amid difficult negotiations with US President Donald Trump, representing Canada's biggest trading partner, Carney said that he and his compatriots had come to realize the country was too dependent on the economic powerhouse to the south.
paras.zh: 在与代表加拿大最大贸易伙伴的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普进行艰难谈判时，卡尼表示，他和他的同胞已经意识到加拿大过于依赖南方的经济强国。

paras.en: "The lesson we've taken, Canadians as a whole, is we're overdependent on the United States. Too closely connected to the United States. And we need to build our strength here at home and diversify and deepen our partnerships with like-minded countries internationally," Carney said.
paras.zh: 卡尼说：“作为一个整体，加拿大人得到的教训是，我们过度依赖美国。与美国联系太紧密。我们需要在国内增强我们的实力，并在国际上使我们与志同道合的国家的伙伴关系多样化和深化。”

paras.en: What did Carney say about EU talks and closer ties to the bloc?
paras.zh: 卡尼对欧盟谈判和与欧盟建立更密切的关系有何看法？

paras.en: An EU delegation led by European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa held talks with Carney and other Canadian officials in Montreal on Friday.
paras.zh: 由欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩和欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔率领的欧盟代表团周五在蒙特利尔与卡尼和其他加拿大官员举行了会谈。

paras.en: They're discussing the plans floated by Commission President Ursula von der Leyen to forge what she called an "associate membership" — a status that does not yet exist for any other country — even as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's government resists creating this label. Carney seemed to speak in its favor.
paras.zh: 他们正在讨论欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩提出的计划，旨在打造她所谓的“准会员”——这种地位在任何其他国家都尚不存在——尽管德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨政府拒绝创建这个标签。卡尼似乎对此表示赞成。

paras.en: "Well, I think the advantage of what we're doing is that a few things are absolutely clear, irrespective of the exact terminology that's used. President von der Leyen uses associated membership. We use associated membership," he told DW's Katharina Kroll at Port of Montreal Tower.
paras.zh: “嗯，我认为我们正在做的事情的优点是，无论使用什么确切的术语，有些事情都是绝对清楚的。冯德莱恩总统使用关联会员资格。我们使用关联会员资格，”他在蒙特利尔港塔告诉德国之声的凯瑟琳娜·克罗尔。

paras.en: "What does that mean? It means the closest possible partnership without being a full member of the European Union, because Canada is not in Europe geographically and therefore cannot have accession." Carney said.
paras.zh: “这意味着什么？这意味着在不成为欧盟正式成员的情况下尽可能最密切的伙伴关系，因为加拿大在地理上不属于欧洲，因此无法加入。”卡尼说。

paras.en: What scope for EU-Canada cooperation does Carney see?
paras.zh: 卡尼认为欧盟与加拿大的合作范围有多大？

paras.en: Asked if he was looking to create a "new transatlantic bloc without the US," Carney said it was more about diversifying and deepening Canada's other partnerships than excluding by far its largest trading partner.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否打算建立一个“没有美国的新跨大西洋集团”时，卡尼表示，这更多的是为了多元化和深化加拿大的其他伙伴关系，而不是排除迄今为止最大的贸易伙伴。

paras.en: "We're both partners of the United States, obviously close partners, alliance partners in NATO. And there are many, many opportunities for cooperation with the United States," he said. "But in many cases, there'll be much deeper cooperation for Canada between Canada and Europe than Canada and the United States."
paras.zh: “我们都是美国的合作伙伴，显然是密切的合作伙伴，北约的联盟伙伴。与美国的合作有很多很多的机会，”他说。 “但在很多情况下，加拿大与欧洲之间的合作比加拿大与美国之间的合作要深入得多。”

paras.en: He mentioned both existing areas of cooperation like the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), calling it "one of the most successful free trade agreements in the world," and also pointed to research cooperation and programs like Horizon Europe and Erasmus+ enabling student exchanges.
paras.zh: 他提到了全面经济贸易协定（CETA）等现有合作领域，称其为“世界上最成功的自由贸易协定之一”，并指出了研究合作以及Horizo​​n Europe和Erasmus+等促进学生交流的项目。

paras.en: But Carney also pointed to areas where the two sides could seek to expand cooperation, naming areas like space technologies, artificial intelligence and critical minerals.
paras.zh: 但卡尼还指出了双方可以寻求扩大合作的领域，包括太空技术、人工智能和关键矿产等领域。

paras.en: Is Canada concerned the talks could alienate the US, or Trump?
paras.zh: 加拿大是否担心谈判可能会疏远美国或特朗普？

paras.en: Despite his well-documented difficulties with Donald Trump — perhaps most crudely exemplified by Trump's attempts to unilaterally rename Lake Ontario, or his posting AI videos imagining him as an ice hockey player beating Carney up in a fight — Carney said US-Canadian ties were too deep to be derailed by any governments or prime ministers or presidents.
paras.zh: 尽管他与唐纳德·特朗普之间的矛盾有据可查——也许最粗暴的例子是特朗普试图单方面重新命名安大略湖，或者他发布人工智能视频，将他想象成一名冰球运动员在打斗中殴打卡尼——但卡尼表示，美加关系太深厚，任何政府、总理或总统都无法破坏。

paras.en: "The bonds between Canadians and Americans are longstanding. They're very strong. And big elements of that will be maintained regardless of the government in Canada, the government in the United States, the combination of the two," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“加拿大人和美国人之间的联系由来已久。它们非常牢固。无论加拿大政府、美国政府或两者的结合如何，这种关系的重要组成部分都将维持下去。”

paras.en: Asked about the best way to deal with Trump, Carney said it was "to be direct, to be clear, to be absolutely clear about your bottom lines are." He said it was important to show respect but also to continue to bring "the negotiations back to the core issues."
paras.zh: 当被问及与特朗普打交道的最佳方式时，卡尼表示，那就是“直接、明确、绝对清楚你的底线是什么。”他表示，表达尊重很重要，但也要继续“让谈判回到核心问题”。

paras.en: But he said the tensions with Trump had demonstrated the need to diversify and to seek Canada's other most natural partners around the world.
paras.zh: 但他表示，与特朗普的紧张关系表明有必要实现多元化，并在世界各地寻找加拿大其他最自然的合作伙伴。

paras.en: He acknowledged that no matter the nature of the talks with the EU, "the scale of the relationship with the United States" would be "very hard to replace."
paras.zh: 他承认，无论与欧盟谈判的性质如何，“与美国的关系规模”都将“很难替代”。

paras.en: Asked if he was concerned that the talks could expose him to further tariffs or other punitive measures from the Trump administration, Carney said, "We've been living with this for some time."
paras.zh: 当被问及是否担心谈判可能会让他面临特朗普政府的进一步关税或其他惩罚措施时，卡尼表示，“我们已经忍受这种情况有一段时间了。”

paras.en: "There have been many justifications for trade action against Canada that the United States has had," he said. "Our view is that all of them are unjustified under our trade agreement."
paras.zh: “美国对加拿大采取贸易行动有很多理由，”他说。 “我们的观点是，根据我们的贸易协议，所有这些都是不合理的。”

paras.en: Carney said the crucial message, also for the Trump White House, was that the talks with Brussels concerned a "positive association" and partnership "to help solve global problems" and address global challenges.
paras.zh: 卡尼表示，对特朗普白宫来说，重要的信息是，与布鲁塞尔的会谈涉及“积极的联系”和伙伴关系，“帮助解决全球问题”和应对全球挑战。

paras.en: "It's not against somebody. It's for. It's a positive act," he said.
paras.zh: “这不是针对某人。这是为了。这是一种积极的行为，”他说。

paras.en: DW's Katharina Kroll conducted the interview in Montreal.
paras.zh: 德国之声的凯瑟琳娜·克罗尔在蒙特利尔进行了采访。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: US greenlights $2.1bn Patriot missile sale to Ukraine

paras.en: The United States says it has approved the possible sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine for an estimated $2.1bn.
paras.zh: 美国表示，已批准向乌克兰出售 500 枚爱国者 PAC-3 导弹，价值估计为 21 亿美元。

paras.en: The package of missiles, parts and support, announced on Friday by the US State Department, would be one of the most significant steps to supply defensive weapons to Kyiv since the start of the second administration of President Donald Trump in January 2025.
paras.zh: 美国国务院周五宣布的导弹、零部件和支持一揽子计划将是自 2025 年 1 月唐纳德·特朗普总统第二届政府上台以来向基辅提供防御武器的最重要步骤之一。

paras.en: The Patriot system is the most effective weapon to counter fast-moving ballistic missiles.
paras.zh: 爱国者系统是对抗快速移动弹道导弹的最有效武器。

paras.en: Delayed missile deliveries, however, have stoked US-Ukraine tensions after Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia and criticised Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy for his unwillingness to stop attacks on Russian refineries.
paras.zh: 然而，在特朗普宣布与俄罗斯达成柴油协议并批评乌克兰总统泽连斯基不愿停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击后，导弹交付的延迟加剧了美乌紧张关系。

paras.en: Ukraine has long said it urgently needs more missile interceptors to knock down the growing waves of missiles Russia’s military fires at the country.
paras.zh: 乌克兰长期以来一直表示，它迫切需要更多的导弹拦截器来击落俄罗斯向该国发射的越来越多的导弹。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said on Monday that Kyiv had been waiting for almost a month for Washington to sign off on critical missile supplies, as Russia stepped up its attacks on Ukrainian energy and civilian infrastructure.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周一表示，随着俄罗斯加大对乌克兰能源和民用基础设施的攻击力度，基辅已经等待华盛顿签署关键导弹供应协议近一个月了。

paras.en: A Russian drone strike on Thursday killed at least 14 people on a crowded rail platform in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro.
paras.zh: 周四，俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰第聂伯罗市一个拥挤的火车站台，造成至少 14 人死亡。

paras.en: Five people were killed in daytime strikes on two other cities, and a late-evening missile strike killed one person in the capital, Kyiv, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，白天对另外两个城市的袭击造成五人死亡，深夜的导弹袭击在首都基辅造成一人死亡。

paras.en: Despite Ukraine’s need for quick deliveries of the missiles, Kyiv is unlikely to receive the Patriot interceptors soon. Weapons sales typically take years to fulfil.
paras.zh: 尽管乌克兰需要快速交付导弹，但基辅不太可能很快收到爱国者拦截弹。武器销售通常需要数年时间才能完成。

paras.en: Two people briefed on the US decision said the missiles, which have yet to be made, are not expected to be delivered until a couple of years into the 2030s.
paras.zh: 两名了解美国决定的人士表示，这些导弹尚未制造，预计要到 2030 年代几年后才会交付。

paras.en: Ukraine will pay for the missiles with contributions from Canada, Germany and Norway through a programme called US JUMPSTART, along with national funds financed by the European Union’s Ukraine Support Loan, the State Department said in its statement.
paras.zh: 美国国务院在声明中表示，乌克兰将通过一项名为“US JUMPSTART”的计划，利用加拿大、德国和挪威的捐款以及欧盟乌克兰支持贷款资助的国家资金来支付这些导弹的费用。

paras.en: US weapons manufacturer Lockheed Martin is the principal contractor for the sale of the Patriot interceptors.
paras.zh: 美国武器制造商洛克希德·马丁公司是爱国者拦截弹销售的主要承包商。

paras.en: The US Army awarded Lockheed a contract worth up to $58.6bn to produce Patriot interceptor missiles in July.
paras.zh: 7月份，美国陆军授予洛克希德公司一份价值高达586亿美元的合同，生产爱国者拦截导弹。

paras.en: Lockheed has said the deal would allow it to follow through on a promise to triple PAC-3 production capacity by the end of 2030. It has previously announced that Patriot PAC-3 missile interceptor production would reach 2,000 units annually.
paras.zh: 洛克希德公司表示，这笔交易将使其能够兑现到 2030 年底将 PAC-3 产能提高两倍的承诺。该公司此前曾宣布，爱国者 PAC-3 导弹拦截器的年产量将达到 2,000 枚。

paras.en: Pentagon negotiators are pressing weapons contractors to speed up production.
paras.zh: 五角大楼谈判代表正在敦促武器承包商加快生产。

paras.en: The US military’s supply of large quantities of weapons to allies and its own heavy munitions use for its operations in Iran have raised concerns about its inventories of key air defence and precision-guided weapons.
paras.zh: 美军向盟国提供大量武器，以及在伊朗行动中使用重型弹药，引发了人们对其关键防空和精确制导武器库存的担忧。

articles.title: Why are US, Russia and China racing to put nuclear reactors on the moon?

paras.en: The United States, Russia and China are racing to build nuclear reactors on the moon, as scientists warn about the possible risk of a radioactive mishap.
paras.zh: 美国、俄罗斯和中国正在竞相在月球上建造核反应堆，科学家警告称可能存在放射性事故的风险。

paras.en: In January, NASA, the US space agency, announced plans to develop a nuclear reactor on the moon by the end of 2030. Russia, working with China, aims to do the same by 2036 as they strive to advance space exploration.
paras.zh: 今年 1 月，美国宇航局 (NASA) 宣布计划到 2030 年底在月球上开发核反应堆。俄罗斯与中国合作，计划到 2036 年实现同样的目标，并努力推进太空探索。

paras.en: The reactors will be needed to power mining of frozen water trapped deep in the moon’s craters, which scientists believe could supply drinking water, air, and rocket fuel for future bases. The reactors would also provide power for lunar bases.
paras.zh: 这些反应堆将用于为月球陨石坑深处的冰水开采提供动力，科学家认为这些冰水可以为未来的基地提供饮用水、空气和火箭燃料。这些反应堆还将为月球基地提供电力。

paras.en: Which countries want to put nuclear reactors on the moon?
paras.zh: 哪些国家想在月球上建核反应堆？

paras.en: The US said NASA’s Lunar Reactor 1 would produce 20 kilowatts of electricity, creating enough power to run on its own for five years without maintenance.
paras.zh: 美国表示，NASA 的月球反应堆 1 号将产生 20 千瓦的电力，足以在无需维护的情况下自行运行五年。

paras.en: NASA’s reactor is designed to be compact, weighing under 6,000kg (13,200 lbs) and will fit inside a rocket compartment measuring 3.7 metres (12 feet) long by 5.5 metres (18 ft) wide.
paras.zh: NASA 的反应堆设计紧凑，重量低于 6,000 公斤（13,200 磅），可安装在长 3.7 米（12 英尺）、宽 5.5 米（18 英尺）的火箭舱内。

paras.en: Russia is also building a nuclear reactor, which is expected to produce 10 kilowatts. The reactor, called Selena, will be able to run for a decade without maintenance. It will be ready to power a Chinese-led moon base by about 2036.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯还在建造一座核反应堆，预计发电量为10千瓦。该反应堆名为“Selena”，无需维护即可运行十年。到 2036 年左右，它将准备好为中国主导的月球基地提供动力。

paras.en: The Selena reactor is expected to be even lighter than NASA’s, weighing about 1,100 to 1,300kg (2,400 to 2,800 lbs) for an easier and softer landing on the lunar surface.
paras.zh: Selena 反应堆预计将比 NASA 的反应堆更轻，重约 1,100 至 1,300 公斤（2,400 至 2,800 磅），以便更轻松、更柔和地在月球表面着陆。

paras.en: This would not be the first time nuclear reactors have been placed in outer space.
paras.zh: 这并不是第一次在外太空放置核反应堆。

paras.en: The Soviet Union launched more than 30 nuclear fission reactors into Earth’s orbit between the late 1960s and the 1980s to power spy satellites during the Cold War.
paras.zh: 冷战期间，苏联在 20 世纪 60 年代末至 80 年代期间向地球轨道发射了 30 多个核裂变反应堆，为间谍卫星提供动力。

paras.en: The small, 1,000kg (2,200 lbs) reactors powered radar-tracking spy satellites using heat from splitting uranium atoms into 3 to 5 kilowatts of electricity. They are no longer operational, and no other country has sent nuclear reactors into space.
paras.zh: 这些小型 1,000 公斤（2,200 磅）反应堆利用铀原子分裂成 3 至 5 千瓦电力时产生的热量为雷达跟踪间谍卫星提供动力。它们已不再运行，也没有其他国家将核反应堆送入太空。

paras.en: The US has spent $20bn on advanced space nuclear programmes over the past 70 years, but has never successfully launched a nuclear reactor into space since an experiment in 1965.
paras.zh: 过去 70 年来，美国在先进太空核计划上花费了 200 亿美元，但自 1965 年实验以来从未成功地将核反应堆发射到太空。

paras.en: That experiment was carried out to see if nuclear energy could power a satellite. It worked at first but accidentally shut down after just 43 days because a non-nuclear electrical part of the satellite broke down. It is still floating up in space today.
paras.zh: 该实验的目的是看看核能是否能为卫星提供动力。它一开始工作正常，但仅仅 43 天后就意外关闭，因为卫星的非核电气部分发生故障。今天它仍然漂浮在太空中。

paras.en: Previous attempts by the US to develop nuclear projects have stalled due to shifting budget priorities.
paras.zh: 由于预算优先事项的变化，美国此前开发核项目的尝试已陷入停滞。

paras.en: How do you put nuclear reactors on the moon?
paras.zh: 如何在月球上建造核反应堆？

paras.en: First, scientists will have to build a reactor on Earth, which will then be transported to the moon using a robotic spacecraft that fires rocket engines for a slow and gentle touchdown.
paras.zh: 首先，科学家必须在地球上建造一个反应堆，然后使用机器人航天器将其运送到月球，该航天器启动火箭发动机以缓慢而温和的着陆。

paras.en: Both the US and Russia say they would keep their reactors switched off until they reach the moon, to keep radioactive risk at a minimum until the last step.
paras.zh: 美国和俄罗斯都表示，他们将在抵达月球之前关闭反应堆，以将放射性风险保持在最低限度，直到最后一步。

paras.en: Once set up on the moon, the reactors would be designed to run without maintenance for years, supplying power to bases engaged in mining on the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 一旦在月球上建立起来，这些反应堆将被设计为无需维护即可运行数年，为月球表面采矿基地提供电力。

paras.en: Why does the moon need a nuclear reactor?
paras.zh: 为什么月球需要核反应堆？

paras.en: The US, China and Russia want to build bases near the moon’s south pole, close to the known sources of water ice. The ice sits in the permanently shadowed craters, where sunlight has not reached for millions of years.
paras.zh: 美国、中国和俄罗斯希望在月球南极附近建立基地，靠近已知的水冰来源。冰位于永久阴影的陨石坑中，那里已经有数百万年没有阳光照射到了。

paras.en: As well as powering the moon bases, the reactors would also supply enough power for mining. So far, the US, Russia and China want to mine for frozen water which, once released, could be used to support life on the moon at bases where people could live and conduct research.
paras.zh: 除了为月球基地供电外，反应堆还可以为采矿提供足够的电力。到目前为止，美国、俄罗斯和中国希望开采冰冻水，一旦释放，可用于支持月球上人们生活和进行研究的基地的生命。

paras.en: Tech billionaire Elon Musk has also said he wants to extract minerals such as aluminium, titanium, and silicon, required for manufacturing satellites.
paras.zh: 科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克也表示，他希望提取制造卫星所需的铝、钛和硅等矿物。

paras.en: Solar power for such endeavours would be limited as the sun shines on any one spot on the moon only half the time, so solar panels would go dark for about two weeks every month.
paras.zh: 用于此类努力的太阳能将受到限制，因为太阳照射到月球上任何一个点的时间只有一半，因此太阳能电池板每个月将有大约两周的时间处于黑暗状态。

paras.en: Simon Middleburgh, director of Bangor University’s Nuclear Futures Institute (NFI), told Al Jazeera that solar power is too limited to provide the steady flow of energy a moon base would need, while batteries and diesel are too costly, because everything has to be launched from Earth.
paras.zh: 班戈大学核未来研究所（NFI）所长西蒙·米德尔堡（Simon Middleburgh）告诉半岛电视台，太阳能太有限，无法提供月球基地所需的稳定能源，而电池和柴油成本太高，因为一切都必须从地球发射。

paras.en: Nuclear energy is the “obvious choice”, Middleburgh said, adding that it must be used “responsibly”.
paras.zh: 米德尔堡表示，核能是“显而易见的选择”，并补充说必须“负责任地”使用核能。

paras.en: It is likely that three or four reactors working together would be required to provide sufficient energy for mining lunar ice as well as supporting a moon base, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，很可能需要三到四个反应堆一起工作，才能为开采月球冰和支持月球基地提供足够的能量。

paras.en: In a December 2025 executive order, US President Donald Trump ordered NASA to build a lunar reactor ready to launch by 2030. Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin have revealed similar plans.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年 12 月的行政命令中，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普命令 NASA 建造一座月球反应堆，准备在 2030 年发射。中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京也透露了类似的计划。

paras.en: In August this year, Sean Duffy, the US transportation secretary, said the US is in a “race to the moon, in a race with China”.
paras.zh: 今年8月，美国交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，美国正在“与中国进行一场登月竞赛”。

paras.en: Middleburgh said the 2030 deadline is likely for building the reactor itself, but the harder part will be landing on the moon and safely setting up the system.
paras.zh: 米德尔堡表示，建造反应堆本身的最后期限可能是 2030 年，但更困难的部分将是登陆月球并安全地建立该系统。

paras.en: “The biggest challenge isn’t really the nuclear technology at all; it is the regulation for launch, the availability of a launch platform itself, and the landing and setting up the system on the lunar surface ready for it to be operated sustainably and safely,” he said.
paras.zh: “最大的挑战根本不是核技术；而是发射监管、发射平台本身的可用性以及在月球表面着陆和建立系统以使其可持续和安全运行做好准备，”他说。

paras.en: The race to the moon also comes amid growing military competition beyond Earth. In September, the US announced it had deployed weapons into orbit, which officials said would be used to defend US forces.
paras.zh: 登月竞赛也发生在地球以外日益激烈的军事竞争之中。 9月，美国宣布已将武器部署到轨道上，官员称这些武器将用于保卫美军。

paras.en: While the US did not provide details about these “weapons”, experts say they are likely to be space-based communications jammers, rather than kinetic ones that launch strikes.
paras.zh: 虽然美国没有提供有关这些“武器”的详细信息，但专家表示，它们很可能是天基通信干扰器，而不是发动攻击的动能干扰器。

paras.en: The announcement raised concerns about the concept of “space weapons” or the use of space for military purposes, including the potential targeting of satellites that provide GPS, communications and intelligence.
paras.zh: 该声明引发了人们对“太空武器”概念或将太空用于军事目的的担忧，包括可能针对提供全球定位系统、通信和情报的卫星。

paras.en: Middleburgh told Al Jazeera that an accident during the launch of the reactors would be less frightening than it sounds because uranium alone, before it is used in a reactor, is not very radioactive. However, that changes once the reactor is switched on.
paras.zh: 米德尔堡告诉半岛电视台，反应堆启动过程中发生的事故并不像听起来那么可怕，因为在反应堆使用之前，铀本身的放射性并不强。然而，一旦反应堆启动，情况就会发生变化。

paras.en: The risk is bigger if a running reactor falls back onto Earth, analysts say.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，如果正在运行的反应堆落回地球，风险会更大。

paras.en: In 1978, a Soviet satellite carrying a reactor, Kosmos 954, scattered radioactive material across nearly 124,300 square km (48,000sq miles) of northern Canada.
paras.zh: 1978 年，一颗搭载反应堆 Kosmos 954 的苏联卫星将放射性物质散布到加拿大北部近 124,300 平方公里（48,000 平方英里）的地区。

paras.en: The accident forced an expensive military cleanup of the highly radioactive fragments and microscopic particles.
paras.zh: 这次事故迫使军队对高放射性碎片和微小颗粒进行了昂贵的清理。

paras.en: On the moon, Middleburgh says, any contaminated area would be “extremely localised” if there were to be a similar accident.
paras.zh: 米德尔堡说，在月球上，如果发生类似事故，任何受污染的区域都将“极其局部”。

paras.en: Legally, no one. The 1967 Outer Space Treaty bans countries from “claiming” the moon or any part of it, though they have ownership of the equipment they send there. The treaty does not ban nuclear power in space.
paras.zh: 从法律上讲，没有人。 1967 年的《外层空间条约》禁止各国“声称拥有”月球或其任何部分的所有权，尽管它们拥有发送到月球的设备的所有权。该条约并未禁止太空核能。

paras.en: Antonino Salmeri, director of the Lunar Policy Platform, a nonprofit, told Al Jazeera that a reactor can be lawful if it follows the treaty’s principles, including peaceful use and avoiding harmful contamination.
paras.zh: 非营利组织月球政策平台主任安东尼诺·萨尔梅里告诉半岛电视台，如果反应堆遵循条约的原则，包括和平使用和避免有害污染，那么它就是合法的。

paras.en: Norbert Schorghofer, a senior scientist at the Planetary Science Institute in Arizona, US, told Al Jazeera all signatories “have the right to mine the lunar surface as long as it is for peaceful purposes”.
paras.zh: 美国亚利桑那州行星科学研究所的高级科学家诺伯特·肖尔霍费尔 (Norbert Schorghofer) 告诉半岛电视台，所有签署方“都有权在月球表面采矿，只要是出于和平目的”。

paras.en: Whichever country’s reactor gets to the “best” water ice first could claim a “safety zone”, which would not be a land claim but could operate like one. Salmeri said declaring one creates no territorial rights, but a reactor shuts others out anyway, because nobody wants to enter a radioactive area.
paras.zh: 无论哪个国家的反应堆首先获得“最好”的水冰，都可以声称拥有一个“安全区”，这不是土地所有权，但可以像土地一样运作。萨尔梅里说，宣布一个反应堆不会产生领土权利，但反应堆无论如何都会将其他反应堆拒之门外，因为没有人愿意进入放射性区域。

paras.en: A Lunar Policy Platform report released last month points to another problem: Who is responsible if something goes wrong? The report says existing liability rules have not been designed to regulate the use of long-term hazardous equipment on another celestial body.
paras.zh: 上个月发布的月球政策平台报告指出了另一个问题：如果出现问题谁负责？报告称，现有的责任规则并不是为了规范在另一个天体上长期使用危险设备而设计的。

articles.title: After the ‘martyr’s’ funeral: The families left behind by Yemen’s war

paras.en: Sanaa, Yemen – Pickups carrying the bodies of Houthi fighters occasionally travel through the streets of Sanaa. Alongside them in the back, gunmen accompany the fallen fighters on their final journey to the cemetery.
paras.zh: 也门萨那——载着胡塞武装人员尸体的皮卡偶尔会穿过萨那的街道。在他们身后，枪手陪伴着阵亡的战士踏上前往墓地的最后旅程。

paras.en: A song known as “Our martyrs are our greats” echoes loudly from the moving vehicles, drawing the attention of passersby. At the cemetery, mourners solemnly pay their respects to the fallen fighters and show solidarity with their families.
paras.zh: 一首《我们的烈士是我们的伟人》的歌曲在行驶的车辆中大声回响，吸引了路人的注意。在公墓，哀悼者庄严地向阵亡战士表示敬意，并向他们的家人表示声援。

paras.en: Funerals of fighters have been a recurring sight in Yemen over the past few weeks.
paras.zh: 过去几周，战士的葬礼在也门屡见不鲜。

paras.en: Earlier this month, the Yemeni government said its forces killed or wounded 1,540 Houthis in 24 hours. Last week, the government said 16,100 Houthi operatives and commanders had been killed or wounded since October 5.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，也门政府表示，其部队在 24 小时内打死或打伤 1,540 名胡塞武装。上周，政府表示，自 10 月 5 日以来，已有 16,100 名胡塞武装分子和指挥官伤亡。

paras.en: Houthis have also killed hundreds of pro-government troops over the past few weeks, with an October 19 missile attack on a security camp in Shabwa killing more than 70 government soldiers.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装在过去几周内还杀死了数百名亲政府士兵，10 月 19 日对沙布瓦安全营的导弹袭击导致 70 多名政府士兵死亡。

paras.en: While the families of the deceased fighters receive fleeting public tributes at cemeteries, their grief and loss endure long after the funerals. For them, life has become more difficult, economic hardships have deepened and sorrow is a constant companion.
paras.zh: 虽然死者家属在墓地接受短暂的公开悼念，但他们的悲伤和失落在葬礼结束后仍持续很长时间。对他们来说，生活变得更加困难，经济困难加深，悲伤始终如影随形。

paras.en: “The martyrdom of my brother, Abdulaziz, on October 10 broke us and robbed us of peace of mind. We could smile to hide our pain, but our hearts are filled with bottomless grief,” Akram, a 23-year-old resident of Sanaa, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “10 月 10 日，我兄弟阿卜杜勒阿齐兹的殉难让我们心碎，让我们失去了内心的平静。我们可以用微笑来掩饰痛苦，但我们的内心却充满了无尽的悲伤，”23 岁的萨那居民阿克拉姆告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Abdulaziz, 21, was killed in Dhubab, in southwestern Yemen, while fighting alongside the Houthi group, two months after being recruited, Akram said.
paras.zh: 阿克拉姆说，21 岁的阿卜杜勒阿齐兹在被招募两个月后，在也门西南部的杜巴布与胡塞武装并肩作战时被杀。

paras.en: Before Abdulaziz went to the front line, the two brothers worked in Sanaa as daily-wage workers in construction or agriculture. When they managed to get work, they pooled their earnings to cover the living expenses of their six-member family. That made the family’s financial difficulties “manageable”, said Akram.
paras.zh: 在阿卜杜勒阿齐兹前往前线之前，两兄弟在萨那从事建筑业或农业的日薪工人工作。当他们找到工作后，他们将自己的收入集中起来支付一家六口人的生活费用。阿克拉姆说，这使得这个家庭的经济困难变得“可控”。

paras.en: Today, he struggles without his brother and covering the family’s basic needs has become a harder task.
paras.zh: 如今，他在没有兄弟的情况下挣扎，满足家庭的基本需求已成为一项艰巨的任务。

paras.en: “I lost my pillar of strength, Abdulaziz. His income, along with mine, used to cover water, electricity and food expenses. Without him, I am like a bird with one wing, burdened by so many responsibilities,” said Akram.
paras.zh: “我失去了我的支柱阿卜杜勒阿齐兹。他的收入和我的一样，用来支付水、电和食品费用。没有他，我就像一只只有一只翅膀的鸟，背负着如此多的责任，”阿克拉姆说。

paras.en: Over the past few days, petrol and diesel prices have risen by 10 percent in Houthi-controlled northwestern Yemen, adding to the cost of basic goods and increasing pressure on struggling families, such as Akram’s.
paras.zh: 过去几天，胡塞武装控制的也门西北部地区的汽油和柴油价格上涨了 10%，增加了基本商品的成本，也给阿克拉姆等陷入困境的家庭带来了更大的压力。

paras.en: “When it comes to paying the fees for water, electricity, or buying groceries, it does not matter if your relative is a martyr or not. You have to pay or starve to death,” said Akram.
paras.zh: 阿克拉姆说：“在支付水费、电费或购买杂货费时，无论你的亲戚是否是烈士，你都必须付钱，否则就会饿死。”

paras.en: In recent months, Yemen has faced a major escalation in fighting between Saudi-backed government forces and the Iran-aligned Houthi group that controls parts of the country.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，也门面临沙特支持的政府军与控制该国部分地区、与伊朗结盟的胡塞组织之间的战斗大幅升级。

paras.en: The latest escalation “threatens to be absolutely devastating” for food security, said the World Food Programme’s Assistant Executive Director for Programme Operations, Matthew Hollingworth, earlier this month.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署负责项目运营的助理执行主任马修·霍林沃思本月早些时候表示，最新的升级对粮食安全“绝对是毁灭性的威胁”。

paras.en: “We are looking at a hunger crisis that is going to grow as it persists,” Hollingworth added.
paras.zh: 霍林沃斯补充说：“我们正在面临一场饥饿危机，随着它的持续存在，这场危机将会加剧。”

paras.en: The Houthis seized Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, in September 2014 and subsequently took control of much of northern and western Yemen. Since then, the conflict has remained unresolved.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装于 2014 年 9 月占领也门首都萨那，随后控制了也门北部和西部的大部分地区。此后，冲突一直没有解决。

paras.en: Like many other deceased fighters’ families in Houthi-controlled areas, Houthi authorities gave Akram’s family a food basket, which included flour, cooking oil, rice and sugar.
paras.zh: 与胡塞武装控制地区的许多其他死者家属一样，胡塞当局给阿克拉姆的家人提供了一个食品篮，其中包括面粉、食用油、大米和糖。

paras.en: However, the supply of food or financial assistance is irregular, Sanaa-based Ali Yahia, a 55-year-old father of a deceased fighter, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 然而，萨那的 55 岁战士阿里·叶海亚 (Ali Yahia) 告诉半岛电视台，食物或经济援助的供应不稳定。他是一名已故战士的父亲。

paras.en: “My son was killed four years ago on the Saudi-Yemen border when he was fighting for the Sanaa-based government. Since then, I have received food baskets at different times. Sometimes, I receive them twice a year or thrice a year, or four times a year,” he said.
paras.zh: “我的儿子四年前在沙特和也门边境被杀，当时他正在为萨那政府作战。从那以后，我在不同的时间收到食物篮。有时，我每年收到两次、三次、甚至四次，”他说。

paras.en: For Yahia, this support is insufficient, and he argues that “fair compensation” would be a monthly salary of $200 at least. “This amount of money would help a family cover the basics each month,” he said.
paras.zh: 对于 Yahia 来说，这种支持还不够，他认为“公平的补偿”至少是月薪 200 美元。 “这笔钱可以帮助一个家庭支付每个月的基本生活费用，”他说。

paras.en: Yahia has two other sons who support him. One is a delivery rider in Sanaa and the other works at a restaurant.
paras.zh: 叶海亚还有另外两个儿子支持他。一名是萨那的送货员，另一名在餐厅工作。

paras.en: “With their support, my living conditions have improved. But if a family depends on a fighter’s income, the death of the fighter sparks a living and psychological ordeal for the whole family,” he said.
paras.zh: “在他们的支持下，我的生活条件得到了改善。但如果一个家庭依赖一名战士的收入，那么战士的死亡会给整个家庭带来生活和心理上的考验，”他说。

paras.en: According to the World Food Programme, 18.3 million people across Yemen face severe food insecurity, while 2.2 million children under five suffer from acute malnutrition.
paras.zh: 据世界粮食计划署称，也门全国有 1830 万人面临严重的粮食不安全，而 220 万五岁以下儿童患有严重营养不良。

paras.en: As the number of fighters killed on the front lines rises, the authorities’ ability to support bereaved families is increasingly stretched, Ali Mohammed, a Houthi representative in Sanaa, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装驻萨那代表阿里·穆罕默德告诉半岛电视台，随着在前线阵亡的战士人数不断增加，当局支持死者家属的能力日益捉襟见肘。
