paras.en: “Martyrs today are too many and their families deserve due support. However, the rising number of martyrs affects the level of support they receive. Assistance is distributed so that every family gets some,” said Mohammed.
paras.zh: “今天的烈士太多了，他们的家人应该得到应有的支持。然而，烈士人数的增加影响了他们获得的支持水平。援助是分配的，以便每个家庭都能得到一些，”穆罕默德说。

paras.en: He argued that the “complete Houthi victory will lead to stability in the country and this will give authorities a better opportunity to look after the families of the martyrs.” He added: “This will take time”.
paras.zh: 他认为，“胡塞武装的彻底胜利将带来国家的稳定，这将使当局有更好的机会照顾烈士家属。”他补充道：“这需要时间”。

paras.en: On October 25, the Sanaa-based Houthi Ministry of Youth and Sports commemorated Martyrs’ Day in the presence of many Houthi officials.
paras.zh: 10月25日，位于萨那的胡塞青年和体育部在许多胡塞官员的见证下纪念了烈士节。

paras.en: During the event, the group’s Undersecretary for the Sports Sector, Ali Hadban, emphasised the importance of observing the occasion to “draw inspiration from the lessons of sacrifice and selflessness, and to reflect on the enduring legacies of the martyrs who defended the nation”.
paras.zh: 在活动期间，该组织负责体育部门的副部长阿里·哈德班强调了庆祝这一场合的重要性，“从牺牲和无私的教训中汲取灵感，并反思保卫国家的烈士的不朽遗产”。

paras.en: He noted that the victories achieved across various fronts are the direct result of the sacrifices made by “these noble martyrs”, emphasising the need to provide support and care for their families.
paras.zh: 他指出，各条战线取得的胜利是“这些崇高烈士”牺牲的直接结果，并强调需要为他们的家人提供支持和照顾。

paras.en: At the end of 2021, the UN estimated that 377,000 people had been killed directly or indirectly by the war in Yemen. The recent return of fighting has claimed more lives.
paras.zh: 截至2021年底，联合国估计也门战争直接或间接造成37.7万人死亡。最近的战斗再次夺去了更多人的生命。

paras.en: Adel Dashela, researcher at the Sanaa Center for Strategic Studies, described the public celebration of fallen fighters as “an alien practice” that emerged during the war.
paras.zh: 萨那战略研究中心研究员阿德尔·达谢拉（Adel Dashela）将公开庆祝阵亡战士描述为战争期间出现的“一种异类做法”。

paras.en: “This practice reflects the normalisation of violence and encourages children to risk their lives and die under various sectarian and political slogans. Yemenis did not witness this phenomenon until the Houthi group took control of the capital, Sanaa,” Dashela told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “这种做法反映了暴力的正常化，并鼓励儿童在各种宗派和政治口号下冒着生命危险和死亡。直到胡塞组织控制首都萨那，也门人才目睹这种现象，”达谢拉告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Families may be encouraged to participate in these rituals and may find themselves compelled to do so under social and political pressure, he said. “The reality, however, is that public displays of honour do not alleviate families’ suffering. Instead, the social, psychological and financial consequences of their loss remain their burden to bear.”
paras.zh: 他说，家庭可能会被鼓励参加这些仪式，并且可能会发现自己在社会和政治压力下被迫这样做。 “然而，现实是，公开展示荣誉并不能减轻家庭的痛苦。相反，失去亲人所带来的社会、心理和经济后果仍然是他们要承受的负担。”

paras.en: In many cases, women and children assume responsibility for supporting their families after the death of the breadwinner.
paras.zh: 在许多情况下，妇女和儿童在养家糊口的人去世后承担起养家糊口的责任。

paras.en: “Thus, women and children bear the real cost of these losses, while public celebrations remain detached from their everyday realities and the ongoing suffering of bereaved families,” Dashela added.
paras.zh: 达什拉补充道：“因此，妇女和儿童承担了这些损失的真正代价，而公众庆祝活动仍然脱离了他们的日常生活现实和失去亲人的家庭正在遭受的痛苦。”

articles.title: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
paras.zh: 西班牙预计全国大选前将发生今年第二起致命火车事故

paras.en: URDA, Spain — Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, a crash in which one train struck another from behind, killing 68 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network.
paras.zh: 西班牙乌尔达——西班牙今年发生的第二起高铁事故，一列火车从后面撞上另一列火车，造成 68 人死亡，引发了对该国铁路网络安全的新担忧。

paras.en: Spain's network of high-speed rail has been considered one of the nation's crowning achievements. It ranks second to China in track mileage in the world. Until this year, it had not endured a deadly crash since coming into service over three decades ago.
paras.zh: 西班牙的高铁网络被认为是该国的最高成就之一。赛道里程排名世界第二，仅次于中国。直到今年，它自三十多年前投入使用以来还没有发生过致命的事故。

paras.en: The collision Wednesday that turned a sleepy stretch of rail lined by olive groves into a scene of carnage came just four weeks before the country votes in a national election.
paras.zh: 周三发生的撞车事故使一段橄榄林两旁的昏昏欲睡的铁路变成了大屠杀现场，距离该国全国大选投票仅四个星期。

paras.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez visited the crash site in the central province of Toledo after regional authorities confirmed that more than 60 people had died and dozens more were being treated at hospitals.
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯视察了中部托莱多省的坠机现场，此前地区当局确认已造成 60 多人死亡，另有数十人正在医院接受治疗。

paras.en: Only in January, 46 people had died when one train jumped the track and slammed into the side of another going the opposite way in southern Spain.
paras.zh: 仅在 1 月，西班牙南部一列火车冲出铁轨并撞上另一列相反方向的火车侧面，造成 46 人死亡。

paras.en: Sánchez pledged an investigation into the latest collision and improvements to prevent another tragedy like the two that have shaken trust in a rail system that carried 45 million travelers last year, including millions of tourists.
paras.zh: 桑切斯承诺对最近的事故进行调查，并做出改进，以防止再次发生类似两起事故，这两起事故动摇了人们对去年运送 4500 万名旅客（其中包括数百万游客）的铁路系统的信任。

paras.en: "It is clear that we need to reinforce the safety of our train service to rebuild the trust in our high-speed rail," Sánchez said. "It is not acceptable for a country like Spain to endure two high-speed train accidents in the same year."
paras.zh: 桑切斯说：“显然，我们需要加强火车服务的安全性，以重建人们对我们高铁的信任。” “像西班牙这样的国家在同一年遭遇两起高铁事故是不可接受的。”

paras.en: Sánchez's government declared three days of mourning starting Thursday.
paras.zh: 桑切斯政府宣布从周四开始哀悼三天。

paras.en: Both deadly crashes this year involved a train operated by the state-owned RENFE company and one from the privately owned IRYO. Spain only liberalized its high-speed rail service in 2021, with the Italian IRYO starting service the following year.
paras.zh: 今年的两起致命事故都涉及一列国有 RENFE 公司运营的火车和一列私营 IRYO 公司运营的火车。西班牙直到2021年才开放高铁服务，意大利IRYO于次年开始服务。

paras.en: Political implications for Sánchez ahead of election
paras.zh: 选举前对桑切斯的政治影响

paras.en: Sánchez has weathered many crises since taking power in 2018, staying in power and winning reelection after the COVID-19 pandemic and the global rise in inflation.
paras.zh: 桑切斯自 2018 年上台以来经历了多次危机，在 COVID-19 大流行和全球通胀上升后继续掌权并赢得连任。

paras.en: But polls show he faces another uphill battle when voters cast ballots in Spain's first national election since 2023. The new rail disaster can't help the prospects of his Socialist party.
paras.zh: 但民意调查显示，当选民在西班牙自 2023 年以来的首次全国大选中投票时，他面临着另一场艰苦的战斗。新的铁路灾难并不能帮助他的社会党的前景。

paras.en: Sánchez and other progressive parties had hoped to leverage a wave of discontent over housing costs and high rents when he called for early elections earlier this month.
paras.zh: 桑切斯和其他进步政党本月早些时候呼吁提前举行选举时，曾希望利用人们对住房成本和高租金的不满情绪。

paras.en: About an hour before news of Wednesday's crash spread, Sánchez had posted on X a message that "There are lots of reasons to be optimistic about this country."
paras.zh: 周三坠机事故消息传开前大约一个小时，桑切斯在 X 上发布了一条消息，称“有很多理由对这个国家保持乐观”。

paras.en: Now it appears he will have to handle concerns over the state of Spain's rail service along with attacks from right-wing parties over his liberal migration policies and accusations of corruption against his party and his wife, which both he and his wife deny.
paras.zh: 现在看来，他将不得不应对对西班牙铁路服务状况的担忧，以及右翼政党对其自由移民政策的攻击，以及对他的政党和妻子的腐败指控，但他和他的妻子都否认了这一点。

paras.en: His transport minister, Óscar Puente, had to handle media questions over whether he would resign following a second major train wreck under his watch. His response was that he was fully focused on dealing with the collision, not his future.
paras.zh: 他的交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特（Óscar Puente）必须处理媒体关于他是否会在他领导下的第二次重大火车事故后辞职的问题。他的回应是，他完全专注于处理碰撞，而不是他的未来。

paras.en: Sánchez's main rival, Popular Party leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo, demanded a full investigation of the crash. The conservative leader said that in respect for the victims his party canceled its campaign events for the day.
paras.zh: 桑切斯的主要竞争对手、人民党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍要求对事故进行全面调查。这位保守党领袖表示，为了尊重受害者，他的政党取消了当天的竞选活动。

paras.en: "This is the moment to respect the dead, the injured and their families," Núñez Feijóo said. "That does not mean we will ignore the fact that Spaniards are asking tough questions that demand answers."
paras.zh: 努涅斯·费乔说：“现在是尊重死者、伤者及其家人的时刻。” “这并不意味着我们会忽视西班牙人提出需要答案的棘手问题这一事实。”

paras.en: The far-right Vox leader, Santiago Abascal, who is likely hoping to enter a coalition government with the conservatives, did not show the same restraint.
paras.zh: 极右翼 Vox 领导人圣地亚哥·阿巴斯卡尔 (Santiago Abascal) 可能希望与保守派组成联合政府，但他没有表现出同样的克制。

paras.en: "More dead. Another tragedy. More rage over being left to fend for ourselves, the despair and the betrayal that Spaniards are enduring," Abascal said just hours after the crash.
paras.zh: “更多的人死了。又是一场悲剧。更多的愤怒是因为西班牙人不得不自力更生，承受着绝望和背叛，”事故发生几小时后，阿巴斯卡尔说道。

paras.en: "I promise to work tirelessly until this government, which is a criminal organization, is sitting in a courtroom to answer for its crimes," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我保证将不懈努力，直到这个犯罪组织政府坐在法庭上对其罪行负责。”

paras.en: Puente said that the crash was caused by what he called the "inexplicable" order from a central command center for Spain's trains after a security system had failed. He said the train engineers were not to blame.
paras.zh: 普恩特表示，这起事故是由西班牙火车中央指挥中心在安全系统失效后发出的“莫名其妙”的命令造成的。他说火车工程师不应该受到责备。

paras.en: Puente said that at 8:30 a.m. the security system on a stretch of 63 kilometers (39 miles) stopped working due to a computer malfunction, causing all trains on that stretch to stop. At that point the IRYO train was stopped near the town of Urda, while the RENFE train was 25 kilometers (15.5 miles) behind it.
paras.zh: 普恩特说，上午8点30分，由于计算机故障，63公里（39英里）范围内的安全系统停止工作，导致该范围内的所有火车停止运行。此时，IRYO 列车停在乌尔达镇附近，而 RENFE 列车则在其后方 25 公里（15.5 英里）处。

paras.en: But a few minutes later the central command told the RENFE train to start running again without any speed restrictions, and it ended up colliding with the stationary IRYO train at 8:53 a.m.
paras.zh: 但几分钟后，中央指挥部要求 RENFE 列车重新开始运行，不受任何速度限制，最终于上午 8 点 53 分与静止的 IRYO 列车相撞。

paras.en: Puente said that the train should never have been told to start moving again since there was still a "stop signal" active on that line. And if it had, at least it should have been told to go at reduced speed.
paras.zh: 普恩特表示，火车根本不应该被告知重新开始行驶，因为该线路上仍然有“停止信号”。如果有的话，至少应该告诉它放慢速度。

paras.en: Workers started to use cranes to move parts of the damaged trains late on Wednesday after a hectic day involving hundreds of emergency workers, firefighters, police and soldiers all pitching in to rescue survivors and recover bodies.
paras.zh: 经过忙碌的一天，数百名急救人员、消防员、警察和士兵都投入到营救幸存者和打捞尸体的工作中，周三晚些时候，工人们开始使用起重机移动受损列车的部分部件。

articles.title: JuJu Watkins says she's dreamed of her first basket since ACL injury as USC looks to end title drought

paras.en: JuJu Watkins, one of the brightest young stars in women’s college basketball, is back on the court. The Southern California guard was sidelined last season while rehabbing a torn ACL.
paras.zh: JuJu Watkins，女子大学篮球界最耀眼的年轻明星之一，重返球场。这位南加州后卫上赛季因十字韧带撕裂而缺席比赛。

paras.en: Watkins' first two seasons with the USC Trojans saw her score an average of 25.6 points per game. Now, she returns to a talented supporting cast as the No. 3 Trojans pursue their first national championship since 1984.
paras.zh: 沃特金斯在南加州大学特洛伊队的前两个赛季平均每场得分 25.6 分。现在，她又回到了才华横溢的配角阵容中，带领三号特洛伊队追求自 1984 年以来的第一个全国冠军。

paras.en: "It’s on my mind every day," Watkins said. "So much anticipation has gone into this year. I want it really badly, but also in a healthy way. I just want to have fun and really enjoy this year."
paras.zh: “我每天都在想这个问题，”沃特金斯说。 “今年人们充满了期待。我非常想要它，但也是以一种健康的方式。我只想玩得开心，真正享受今年。”

paras.en: Watkins added that she's already imagined what it will feel like to see her first basket go in.
paras.zh: 沃特金斯补充说，她已经想象过看到她的第一个篮子投入的感觉。

paras.en: "I’ve had dreams about that every night. I might shed a tear, honestly, I can’t lie," she said. "That’ll be a really amazing feeling for me."
paras.zh: “我每天晚上都会梦见这个。我可能会流泪，说实话，我不能撒谎，”她说。 “这对我来说真是一种奇妙的感觉。”

paras.en: Watkins scored 18 points in 22 minutes during USC’s recent exhibition win over California, offering an early glimpse of what her return could mean.
paras.zh: 沃特金斯在南加州大学最近战胜加州大学的表演赛中，在 22 分钟内拿下 18 分，让人们初步了解了她的回归意味着什么。

paras.en: She will share the backcourt with Big Ten Freshman of the Year Jazzy Davidson, who averaged 17.9 points last season. Although this will be their first season playing together, the duo began building chemistry while Watkins recovered from the injury she suffered in the second round of the 2025 NCAA Tournament. She could often be seen encouraging Davidson from the sideline.
paras.zh: 她将与上赛季场均17.9分的十大联盟年度新秀贾兹·戴维森（Jazzy Davidson）并肩作战。尽管这将是他们一起打球的第一个赛季，但当沃特金斯从 2025 年 NCAA 锦标赛第二轮的伤病中恢复过来时，两人开始产生化学反应。人们经常看到她在场边鼓励戴维森。

paras.en: "She saw me being hard on myself and I think she saw a little bit of her in me," Davidson said, "and so she kind of knew what it was like going through that. Being able to build the friendship that we were able to build, it’s a huge blessing."
paras.zh: “她看到我对自己很严格，我想她在我身上看到了一点她的影子，”戴维森说，“所以她知道经历那件事是什么感觉。能够建立我们能够建立的友谊，这是一个巨大的祝福。”

paras.en: USC’s stockpile of talent includes guard Saniyah Hall, who had 23 points, six rebounds and five steals in the Trojans’ exhibition, as well as forward Sara Okeke, one of three five-star recruits to join the roster.
paras.zh: 南加州大学的人才储备包括在特洛伊队的表演赛中拿下 23 分、6 个篮板和 5 次抢断的后卫萨尼亚·霍尔 (Saniyah Hall)，以及加入名单的三名五星级新兵之一的前锋萨拉·奥克克 (Sara Okeke)。

paras.en: "They have proven that they’re going to be really impactful players at a high level," coach Lindsay Gottlieb said.
paras.zh: “他们已经证明自己将成为高水平上真正有影响力的球员，”教练林赛·戈特利布说。

paras.en: Last season, Watkins would set up chairs in the locker room for the team talk on the road. It was one of the small ways she found to be useful without being on the court.
paras.zh: 上个赛季，沃特金斯会在更衣室里摆上椅子，以便球队在客场进行谈话。这是她发现不在球场上也有用的小方法之一。

paras.en: "I was able to take on a leadership role for sure, and I can’t say I really owned that role prior to that," she said. "Being able to do that and also see the game from a different perspective and seeing how can I help my team really helped grow my IQ and leadership skills."
paras.zh: “我确实能够担任领导角色，但我不能说在此之前我真的拥有这个角色，”她说。 “能够做到这一点，并从不同的角度看待比赛，看看我如何帮助我的团队，这确实有助于提高我的智商和领导技能。”

paras.en: The Trojans season tips off Monday in Las Vegas against UNLV in the Hall of Fame Series.
paras.zh: 特洛伊队赛季将于周一在拉斯维加斯举行的名人堂系列赛中对阵内华达大学拉斯维加斯分校。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Brewers manager reveals his biggest challenge during championship parade was not peeing himself

paras.en: A championship parade comes after all the hard work is done ... or at least that's what most of us would think.
paras.zh: 在所有艰苦的工作完成之后，冠军游行就会到来……或者至少我们大多数人会这么认为。

paras.en: However, Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy revealed that he was put through a serious endurance test during his team's victory lap through Cream City (which sounds dirty, but I promise it isn't ... though somewhere out there, it might be. Who knows?).
paras.zh: 然而，密尔沃基酿酒人队经理帕特·墨菲透露，在他的球队在奶油城获胜的一圈中，他接受了严格的耐力测试（这听起来很肮脏，但我保证它不是......尽管在某个地方，它可能是。谁知道呢？）。

paras.en: The Brewers' skipper hopped on stage at the end of the parade route where he took a second to talk to Brewers play-by-play man Brian Anderson.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队的队长在游行路线的尽头跳上舞台，他花了一秒钟时间与酿酒人队的实况记者布莱恩·安德森交谈。

paras.en: "I had to pee as bad as anybody has had to pee," Murphy said.
paras.zh: “我不得不撒尿，就像任何人不得不撒尿一样，”墨菲说。

paras.en: Now we need to pause for a second because this is something I have never considered about championship parades: it really is an assault on one's bladder.
paras.zh: 现在我们需要暂停一下，因为这是我从未考虑过冠军游行的事情：这确实是对膀胱的攻击。

paras.en: We all know beer makes pee, but consider the sheer volume of suds you'd consume after winning the World Series.
paras.zh: 我们都知道啤酒会导致小便，但请考虑一下赢得世界职业棒球大赛后您会消耗多少泡沫。

paras.en: Now imagine the awful feeling of having to unload like Seabiscuit after a pre-race trough of water, but you're on a fire truck only halfway through the parade route.
paras.zh: 现在想象一下，在赛前的一洼水之后必须像“Seabiscuit”一样卸载的可怕感觉，但你却在游行路线的一半处乘坐消防车。

paras.en: Brutal. But Murphy got the job done ... or did he?
paras.zh: 野蛮。但墨菲完成了任务……是吗？

paras.en: "Good job holding it together," Anderson said.
paras.zh: “干得好，把它整合在一起，”安德森说。

paras.en: "I didn't say I held it together," replied Murphy.
paras.zh: “我并没有说我把它放在一起，”墨菲回答道。

paras.en: A stroke of brilliance that makes up for not using Jacob Misiorowski to close out Game 4.
paras.zh: 这一出色的表现弥补了第四场比赛没有使用雅各布·米西奥罗夫斯基的遗憾。

paras.en: That's a great joke to endear you to the crowd that is already in the palm of your hand even more. However, if there really was an accident, it clears your conscience while everyone in the crowd just thinks you're joshing.
paras.zh: 这是一个很棒的笑话，可以让你更加受到已经掌握在你手中的人群的喜爱。然而，如果真的发生了事故，你的良心就会清明，而人群中的每个人都认为你在开玩笑。

paras.en: Hopefully someone pointed him in the direction of the shiniest urinal Milwaukee has to offer.
paras.zh: 希望有人向他指出密尔沃基最闪亮的小便池的方向。

articles.title: Thunder to lose Chet Holmgren for at least 2 months with knee injury amid string of early-season NBA injuries

paras.en: The Oklahoma City Thunder will have to navigate the next couple of months without one of their key players.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马城雷霆队将不得不在失去一名关键球员的情况下度过接下来的几个月。

paras.en: Chet Holmgren is expected to miss between eight to ten weeks with a right knee injury, adding to a troubling string of injury news across the NBA early in the season. Oklahoma City was already braced to be without Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace for potentially the rest of the regular season. The Thunder said Holmgren began experiencing knee discomfort Sunday.
paras.zh: 切特·霍姆格伦预计将因右膝伤势缺席八到十周，这给整个 NBA 赛季初一系列令人不安的伤病消息增添了色彩。俄克拉荷马城已经准备好在常规赛剩余时间里贾伦·威廉姆斯和卡森·华莱士可能缺席。雷霆队表示霍姆格伦周日开始出现膝盖不适。

paras.en: After discussions with multiple specialists, Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday for a small tear in his patellar tendon.
paras.zh: 在与多位专家讨论后，霍姆格伦周五因髌腱小撕裂接受了生物治疗。

paras.en: Wallace also had surgery Friday for a labral tear in his left shoulder. The surgery was performed in Los Angeles by Dr. Neal ElAttrache at the Cedars-Sinai Kerlan-Jobe Institute in Los Angeles with Thunder medical personnel present.
paras.zh: 华莱士周五还因左肩盂唇撕裂接受了手术。手术由洛杉矶 Cedars-Sinai Kerlan-Jobe 研究所的 Neal ElAttrache 医生在洛杉矶进行，雷霆医疗人员也在场。

paras.en: The guard will be evaluated again before the end of the regular season.
paras.zh: 这名后卫将在常规赛结束前再次接受评估。

paras.en: Williams sustained a broken left fibula and dislocated left ankle Sunday. The Thunder already said after his surgery he also would be evaluated again before the end of the regular season.
paras.zh: 周日，威廉姆斯左腓骨骨折，左脚踝脱臼。雷霆队已经表示，手术后他还将在常规赛结束前再次接受评估。

paras.en: Earlier this week, ESPN reported that Minnesota Timberwolves superstar Anthony Edwards was expected to undergo an arthroscopic procedure to address discomfort in his right knee. The procedure is expected to sideline the three-time All-Star for up to two months.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，ESPN 报道称，明尼苏达森林狼队巨星安东尼·爱德华兹预计将接受关节镜手术，以解决右膝不适的问题。该手术预计将使这位三届全明星球员缺席长达两个月的时间。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy praises US over $2.1bn Patriot missile deal but warns it could take years
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies

paras.en: The US has approved the sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine for an estimated $2.1bn, but Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned deliveries could take years and stockpiles were needed now to counter Russian ballistic missile attacks.
paras.zh: 美国已批准向乌克兰出售 500 枚爱国者 PAC-3 导弹，价值估计为 21 亿美元，但弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基警告称，交付可能需要数年时间，现在需要储备来应对俄罗斯的弹道导弹袭击。

paras.en: “The proposed sale will improve Ukraine’s capability to meet current and future threats by improving its integrated air and missile defense capabilities,” the US state department said in a statement on Friday.
paras.zh: 美国国务院周五在一份声明中表示：“拟议的出售将通过提高乌克兰的综合防空和导弹防御能力来提高乌克兰应对当前和未来威胁的能力。”

paras.en: The statement did not provide an estimate for when the weapons could be delivered to Ukraine.
paras.zh: 该声明没有提供武器何时可以运抵乌克兰的估计。

paras.en: Zelenskyy praised the “strong decision by the US state department” but said in a post on X early on Saturday: “However, it has been stipulated that deliveries may begin ONLY IN A FEW YEARS. We are asking our American partners to find a solution for the time when there is a real danger and a real need to use PAC-3 interceptors.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基赞扬了“美国国务院的强有力决定”，但周六早些时候在X上发帖称：“然而，规定交付可能要在几年内开始。我们要求我们的美国合作伙伴在真正存在危险和确实需要使用PAC-3拦截器时找到解决方案。”

paras.en: “Right now, the Russians are attacking our energy infrastructure every single day.”
paras.zh: “现在，俄罗斯人每天都在攻击我们的能源基础设施。”

paras.en: Ukraine has long said it urgently needs more missile interceptors to knock down the growing waves of missiles Russia’s military fires at the country. The Patriot missile system is the most effective weapon to counter fast-moving ballistic missiles.
paras.zh: 乌克兰长期以来一直表示，它迫切需要更多的导弹拦截器来击落俄罗斯向该国发射的越来越多的导弹。爱国者导弹系统是对抗快速移动弹道导弹的最有效武器。

paras.en: On Thursday, a Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people on a crowded rail platform in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro, while five died in daytime strikes on two other provincial cities and a late-evening missile strike killed 1 person in the capital Kyiv, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，周四，俄罗斯无人机袭击乌克兰第聂伯罗市一个拥挤的铁路站台，造成至少 14 人死亡，另外两个省级城市白天的袭击造成 5 人死亡，首都基辅深夜的导弹袭击造成 1 人死亡。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said US and European allies had sufficient stockpiles of Patriot interceptors to provide to Ukraine now, which could be replenished in the coming years through contracts already paid for by Ukraine and its partners.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，美国和欧洲盟友现在有足够的爱国者拦截弹库存可以提供给乌克兰，这些库存可以在未来几年通过乌克兰及其合作伙伴已经支付的合同进行补充。

paras.en: He said this would “be the right approach” and was “entirely feasible”.
paras.zh: 他表示这将是“正确的做法”并且“完全可行”。

paras.en: Delayed missile deliveries have added to Kyiv’s tensions with Washington after US president Donald Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia and criticised Zelenskyy for Ukraine’s unwillingness to stop attacks on Russian refineries.
paras.zh: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布与俄罗斯达成柴油协议并批评泽连斯基乌克兰不愿停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击之后，导弹交付的延迟加剧了基辅与华盛顿的紧张关系。

paras.en: But despite Ukraine’s urgency, it will probably not receive the missile interceptors quickly. Weapons sales typically take years to fulfil, and two people briefed on the US decision said the missiles – which are yet to be manufactured – are not expected to be delivered until a couple of years into the 2030s.
paras.zh: 但尽管乌克兰很紧迫，但它可能不会很快收到导弹拦截器。武器销售通常需要数年时间才能完成，两名了解美国决定的人士表示，这些尚未制造的导弹预计要到 2030 年代几年后才会交付。

paras.en: One of the people said Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense was encouraging the Pentagon to bring forward the delivery date, possibly by giving Kyiv missiles already in the US arsenal and backfilling with the new Patriot interceptors.
paras.zh: 其中一位知情人士表示，乌克兰国防部正在鼓励五角大楼提前交付日期，可能的方式是向美国军火库中已有的基辅导弹提供支持，并用新的爱国者拦截弹进行回填。

paras.en: Ukraine will pay for the missiles with contributions from Canada, Germany and Norway routed through a program called US Jumpstart, along with national funds financed by the EU’s Ukraine Support Loan, the state department said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国国务院在一份声明中表示，乌克兰将通过一项名为“美国Jumpstart”的计划，通过加拿大、德国和挪威的捐款以及欧盟乌克兰支持贷款资助的国家资金来支付导弹的费用。

paras.en: The programme uses donations from allies to buy weapons, services and training for Ukraine to support its self-defence following Russia’s invasion, according to a Pentagon website.
paras.zh: 据五角大楼网站称，该计划利用盟友的捐款为乌克兰购买武器、服务和培训，以支持其在俄罗斯入侵后的自卫。

paras.en: Lockheed Martin is the principal contractor for the sale of the Patriot interceptors.
paras.zh: 洛克希德·马丁公司是爱国者拦截机销售的主要承包商。

paras.en: The US has supplied large quantities of weapons to allies while also using munitions in its own military operations in Iran, raising concerns about inventories of key air defense and precision-guided weapons.
paras.zh: 美国向盟国提供了大量武器，同时也在自己对伊朗的军事行动中使用弹药，引发了人们对关键防空和精确制导武器库存的担忧。

articles.title: Albanese looks for reset on world stage as ‘spot fires burn’ domestically and likely interest rate hike looms
articles.author: Ben Doherty and AAP

paras.en: As “summit season” begins, reaffirming ties with fellow leaders on the world stage could be a circuit breaker for Anthony Albanese amid domestic and economic woes, analysts have said.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，随着“峰会季节”的开始，在世界舞台上重申与其他领导人的关系可能会成为安东尼·阿尔巴内塞在国内和经济困境中的断路器。

paras.en: But a likely interest rate hike, triggered by higher-than-expected inflation, while the prime minister is overseas will make his job – and the treasurer’s – even harder.
paras.zh: 但当总理在海外时，由于通胀高于预期而可能引发加息，这将使他和财政部长的工作变得更加困难。

paras.en: Albanese is attending the Commonwealth heads of government meeting (Chogm) in Antigua and Barbuda from Saturday.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞将于周六参加在安提瓜和巴布达举行的英联邦政府首脑会议（Chogm）。

paras.en: He will hold talks with King Charles III and allies including the UK and Canadian prime ministers, Andy Burnham and Mark Carney, at the biennial meeting.
paras.zh: 他将在两年一次的会议上与国王查理三世以及包括英国和加拿大总理安迪·伯纳姆和马克·卡尼在内的盟友举行会谈。

paras.en: The discussions will constitute a well-needed reset after controversies over grant funding and pressures on inflation, according to Dr Zareh Ghazarian, an associate professor of politics at Monash University.
paras.zh: 莫纳什大学政治学副教授扎雷·加扎里安博士表示，在有关拨款资金和通胀压力的争议之后，这些讨论将构成急需的重新调整。

paras.en: “It is a strategically important time for him,” Ghazarian said.
paras.zh: “这对他来说是一个具有重要战略意义的时刻，”加扎里安说。

paras.en: “He’s got a lot of spot fires burning domestically but this is going to be an opportunity for him to present himself to be much more on the front foot.
paras.zh: “他在国内遇到了很多麻烦，但这对他来说将是一个展示自己处于领先地位的机会。

paras.en: “There’s a lot of pressure, so this trip could just be a moment to reset the political debate for people … this is a critical moment to present himself as a world leader amongst other world leaders.”
paras.zh: “压力很大，所以这次访问可能只是为人们重新设定政治辩论的时刻……这是在其他世界领导人中展现自己作为世界领导人的关键时刻。”

paras.en: Albanese will be away when the Reserve Bank hands down its next interest rate decision on Tuesday, with markets tipping a rise to 4.85%.
paras.zh: 周二储备银行公布下一次利率决定时，Albanese 将离开，市场预计利率将上涨至 4.85%。

paras.en: It would be the fifth interest rate hike in 2026 and a challenging situation for the government to navigate, amid continuing cost-of-living pressures.
paras.zh: 这将是 2026 年第五次加息，在持续的生活成本压力下，政府面临着一个充满挑战的局面。

paras.en: Albanese emphasised the value of attending Chogm before his departure on Saturday morning. In a crowded international calendar, the Commonwealth is occasionally dismissed as irrelevant, an anachronistic relic of a former imperial era.
paras.zh: Albanese 在周六早上出发前强调了参加 Chogm 的价值。在拥挤的国际日历中，英联邦偶尔会被认为无关紧要，是前帝国时代不合时宜的遗物。

paras.en: “The Commonwealth heads of government meeting is an important forum,” Albanese said.
paras.zh: “英联邦政府首脑会议是一个重要的论坛，”阿尔巴内塞说。

paras.en: “[It provides] an opportunity to work with some of our closest partners on shared challenges, including climate change, the preservation of our oceans, trade and investment and the rise of AI.”
paras.zh: “[它提供]了与我们一些最亲密的合作伙伴合作应对共同挑战的机会，包括气候变化、保护我们的海洋、贸易和投资以及人工智能的崛起。”

paras.en: The issue of historical slavery, and its ongoing legacy, is likely to be a key point of contention at Chogm.
paras.zh: 历史上的奴隶制问题及其持续的遗留问题可能是乔格姆争论的一个关键点。

paras.en: Burnham, writing in the Guardian, said having “difficult conversations to safeguard the Commonwealth for the future” was the right thing to do.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆在《卫报》上撰文表示，“为了维护英联邦的未来而进行艰难的对话”是正确的做法。

paras.en: “Not just because it is in our interests, but because the Britain I believe in is confident, decent and brave. We led the world in abolishing slavery – and we can show leadership again today.”
paras.zh: “不仅因为这符合我们的利益，还因为我相信的英国是自信、正派和勇敢的。我们在废除奴隶制方面领导了世界——今天我们可以再次展现领导力。”

paras.en: He called the transatlantic slave trade a “brutal and barbaric violation” of people “treated as property and worked to their deaths”.
paras.zh: 他称跨大西洋奴隶贸易是对“被视为财产并工作致死”的人的“残酷和野蛮侵犯”。

paras.en: “I want to express my sorrow and regret for the pain and suffering of so many millions of people, and to recognise the way it still shapes our world today,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“我想对数百万人的痛苦和磨难表示悲伤和遗憾，并认识到它仍然塑造着我们今天的世界。”

paras.en: Caribbean nations have made renewed calls for Britain to apologise for its role in selling enslaved people for profit, and for reparations, as the King toured the Caribbean.
paras.zh: 在国王访问加勒比海期间，加勒比国家再次呼吁英国为其贩卖奴隶以获取利润的行为道歉，并要求英国赔偿。

paras.en: Burnham said: “Listening to calls for a formal apology on behalf of the British state will form an important part of this process and I am open to them.” But he said he did not believe reparations for slavery was the “right answer”.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆表示：“听取代表英国政府正式道歉的呼声将构成这一进程的重要组成部分，我对他们持开放态度。”但他表示，他不认为对奴隶制进行赔偿是“正确的答案”。

paras.en: Australia would not be a bystander to any debate about slavery and the slave trade.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚不会成为任何有关奴隶制和奴隶贸易辩论的旁观者。

paras.en: Across the 19th and early 20th centuries, Australian agriculture relied heavily on “blackbirding”: the use of coercion, trickery, bribery and kidnapping to bring more than 60,000 Pacific Islanders to work as indentured labourers in Australia, primarily on Queensland’s sugar and cotton plantations.
paras.zh: 整个 19 世纪和 20 世纪初，澳大利亚农业严重依赖“黑鸟行为”：利用胁迫、欺骗、贿赂和绑架手段，将 6 万多名太平洋岛民带到澳大利亚作为契约劳工，主要在昆士兰州的糖料和棉花种植园工作。

paras.en: The Chogm meeting will kick off a busy end to the year overseas for Albanese, with international summits in Turkey, the Philippines, China and the US in coming weeks.
paras.zh: Chogm 会议将为 Albanese 在海外忙碌的一年拉开序幕，未来几周将在土耳其、菲律宾、中国和美国举行国际峰会。

paras.en: The foreign affairs minister, Penny Wong, is currently in Atlanta, Georgia for the G20 foreign ministers’ meeting. The start of that conference has been overshadowed by the presence of Russia, with about one-third of the countries attending vowing to boycott the customary “family photo” if the Russian foreign minister, Sergei Lavrov, was involved.
paras.zh: 外交部长黄英贤目前正在佐治亚州亚特兰大参加二十国集团外长会议。这次会议的开始因俄罗斯的出席而蒙上阴影，大约三分之一的与会国家发誓，如果俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫参与其中，他们将抵制传统的“全家福”。

articles.title: Riot police deployed to Poland’s constitutional court after judge suspended
articles.author: Jakub Krupa

paras.en: Riot police were locked in a tense standoff with protesters outside Poland’s constitutional court on Friday night after its top judge was suspended in the latest escalation in a decade-long dispute over the court’s legal status.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，在波兰宪法法院最高法官被停职后，防暴警察在波兰宪法法院外与抗议者陷入紧张对峙，这是长达十年的关于法院法律地位的争议的最新升级。

paras.en: The clashes followed a controversial decision by a group of government-appointed judges to suspend the court’s contested president, Bogdan Święczkowski, and his deputy, Bartłomiej Sochański, amid disagreements over the bench’s legitimacy.
paras.zh: 冲突发生之前，一群政府任命的法官因对法官席合法性存在分歧，做出了一项有争议的决定，暂停了有争议的院长博格丹·斯维茨科夫斯基和他的副手巴特沃米耶·索恰斯基的职务。

paras.en: The move prompted a furious reaction from the rightwing opposition Law and Justice (PiS) party, with its leader, Jarosław Kaczyński, condemning what he claimed was an “assault” on the court.
paras.zh: 此举引起了右翼反对派法律与正义党（PiS）的强烈反应，其领导人雅罗斯瓦夫·卡钦斯基（Jarosław Kaczyński）谴责了他所称的对法院的“攻击”。

paras.en: The court frequently ruled in favour of Polish legislation over EU law and the European Union accused Poland’s highest court of being too close to the nationalist political power of the time.
paras.zh: 法院经常做出有利于波兰立法而非欧盟法律的裁决，欧盟指责波兰最高法院与当时的民族主义政治势力过于接近。

paras.en: The PiS-backed conservative president, Karol Nawrocki, a close ally of Donald Trump, turned his plane around en route to a state visit in Senegal to return to Warsaw and intervene at the court on Friday night.
paras.zh: 法律与正义党支持的保守派总统、唐纳德·特朗普的亲密盟友卡罗尔·诺罗基在前往塞内加尔进行国事访问的途中调转飞机返回华沙，并于周五晚上在法庭上进行干预。

paras.en: Hundreds of protesters – including opposition MPs – gathered outside the building to show their support for the suspended judges. Three people were reportedly arrested for trying to force entry through a heavy police presence.
paras.zh: 包括反对派议员在内的数百名抗议者聚集在大楼外，以表达对被停职的法官的支持。据报道，三人因试图在大量警察存在下强行进入而被捕。

paras.en: Shortly before 1am on Saturday, Nawrocki appeared outside the court and made his way through the police cordon, with one video showing the president tussling with security and other judges to force his entry into the building. As of 4am local time, the president remained inside the building.
paras.zh: 周六凌晨 1 点前不久，纳罗基出现在法庭外，穿过警方警戒线，一段视频显示总统与保安和其他法官发生争执，强行进入大楼。截至当地时间凌晨 4 点，总统仍留在大楼内。

paras.en: In a clip posted online, Nawrocki was heard saying the government appointees “were not judges of the constitutional court”.
paras.zh: 在网上发布的一段视频中，纳罗基称政府任命的人“不是宪法法院的法官”。

paras.en: In a statement read out on his behalf outside the court at 5am, Nawrocki criticised “a violation of Poland’s constitutional order”, saying “a constitutional body was seized by force”. He called for security forces to leave the premises.
paras.zh: 凌晨 5 点，纳乌罗基在法庭外代表他宣读了一份声明，批评“这违反了波兰的宪法秩序”，称“宪法机构被武力夺取”。他呼吁安全部队离开该场所。

paras.en: The latest clash is likely to further polarise the country, setting the scene for a dramatic showdown in next year’s parliamentary election, with polls showing the populist-right with a chance to return to power.
paras.zh: 最近的冲突可能会进一步加剧该国的两极分化，为明年议会选举中的戏剧性摊牌奠定基础，民意调查显示民粹主义右翼有机会重新掌权。

paras.en: The court has been at the centre of a dispute dating back to 2015, when the outgoing centrist and the incoming rightwing governments moved in quick succession with legally questionable moves to stack the bench with their appointees.
paras.zh: 自2015年以来，最高法院一直处于争议的中心，当时即将卸任的中间派和即将上任的右翼政府接连采取了在法律上存在争议的举措，将其任命的法官安排在法官席上。

paras.en: The dispute over the appointments paralysed the court, followed by further attempts to cripple it during the PiS’s eight years of illiberal rule marred by clashes with the EU over the rule of law.
paras.zh: 关于任命的争议使法院陷入瘫痪，随后在法律与公正党长达八年的非自由统治期间，法院进一步试图削弱法院，并因与欧盟在法治问题上发生冲突而受到损害。

paras.en: Since returning to power in 2023, Poland’s prime minister, Donald Tusk, has repeatedly pledged to reverse controversial reforms as he sought to mend relations with Brussels, while refusing to recognise the court’s legitimacy in the current form.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年重新掌权以来，波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克一再承诺扭转有争议的改革，寻求修复与布鲁塞尔的关系，同时拒绝承认该法院目前形式的合法性。

paras.en: However, his efforts have been thwarted by opposition-aligned presidents who used their veto powers and expansive interpretations of their powers to block reforms.
paras.zh: 然而，他的努力遭到了与反对派结盟的总统的阻挠，这些总统利用否决权和对其权力的广泛解释来阻止改革。

paras.en: In the latest twist this year, Nawrocki, who unexpectedly won last year’s presidential election against Tusk’s candidate, refused to swear in five judges elected by the current parliament, further complicating the legal situation.
paras.zh: 今年最新的转折是，纳乌罗基去年出人意料地击败了图斯克的候选人赢得了总统选举，他拒绝让现任议会选出的五名法官宣誓就职，这使得法律局势进一步复杂化。

paras.en: Earlier this month, the Council of Europe’s advisory body on the rule of law, the Venice Commission, said the president’s refusal should not prevent judges from taking up their posts.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，欧洲委员会法治咨询机构威尼斯委员会表示，总统的拒绝不应妨碍法官就职。

paras.en: On Friday night, a group of judges elected by the current majority moved to suspend Święczkowski, a former minister under PiS, and seize procedural control of the court. Anna Korwin-Piotrowska – who is one of the five judges not accepted by Nawrocki – said she had assumed the top position, citing the longest experience in the judiciary.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，由现任多数派选出的一组法官采取行动，暂停了法律与公正党的前部长斯维茨科夫斯基的职务，并夺取了法院的程序控制权。安娜·科温-皮奥特罗斯卡（Anna Korwin-Piotrowska）是纳罗基未接受的五名法官之一，她表示自己已担任最高职位，并援引了在司法部门最长的经验。

paras.en: Experts are deeply divided in their opinion on the legality of the judge’s suspension. Marcin Matczak, a prominent law expert and outspoken critic of PiS, said he “did not think he would ever end up defending” Święczkowski, but believed the legal basis for his suspension was “non-existent”.
paras.zh: 对于法官停职的合法性，专家们意见分歧很大。著名法律专家、法律与公正党直言不讳的批评者马尔辛·马特扎克 (Marcin Matczak) 表示，他“不认为自己最终会为希维茨科斯基辩护”，但认为对他进行停职的法律依据“不存在”。

paras.en: Separately, justice minister Waldemar Żurek said he had asked for Święczkowski and deputy chief Sochański to be stripped of their legal immunity to face prosecution for obstructing the court’s work.
paras.zh: 另外，司法部长瓦尔德马尔·祖雷克表示，他已要求剥夺斯维茨科夫斯基和副院长索恰斯基的法律豁免权，以便因妨碍法院工作而面临起诉。

paras.en: Despite criticism, Tusk insisted that “restoring the rule of law is our duty.”
paras.zh: 尽管受到批评，图斯克坚称“恢复法治是我们的责任”。

paras.en: “After years of PiS’s lawlessness, this is a difficult process, sometimes painful, and it requires decisive action. There is no other way,” he argued.
paras.zh: “法律与公正党多年来无法无天，这是一个艰难的过程，有时甚至是痛苦的，需要采取果断行动。没有其他办法，”他辩称。

paras.en: Earlier this month, he pledged “the court will begin its work in accordance with the constitution, whether people like it or not.”
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，他承诺“无论人们喜欢与否，法院都将根据宪法开始工作。”

paras.en: Poland’s foreign minister Radosław Sikorski told reporters on the margins of a G20 meeting in Atlanta that “the constitutional tribunal was politicised under the previous government.”
paras.zh: 波兰外交部长拉多斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团 (G20) 会议间隙对记者表示，“宪法法庭在上届政府的领导下被政治化了。”

paras.en: “What is happening has the purpose of allowing the majority of duly elected judges to make the tribunal function again,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“正在发生的事情的目的是让大多数正式当选的法官能够使法庭再次发挥作用。”

paras.en: Opposition leaders and the court’s social media account accused the government of carrying out a judicial “a coup d’état”. Several European far-right figures, including Britain’s Nigel Farage, Liz Truss and the Netherlands’ Geert Wilders, also condemned the move.
paras.zh: 反对派领导人和法院的社交媒体账户指责政府进行司法“政变”。包括英国的奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）、利兹·特拉斯（Liz Truss）和荷兰的吉尔特·维尔德斯（Geert Wilders）在内的几位欧洲极右翼人士也谴责了此举。

paras.en: US ambassador to Poland Tom Rose said in a post on X: “The events unfolding tonight … are very serious.”
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯在X上发帖称：“今晚发生的事件……非常严重。”

paras.en: “Both sides offer sharply different accounts of what happened and why,” he said. “Whatever the facts ultimately establish, thousands gathering outside the tribunal make an already dangerous situation more combustible. The last thing Poland needs is a confrontation that spirals into something far worse.”
paras.zh: “双方对所发生的事情及其原因的说法截然不同，”他说。 “无论事实最终如何，数千人聚集在法庭外会使本已危险的局势变得更加易燃。波兰最不需要的就是一场升级为更糟糕局面的对抗。”

articles.title: Why North Korea's 'elite' hackers are the prime suspect in major Binance hack

paras.en: Two major blockchain analytics firms say they have robust intelligence pointing to a North Korean state-backed group as the likely culprits in the $6.3bn (Â£4.7bn) hack of Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange.
paras.zh: 两家主要区块链分析公司表示，他们掌握的可靠情报表明，朝鲜国家支持的集团可能是全球最大加密货币交易所币安网遭受 63 亿美元（47 亿英镑）黑客攻击的罪魁祸首。

paras.en: The Lazarus Group, a North Korean hacking unit also known as TraderTraitor, was identified "with high confidence" by TRM Labs, as well as Chainalysis.
paras.zh: Lazarus Group 是一个朝鲜黑客组织，也被称为 TraderTraitor，被 TRM Labs 和 Chainaanalysis “高度信任”地认定为该组织。

paras.en: This incident is just the latest linked to the country, one of the poorest in the world and where access to the internet is severely restricted.
paras.zh: 这起事件只是与该国有关的最新一起事件，该国是世界上最贫穷的国家之一，互联网的访问受到严格限制。

paras.en: Experts accuse the government of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un of relying on cybercrime to finance itself, something Pyongyang has long denied.
paras.zh: 专家指责朝鲜领导人金正恩政府依靠网络犯罪为自己筹集资金，但平壤长期以来一直否认这一点。

paras.en: Though not financial, the nation's most spectacular suspected hack took place in 2014. The target: Sony Pictures, which had made the Hollywood film The Interview. The film involves a plot to assassinate Kim.
paras.zh: 虽然不是金融方面的，但美国最引人注目的疑似黑客攻击发生在 2014 年。目标：索尼影业，该公司制作了好莱坞电影《采访》。这部电影涉及刺杀金的阴谋。

paras.en: The resulting hack exposed thousands of embarrassing emails exchanged among the studio's top executives.
paras.zh: 由此引发的黑客攻击暴露了工作室高层管理人员之间交换的数千封令人尴尬的电子邮件。

paras.en: Last year, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said North Korea was responsible for the theft of $1.5bn on the Bybit exchange.
paras.zh: 去年，美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 表示，朝鲜对 Bybit 交易所 15 亿美元的盗窃案负有责任。

paras.en: In the aftermath of that incident, the agency said TraderTraitor had moved to quickly launder and disperse the stolen assets, converting them to Bitcoin and other digital assets with a goal of eventually turning them into hard currency.
paras.zh: 该事件发生后，该机构表示 TraderTraitor 已采取行动，迅速清洗和分散被盗资产，将其转换为比特币和其他数字资产，目标是最终将其变成硬通货。

paras.en: The FBI has broadly accused North Korea of "illicit cybercrime and virtual asset theft activities".
paras.zh: 联邦调查局广泛指责朝鲜进行“非法网络犯罪和虚拟资产盗窃活动”。

paras.en: The nation has systematically developed its cyber operations, recruiting the most promising students from universities and channeling them into hacker groups overseen by North Korea's intelligence agency, according to reports.
paras.zh: 据报道，该国系统地发展了网络行动，从大学招募最有前途的学生，并将他们引导到朝鲜情报机构监督的黑客组织中。

paras.en: Some of the cyberwarfare conducted takes place just over the nation's border in China, according to analysis from tech groups.
paras.zh: 根据科技组织的分析，一些网络战发生在中国边境附近。

paras.en: Much of its hacking activity has centred on monetary gain.
paras.zh: 其大部分黑客活动都以金钱利益为中心。

paras.en: North Korean hackers are also suspected in the theft of $620m worth of cryptocurrency in 2022.
paras.zh: 朝鲜黑客还涉嫌在 2022 年盗窃价值 6.2 亿美元的加密货币。

paras.en: In this most recent heist, North Korean agents are accused of using a special authorisation to turn a Binance hot wallet, which is connected to the internet, into one that moved funds automatically to the attacker.
paras.zh: 在最近的这起抢劫案中，朝鲜特工被指控使用特殊授权将连接到互联网的币安热钱包变成自动将资金转移给攻击者的钱包。

paras.en: TRM said it's likely the attacker gained access to Binance's hot wallet signing system as part of the scheme.
paras.zh: TRM 表示，作为该计划的一部分，攻击者很可能获得了币安热钱包签名系统的访问权限。

paras.en: Binance has not directly responded to the BBC's queries about the incident's potential links to the area.
paras.zh: 币安尚未直接回应 BBC 关于该事件与该地区潜在联系的询问。

paras.en: The company had initially said it thought an engineer's laptop had been compromised, allowing unauthorised withdrawals, but later said the attack was wider.
paras.zh: 该公司最初表示，它认为一名工程师的笔记本电脑已被入侵，允许未经授权的提款，但后来表示攻击范围更广。

paras.en: "Our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach," Binance's co-CEO Richard Teng said.
paras.zh: 币安联合首席执行官理查德·滕（Richard Teng）表示：“我们随后的调查发现了更多违规点。”

paras.en: Some 80% of stolen assets have been secured, a Binance spokesperson said on Friday, but the rest remains unaccounted for.
paras.zh: 币安发言人周五表示，约 80% 的被盗资产已被锁定，但其余资产仍下落不明。

paras.en: If the accusations are true, the record-making heist shows how powerful suspected North Korean hackers have become â a sign that the tools of the hacking trade have grown sharper.
paras.zh: 如果指控属实，这起创纪录的抢劫事件表明，朝鲜黑客嫌疑人已经变得多么强大——这表明黑客交易的工具变得更加锋利。

paras.en: Experts say the rise of artificial intelligence has also given threat actors new ways to carry out crime, through automation and other means.
paras.zh: 专家表示，人工智能的兴起也为威胁行为者提供了通过自动化和其他手段实施犯罪的新方法。

paras.en: In this case, it's plausible that AI was used to infiltrate Binance's systems.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，人工智能可能被用来渗透币安的系统。

paras.en: As Chainalysis put it, the attacker used laundering patterns "we have not seen before".
paras.zh: 正如 Chainaanalysis 所说，攻击者使用了“我们以前从未见过”的洗钱模式。

articles.title: Trump's tariffs could shutter this Canadian town - its residents are fighting to save it

paras.en: As you cross the Ottawa river into TÃ©miscaming, Quebec, the paper mill takes up much of the horizon.
paras.zh: 当您穿过渥太华河进入魁北克省特米斯卡明时，造纸厂占据了地平线的大部分区域。

paras.en: The town itself was built over a century ago, around the mill and the region's forests filled with pine, birch, spruce and fir. Now, the main employer and economic anchor sits idle after trade talks broke down between Canada and the US and President Donald Trump imposed more tariffs on the country.
paras.zh: 该镇本身建于一个多世纪前，周围是磨坊和该地区长满松树、桦树、云杉和冷杉的森林。现在，在加拿大和美国之间的贸易谈判破裂以及唐纳德·特朗普总统对该国征收更多关税后，主要雇主和经济支柱闲置了。

paras.en: Most of the millâs 360 employees are out of work, kept afloat for the moment with partial pay from government tariff-relief.
paras.zh: 该工厂 360 名员工中的大多数都失业了，暂时靠政府关税减免的部分工资维持生计。

paras.en: For some, like Nadine Suley, the shuttering of the mill could mark not just a lost livelihood, but a lost way of life.
paras.zh: 对于纳丁·苏利（Nadine Suley）等人来说，关闭工厂不仅意味着失去生计，而且意味着失去生活方式。

paras.en: She is not "a city girl", and is heading out moose hunting later to take advantage of the short season, like much of the town. She quips they'll all need the free meat provided by the animals this year.
paras.zh: 她不是“城市女孩”，她会像镇上的大部分人一样，利用淡季的机会去狩猎驼鹿。她打趣说，今年他们都需要动物提供的免费肉。

paras.en: "It's not just a job. It's our home," Suley says, adding that the US tariffs on her town feel like "a personal attack".
paras.zh: 苏利说：“这不仅仅是一份工作。这是我们的家。”她补充说，美国对她所在的城镇征收关税感觉就像是“人身攻击”。

paras.en: In early October, American owner RYAM went ahead with an "economic shutdown" of the mill for "an indefinite period".
paras.zh: 10 月初，美国所有者 RYAM 继续对该工厂进行“无限期”的“经济关闭”。

paras.en: Property values in TÃ©miscaming fell almost overnight, and "For Sale" signs dot the yards of modest middle-class homes that make up most of the town.
paras.zh: 特米斯卡明的房产价值几乎一夜之间就下跌了，“待售”的牌子点缀在构成该镇大部分地区的中产阶级住宅的院子里。

paras.en: There are fears that essential service people - from grocery store clerks to the doctors at the small local hospital - could also be on their way out.
paras.zh: 人们担心，从杂货店店员到当地小医院的医生等基本服务人员也可能会离开。

paras.en: "If the mill goes down, it'll turn into a ghost town," says Ronnie Raymond, who like many in the town comes from a family of mill workers.
paras.zh: “如果工厂倒闭，它就会变成一座鬼城，”罗尼·雷蒙德（Ronnie Raymond）说，他和镇上的许多人一样来自一个工厂工人家庭。

paras.en: "There'll be nothing, nothing left. There's no work for anybody, really. It's scary."
paras.zh: “什么都没有，什么都没有留下。真的，任何人都没有工作。这太可怕了。”

paras.en: At a high level, Canada's economy has weathered the ongoing trade war with the US, its largest customer. The national unemployment rate has remained largely steady at around 6.5% since Trump's tariffs were first implemented. It's been coupled with tepid but consistent economic growth.
paras.zh: 从高层来看，加拿大经济经受住了与其最大客户美国持续的贸易战。自特朗普关税首次实施以来，全国失业率基本稳定在 6.5% 左右。与此同时，经济增长不温不火但持续稳定。

paras.en: But a closer look at the numbers shows pockets of deep pain in industries directly hit by US tariffs of up to 50%, like steel, aluminium, automobiles and - in the case of TÃ©miscaming - lumber, pulp and paper. It raises questions about whether the Carney government is doing enough to help those struggling while a trade deal remains elusive.
paras.zh: 但仔细观察这些数字就会发现，受美国高达 50% 的关税直接打击的一些行业，例如钢铁、铝、汽车，以及木材、纸浆和纸张（在 Témiscaming 的案例中）都遭受了深刻的痛苦。这引发了人们的疑问：在贸易协议仍难以达成的情况下，卡尼政府是否采取了足够的措施来帮助那些陷入困境的人。

paras.en: "If there was 10% of job loss in Toronto or Montreal or Quebec City or Vancouver, it'd be all over the news, and it'd be a lot of pressure on the governments to do something,â says StÃ©phane Lefebvre, an employee and union leader, whose father and grandfather also worked at the mill.
paras.zh: “如果多伦多、蒙特利尔、魁北克市或温哥华的失业人数达到 10%，新闻就会满天飞，政府就会面临很大的压力，需要采取行动，”员工兼工会领袖 Stéphane Lefebvre 说，他的父亲和祖父也在工厂工作。

paras.en: That economic pain could have ripple effects on the entire forestry industry in the region, including saw mills and trucking. One local contractor told the BBC he has already had to lay off 13 people.
paras.zh: 这种经济痛苦可能会对该地区的整个林业产生连锁反应，包括锯木厂和卡车运输。一位当地承包商告诉 BBC，他已经不得不解雇 13 名员工。

paras.en: The last time the town faced a threat this existential was in 1973, when the mill's then-American owner threatened to shut it down, prompting the local workers and managers to come together and purchase it.
paras.zh: 该镇上一次面临这种生存威胁是在 1973 年，当时工厂的美国老板威胁要关闭工厂，促使当地工人和管理人员联合起来购买工厂。

paras.en: They turned it into Tembec, a Quebec-owned, international company with branches across North America and France.
paras.zh: 他们将其转变为 Tembec，一家魁北克拥有的国际公司，在北美和法国设有分支机构。

paras.en: The workers now hope to do it again, mobilising a coalition of locals who want to buy the plant back from RYAM, which purchased it in 2017.
paras.zh: 现在，工人们希望再次这样做，他们动员了一个当地人联盟，希望从 RYAM 手中买回该工厂，RYAM 于 2017 年购买了该工厂。

paras.en: "We're hoping that lightning will hit twice," Lefebvre says, speaking inside the town's union hall.
paras.zh: “我们希望闪电会击中两次，”列斐伏尔在镇工会大厅内说道。

paras.en: But he contends that they cannot do so without significant help from Prime Minister Mark Carney and the Quebec government, either in the form of tariff relief or financial support.
paras.zh: 但他认为，如果没有马克·卡尼总理和魁北克政府的大力帮助，无论是关税减免还是财政支持，他们就无法做到这一点。

paras.en: Suley notes that the prime minister has placed emphasis on "buy local" and supporting Canadian workers since he was elected. Backing the town's bid to buy back the mill, she says, would be a way for Carney to fulfil that pledge.
paras.zh: 苏利指出，自当选以来，总理一直强调“购买本地产品”和支持加拿大工人。她说，支持该镇回购工厂的投标，将是卡尼履行这一承诺的一种方式。

paras.en: In an email to the BBC, RYAM said it would not comment on a potential sale of the plant or any prospective buyers.
paras.zh: RYAM 在给 BBC 的电子邮件中表示，不会对该工厂的潜在出售或任何潜在买家发表评论。

paras.en: Mayor Alain Gauthier doesn't blame RYAM for its decision. He calls US tariffs "a bomb to shut down our manufacturing in Canada".
paras.zh: 市长阿兰·高蒂尔 (Alain Gauthier) 并没有责怪 RYAM 的决定。他称美国的关税是“一枚炸弹，旨在关闭我们在加拿大的制造业”。

paras.en: He wants Ottawa to retaliate with its own duties on the board products coming into Canada from the US, currently tariff-free.
paras.zh: 他希望渥太华对从美国进入加拿大的纸板产品征收关税进行报复，目前这些产品是免税的。

paras.en: And he says that while politicians have said Canada is in an economic war with the US, "in reality we see absolutely no evidence of war measures being taken".
paras.zh: 他说，虽然政界人士表示加拿大正在与美国进行经济战，但“实际上，我们绝对没有看到采取战争措施的证据”。

paras.en: "We feel we got into a war with kid's water guns to fight back."
paras.zh: “我们觉得我们用孩子的水枪进行了反击。”

paras.en: Some, like Lefebvre, feel that forestry has taken a back seat in the fight to save other tariffed industries like steel and autos.
paras.zh: 列斐伏尔等人认为，在拯救钢铁和汽车等其他关税行业的斗争中，林业已退居二线。

paras.en: This month, Industry Minister MÃ©lanie Joly threatened Stelco - one of Canada's largest steelmakers - with financial penalties or a forced asset sale should they go ahead with the planned layoffs of some 500 workers due to steel tariffs pressure.
paras.zh: 本月，工业部长梅兰妮·乔利 (Mélanie Joly) 威胁加拿大最大的钢铁制造商之一 Stelco，如果他们因钢铁关税压力而继续计划裁员约 500 名工人，将受到经济处罚或强制出售资产。

paras.en: Stelco in Hamilton, near Toronto, is owned by US-based Cleveland-Cliffs, which committed to keeping jobs in Canada when it bought the firm in 2024.
paras.zh: 位于多伦多附近汉密尔顿的 Stelco 属于美国克利夫兰克里夫斯公司 (Cleveland-Cliffs) 所有，该公司在 2024 年收购该公司时承诺保留加拿大的就业机会。

paras.en: Last week, Carney and Ontario Premier Doug Ford announced nearly C$9bn ($6.4bn; Â£4.8bn) to help Ontario's steel and auto sector. The funds will be used to help the industries modernise, strengthen domestic demand and open new markets overseas, they said.
paras.zh: 上周，卡尼和安大略省省长道格·福特宣布拨款近 90 亿加元（64 亿美元；48 亿英镑）来帮助安大略省的钢铁和汽车行业。他们表示，这些资金将用于帮助行业现代化、增强内需和开拓海外新市场。

paras.en: SÃ©bastien Lemire, the elected MP for TÃ©miscaming from the Bloc QuÃ©bÃ©cois party, told the BBC that he is "very concerned and worried" about what he calls inaction from the Carney government to support the town and Quebec's forestry industry more broadly.
paras.zh: 来自魁北克集团的当选议员塞巴斯蒂安·勒米尔 (Sébastien Lemire) 告诉 BBC，他对卡尼政府在更广泛地支持该镇和魁北克林业方面的不作为感到“非常担忧”。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Minister Joly told the BBC in a statement that the government has made available $400m to support the forestry sector in rural and remote areas.
paras.zh: 乔利部长的发言人在一份声明中告诉 BBC，政府已提供 4 亿美元来支持农村和偏远地区的林业部门。

paras.en: It has also launched a programme to help businesses impacted by tariffs to access cash-flow while they work to pivot away from US markets.
paras.zh: 它还启动了一项计划，帮助受关税影响的企业在努力撤离美国市场的同时获得现金流。

paras.en: On the TÃ©miscaming mill, the spokesperson said that the government "is actively working with all parties involved to find a viable solution to the issues facing the company, while responsibly managing Canadians' dollars."
paras.zh: 关于 Témiscaming 工厂，发言人表示，政府“正在积极与所有相关方合作，为公司面临的问题寻找可行的解决方案，同时负责任地管理加拿大人的资金。”

paras.en: In August, after the breakdown in trade talks, the US imposed 50% duties on a some C$28bn of Canadian goods, including wood and paper products like pulp, stationery and boxes.
paras.zh: 8 月，贸易谈判破裂后，美国对价值约 280 亿加元的加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税，其中包括木浆、文具和盒子等纸制品。

paras.en: Canada in response imposed its own "dollar-for-dollar" counter-tariffs.
paras.zh: 作为回应，加拿大征收了自己的“美元对美元”反关税。

paras.en: The TÃ©miscaming mill, which produces paperboard used in frozen-food packaging across North America and in the scratch-off lottery tickets commonly found at convenience stores, sends roughly 75% of its production to the US.
paras.zh: Témiscaming 工厂生产用于北美冷冻食品包装和便利店常见的刮刮乐彩票的纸板，其大约 75% 的产品销往美国。

paras.en: Trump argues these import taxes boost US manufacturing and create jobs - essentially seeking to protect US workers who could face similar fates to those in TÃ©miscaming.
paras.zh: 特朗普认为，这些进口税促进了美国制造业的发展并创造了就业机会，本质上是为了保护可能面临与Témiscaming类似命运的美国工人。

paras.en: Frank Dottori has been through all of this before.
paras.zh: 弗兰克·多托里以前就经历过这一切。

paras.en: Now in his 80s and retired in TÃ©miscaming, he was an engineer at the mill that was instrumental in organising its employees in the 1970s to take a 10% cut in order to collectively purchase it. He went on to become CEO.
paras.zh: 现年 80 多岁的他在特米斯卡明退休，曾是一家工厂的工程师，该工厂在 20 世纪 70 年代组织员工减薪 10% 以便集体购买工厂方面发挥了重要作用。他后来成为首席执行官。

paras.en: Their ambitions were seen as foolish at the time, and he recalls being "politely ejected" by the Quebec premier when he first came knocking for support.
paras.zh: 他们的野心在当时被认为是愚蠢的，他记得当魁北克省长第一次上门寻求支持时，他被“礼貌地驱逐”了。

paras.en: But they prevailed with the help of the labour union and an ex-employee with executive experience and plenty of swagger. Dottori attributes their success to this person's forceful charisma.
paras.zh: 但在工会和一位拥有高管经验且神气十足的前雇员的帮助下，他们取得了胜利。多托里将他们的成功归功于这个人强大的魅力。

paras.en: Dottori said the new generation of workers need someone just as bold.
paras.zh: 多托里说，新一代工人需要同样大胆的人。

paras.en: "Does the local group have that? Highly unlikely. Can they get it? Yeah, if they if they organise themselves," he said.
paras.zh: “当地团体有这个能力吗？极不可能。他们能得到它吗？是的，如果他们自己组织的话，”他说。

paras.en: It is also imperative, he says, that US tariffs be lifted to restore the mill's long-term economic viability, at least in the short term.
paras.zh: 他表示，还必须取消美国关税，以恢复工厂的长期经济生存能力，至少在短期内如此。

paras.en: Many workers in TÃ©miscaming say they are placing some hope in the upcoming US midterm elections to put pressure on Trump â whose approval ratings have fallen among Americans, according to polls â to ease some of his tariffs on Canada.
paras.zh: Témiscaming 的许多工人表示，他们寄希望于即将到来的美国中期选举，向特朗普施压——根据民意调查，特朗普在美国人中的支持率已经下降——以放松对加拿大的部分关税。

paras.en: "We'll take any help we can get," Suley says, adding: "There are Americans that care what's going on, and it's affecting them too."
paras.zh: 苏利说：“我们将采取一切可能的帮助。”他补充道：“有些美国人关心正在发生的事情，这也影响到了他们。”

paras.en: There are signs the Trump administration is taking note of that pressure, with some tariffs on Canadian goods lifted last week after lobbying from Republican Maine Senator Susan Collins, who is running for re-election in November. Those changes don't apply to products made at TÃ©miscaming's mill, however.
paras.zh: 有迹象表明，特朗普政府正在注意到这种压力，在11月竞选连任的缅因州共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯(Susan Collins)的游说下，上周取消了对加拿大商品的部分关税。然而，这些变化并不适用于 Témiscaming 工厂生产的产品。

paras.en: Suley and others hope a resolution will come quickly, before winter, when sub-zero temperatures could freeze equipment at the idle plant, causing damage that would make reopening even more difficult.
paras.zh: 苏利和其他人希望在冬季之前尽快达成解决方案，届时零度以下的气温可能会冻结闲置工厂的设备，造成损害，从而使重新开工变得更加困难。

paras.en: In the meantime, Lefebvre says he is committed to making the dream of local ownership of the mill a reality, regardless of what happens.
paras.zh: 与此同时，列斐伏尔表示，无论发生什么，他都致力于使当地拥有工厂的梦想成为现实。

paras.en: "We're in Game Seven right now," he says. "We're gonna play till the last whistle."
paras.zh: “我们现在正处于第七场比赛，”他说。 “我们会一直比赛到最后一声哨响。”

articles.title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election

paras.en: The breaking news from Spain this week was shocking but also shockingly familiar: another collision on the high-speed rail line south from Madrid, with reports of dozens killed.
paras.zh: 本周来自西班牙的突发新闻令人震惊，但也令人震惊地熟悉：马德里以南的高铁线上再次发生碰撞，据报道有数十人死亡。

paras.en: It is just nine months since two trains crashed near Cordoba, killing 46 people. Now 69 bodies have been recovered here in central Spain, from wreckage strewn over the tracks and down an embankment.
paras.zh: 距离科尔多瓦附近两列火车相撞、造成 46 人死亡仅九个月。目前，西班牙中部已从散布在铁轨和路堤上的残骸中找到了 69 具尸体。

paras.en: For the victims' families it is devastating; a personal tragedy.
paras.zh: 对于受害者家属来说，这是毁灭性的；个人悲剧。

paras.en: But it is also a national disaster that has shattered confidence in the country's rail network and the Socialist-led government of Pedro SÃ¡nchez. It is playing out just weeks before the snap general election he called.
paras.zh: 但这也是一场全国性灾难，粉碎了人们对该国铁路网络和佩德罗·桑切斯领导的社会党政府的信心。就在他呼吁提前大选的几周前，这场比赛即将上演。

paras.en: The formal investigation into the Toledo train disaster has only just been launched but the government has been quick to take control of the narrative.
paras.zh: 对托莱多火车灾难的正式调查才刚刚启动，但政府很快就控制了局势。

paras.en: From the first hours after the collision, Transport Minister Oscar Puente began suggesting "human error" was to blame, batting responsibility as far as possible from the cabinet.
paras.zh: 从碰撞发生后的最初几个小时起，交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特就开始暗示“人为失误”是事故的罪魁祸首，并尽可能地推卸内阁的责任。

paras.en: On Friday, he appeared before the press for a second time to set out what he called the "objective facts" of the crash and counter a surge of criticism against the government.
paras.zh: 周五，他第二次出现在媒体面前，阐述了他所谓的坠机事件的“客观事实”，并反驳了针对政府的批评浪潮。

paras.en: The opposition People's Party (PP) is among those calling for his resignation as a "moral" and "ethical" move.
paras.zh: 反对党人民党是呼吁他辞职的人士之一，认为这是“道德”和“道德”的举动。

paras.en: Instead after expressing "huge pain and sadness" for the victims, Puente went on the offensive.
paras.zh: 在向受害者表达“巨大的痛苦和悲伤”后，普恩特转而采取攻势。

paras.en: He rejected talk of chronic underinvestment in infrastructure and insisted that Spain's high-speed signalling safety system, the LZB, was neither old nor inadequate: Germany and Austria use the same.
paras.zh: 他否认了基础设施投资长期不足的说法，并坚称西班牙的高速信号安全系统 LZB 既不陈旧也不不足：德国和奥地利也使用同样的系统。

paras.en: In Spain, it has already failed 170 times so far this year, he revealed, but called that "normal" and around the EU average.
paras.zh: 他透露，今年迄今为止，西班牙已经失败了 170 次，但他称这“正常”，接近欧盟平均水平。

paras.en: The problem surrounds what happens next - when the system fails and control of the line shifts to manual.
paras.zh: 问题围绕着接下来会发生什么——当系统发生故障并且生产线的控制转向手动时。

paras.en: In this case, the minister highlighted a series of human errors that proved catastrophic.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，部长强调了一系列被证明是灾难性的人为错误。

paras.en: Crucially, at one point a controller instructed a stalled train to restart, clearing it to advance at up to 160km/h (100 mph) even though a second train was stuck on the line up ahead.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，在某一时刻，管制员指示一列停滞的列车重新启动，使其以 160 公里/小时（100 英里/小时）的速度前进，尽管前面有第二列列车被困在线路上。

paras.en: The impending collision was clear from audio calls and on big screens in the control centre in Madrid.
paras.zh: 从音频通话和马德里控制中心的大屏幕上可以清楚地看到即将发生的碰撞。

paras.en: "They worked. We checked. They could see what was happening," Puente confirmed. But the advancing train was never ordered to stop.
paras.zh: “他们工作了。我们检查了。他们可以看到发生了什么，”普恩特证实。但行进中的火车从未被命令停止。

paras.en: "I'm no judge... But these are the facts."
paras.zh: “我不是法官……但这些都是事实。”

paras.en: So would he take personal and political responsibility anyway, and resign? Puente called it his "duty", rather, to remain as minister.
paras.zh: 那么他无论如何都会承担个人和政治责任并辞职吗？普恩特称其为“职责”，更确切地说，是继续担任部长。

paras.en: "I'll face up to things, explain, elucidate," he countered. "I'll think how to improve the system, and give confidence to those who want to travel by train and feel calm and safe."
paras.zh: “我会面对事情，解释，阐明，”他反驳道。 “我会思考如何改进这个系统，给那些想要乘坐火车旅行并感到平静和安全的人信心。”

paras.en: But Spaniards will take a lot of persuading.
paras.zh: 但西班牙人需要花很多力气才能说服他们。

paras.en: "This is not only a very serious accident, but the second in a very short time," Paco Camas of the pollster Ipsos points out.
paras.zh: 民意调查机构益普索 (Ipsos) 的帕科·卡马斯 (Paco Camas) 指出：“这不仅是一次非常严重的事故，而且是短时间内的第二起事故。”

paras.en: An investigation into January's crash in Adamuz, near Cordoba, is still open, with initial reports suggesting there was a crack in the rails - very different to the latest collision.
paras.zh: 对一月份发生在科尔多瓦附近阿达穆斯的事故的调查仍在进行中，初步报告显示铁轨上出现了裂缝，这与最近的事故非常不同。

paras.en: "It destroys people's confidence not only in the railways but institutions in general," Camas warns. "And in Spain when such things happen, we know that people blame their government."
paras.zh: 卡马斯警告说：“它不仅破坏了人们对铁路的信心，而且破坏了整个机构的信心。” “在西班牙，当这样的事情发生时，我们知道人们会责怪他们的政府。”

paras.en: For Team SÃ¡nchez it is the latest in a spiral of crises.
paras.zh: 对于桑切斯团队来说，这是一系列危机中的最新一起。

paras.en: Allegations of corruption against the prime minister's close relatives still persist, all denied.
paras.zh: 针对总理近亲的腐败指控仍然存在，但均被否认。

paras.en: Then there was a sudden influx of migrants from Morocco this summer to the Spanish exclave of Ceuta. That got right-wing opponents shouting about incompetence and underfunding.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，大量移民突然从摩洛哥涌入西班牙飞地休达。这让右翼反对者大喊无能和资金不足。

paras.en: Later, a video of a pensioner being forcibly evicted from her home went viral and sparked street protests.
paras.zh: 随后，一段养老金领取者被强行逐出家门的视频在网上疯传，引发街头抗议。

paras.en: That's when SÃ¡nchez called an early election.
paras.zh: 就在那时，桑切斯呼吁提前举行选举。

paras.en: His chances of winning the vote looked slim even before the train crash. Now they have plummeted.
paras.zh: 甚至在火车相撞之前，他赢得选票的机会就显得微乎其微。现在他们已经暴跌了。

paras.en: Most recent polls showed the centre-right PP coming first and forming a coalition with the far-right Vox.
paras.zh: 最近的民意调查显示，中右翼的人民党（PP）领先，并与极右翼的 Vox 组成联盟。

paras.en: "They have this majority in almost 95% of the simulations we have done," Prof Pablo Simon of Madrid's Carlos III University explains.
paras.zh: 马德里卡洛斯三世大学的巴勃罗·西蒙教授解释说：“我们所做的近 95% 的模拟中，他们占据了多数。”

paras.en: But SÃ¡nchez had been running a positive campaign, trying to lure apathetic voters to the polls to vote socialist.
paras.zh: 但桑切斯一直在进行积极的竞选活动，试图吸引冷漠的选民到投票站投票给社会主义者。

paras.en: "They've totally lost control of the agenda and the emotion of this campaign," Simon says. "It's going to be extremely difficult now. There is this general mood of decay, of a country that's not working properly. A depression."
paras.zh: “他们完全失去了对这场竞选的议程和情绪的控制，”西蒙说。 “现在将变得极其困难。人们普遍感到衰败，国家运转不正常。萧条。”

paras.en: There have already been small protests over the train crash led by far-right groups in Madrid and large numbers of police are on stand-by this weekend ahead of further potential clashes, organised online.
paras.zh: 马德里已经发生了由极右翼团体领导的针对火车事故的小规模抗议活动，本周末大量警察处于待命状态，以应对网上组织的进一步潜在冲突。

paras.en: "We all travelled in silence and really sad," Paloma told me at the city station, where she had just pulled in on a half empty train.
paras.zh: “我们都在沉默中旅行，真的很悲伤，”帕洛玛在城市车站告诉我，她刚刚坐上了半空的火车。

paras.en: She admitted she's scared of the high-speed network now and angry at the government.
paras.zh: 她承认她现在害怕高速网络并对政府感到愤怒。

paras.en: "This crash will change all of our votes, completely," Paloma said. "We'll shift from the left wing to the right. Because of everything that's happened."
paras.zh: “这次崩盘将彻底改变我们所有的选票，”帕洛玛说。“我们将从左翼转向右翼。因为发生的一切。”

paras.en: Lucia takes the high-speed AVE into Madrid each day, and is scared too.
paras.zh: 露西娅每天乘坐高速 AVE 前往马德里，她也很害怕。

paras.en: "This was human error. But there's been two accidents now with more than 100 dead," she says. "Things here are really bad. They have to change."
paras.zh: “这是人为失误。但现在已经发生了两起事故，造成 100 多人死亡，”她说。 “这里的情况真的很糟糕。他们必须改变。”

paras.en: Producer Davide Ghiglione contributed to this report
paras.zh: 制片人 Davide Ghiglione 对本报告做出了贡献

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

articles.title: Michigan Auto Body Association Celebrates Inaugural Open House
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Michigan Auto Body Association (MABA) held its inaugural event, an open house hosted by America’s Most Wanted 4×4, on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026. The afternoon program ran from 1 to 6 p.m. and drew members, prospective members and vendors eager to learn what the new association is all about.
MABA announced its official founding as a statewide professional association and its affiliation with the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) late last year.

The day opened with a “meet the board” session, where attendees asked board members why the association was formed, how the bard came together and where MABA is headed. As an affiliate of SCRS, MABA then welcomed Aaron Schulenburg, executive director of SCRS, for a virtual introduction. Schulenburg welcomed MABA and its members to the SCRS partnership and highlighted benefits popular with independent collision repairers, including SCRS’s health care program and 401(k) offering.

Stephanie Sheppard of CARS Co-Op followed with an overview of another MABA member benefit, one designed to help Michigan collision repairers save money on day-to-day purchases. Host America’s Most Wanted 4×4 then led attendees on a tour of its facility and shared the story of its rapid growth in a specialized segment of the industry.
MABA was co-founded by Don Speace and Dustin DeLongpre of Axalta.

“This was a dream come true,” said Speace. “As we followed up with and helped our customers, we kept hearing the same thing over and over: Michigan needs a voice. We need someone representing our collision repair industry here in Michigan, like our colleagues have in other states. So here we are! Dustin and I did the background work and helped form the founding board based on what leaders across our industry told us. With a lot of hard work, we launched the association just a couple of months ago, and here we are today.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “I think the industry had a very successful event today,” said Jason Taylor, chair of MABA. “Members, member candidates and vendors all came out to see what MABA is about, and from the conversations I’ve had, they were impressed. When it was time to meet the board, they had questions we need to follow up on, and that’s exactly what we were hoping for. We want to hear from our industry and learn what we need to do to make things happen. In that respect, this was a very good start.”

“This event showed both the desire and the need within our industry,” said Joe Townsend, treasurer of MABA. “A number of vendors quickly stepped up as sponsors, giving back to the industry in a way they trust will make it better. I’m very appreciative and pleased with today’s turnout. We had more than 100 registrants in just over a month since we announced the event, with only a few last-minute no-shows. That speaks volumes.”
Attendee questions gave the board clear direction. Brian Johnson, vice chair of MABA, pointed to one that stood out: how will MABA decide which legislation to pursue when points of view differ?

“We don’t have that answer at this moment, but it will definitely be discussed at our next board meeting,” said Johnson. “We’ve been focused on putting our infrastructure in place: meeting the legal requirements of running an association, building budgets, setting goals and making it a priority to secure a strong lobbyist to represent us in Lansing. Now it’s time to get into the details, so hearing these questions was exciting.”

Taylor added that another question, how will members be kept up to date and given a voice, “reinforced what the board has said all along. We need to include our members and keep them educated and informed. Frankly, that’s why we’re here.”
Secretary Scott Webster was encouraged by how closely shop owners engaged with the presentations.

“We worked through a few technical difficulties, but afterward I saw attendees sitting down with Stephanie from CARS Co-Op to ask questions,” said Webster. “That kind of engagement reassures us that we’re doing the right thing for the right reasons.” He added with a laugh, “I enjoyed networking with my peers, and even more, enjoying a meeting without having to take the minutes for a change.”
The open house wrapped up with pizza, beverages and time for attendees to network.

MABA plans to build on the open house’s momentum with more events in the first quarter of 2027. Dates, locations and programs will be announced in the coming weeks. Collision repair professionals, vendors and industry partners are encouraged to watch for updates at michiganaba.org and on MABA’s social media channels, and to reach out about membership and sponsorship opportunities.

articles.title: Total Loss Auto Claims Weigh on Insurance Customer Satisfaction
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: How satisfied are auto insurance customers in that moment of truth when they need to file a claim? According to the recently released JD Power 2026 U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study, that depends on whether the damage is repairable or not.

This year, overall customer satisfaction with the auto insurance claims process improves 4 points (on a 1,000-point scale) when damages are repairable but declines 12 points when vehicles are deemed a total loss, marking a third consecutive year of declining satisfaction for total loss claims. Overall, 26% of auto insurance claims were classified as total losses in 2026, up from just 16% four years ago as vehicle repairs become more costly, more customers keep their vehicles on the road longer and higher deductibles remove smaller repairs from the claim process.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “A complex mix of trends are conspiring to make this an incredibly challenging market environment for managing auto insurance claims customer satisfaction,” said Mark Garrett, director of global insurance intelligence at JD Power. “On the positive side, rates are coming down and repair cycle times have improved dramatically, so customers who can have their vehicles fixed are showing high levels of satisfaction with the claims experience. However, persistent affordability challenges have many customers keeping vehicles longer or making changes to their policy, such as dropping rental coverage or taking on higher insurance deductibles. Additionally, many customers are upside down on their auto loans, which means the payoff in a total loss scenario can be less than they owe on their vehicles. All of these can make for a poor customer experience in the event of a total loss.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The following are some key findings of the 2026 study:

- Overall satisfaction split based on vehicle repairability: The overall auto claims customer satisfaction score is 700, which is unchanged from last year. Satisfaction scores diverge sharply, however, depending on whether the vehicle is able to be repaired. Overall satisfaction improves 4 points year over year when vehicles are repaired and declines 12 points year over year when vehicles are deemed a total loss. Satisfaction with total losses has continued to trend down for a third consecutive year, declining 46 points since 2023.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: - Effects of total losses exacerbated by macroeconomic trends: More than one-fourth (26%) of auto insurance claims resulted in a total loss in 2026, up from just 16% four years ago. Total loss customer satisfaction scores are lowest (490) when the amount paid by the insurer does not cover the amount the customer still owes on their vehicle loan. Among total loss customers with loans on their vehicles, 25% received payouts that were less than what they owed on their vehicle.

- Repair cycle times improve significantly: When vehicles can be repaired, the likelihood of getting them repaired quickly is getting much easier. Claim volumes are down sharply, so shops have more capacity for repair work, resulting in average repair cycle times of just 15.3 days through the first quarter of 2026, a reduction of 10 days from the first quarter of 2024.

- Room to improve on cross-channel communications: Overall customer satisfaction scores are highest (804) when customers completely agree that their insurer provided a seamless experience across channels. Satisfaction scores are lowest (390) when customers disagree with that statement, which often results from not understanding explanations, using multiple channels to ask questions or digital tools not working as expected. Currently, insurers are delivering a seamless cross-channel experience just 54% of the time, one of the lowest-performing key performance indicators in the study.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Amica ranks highest in overall customer satisfaction with a score of 775. Nationwide (743) ranks second and Automobile Club of Southern CA (AAA) (740) ranks third.

The U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study examines the auto claims experiences of customers from the largest insurance providers throughout the U.S. across eight dimensions (in order of importance): trust; fairness of settlement; people; time to settle claim; communication; ease of resolving claim; ease of starting claim; and digital channels. The 2026 study is based on responses from 8,261 auto insurance customers who settled a claim within the past nine months prior to participating in the survey. It was fielded from September 2025 through August 2026. The study excludes claimants whose vehicle incurred only glass/windshield damage or was stolen, or who only filed a roadside assistance claim.

articles.title: Dipstick Replacement Sensors: How They Work
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: GM has taken a lot of guff recently for eliminating the dipstick on some of their newer V8 engines and replacing it with a sensor. Let’s talk about how those sensors actually work, and how and when they measure the oil level.

It’s not like, for example, a brake master cylinder that has a float and a level that turns on the light on the dash when it reaches a certain level. These sensors are ultrasonic. In other words, it’s sending out a sound wave into the oil pan and determining the oil level that way.

How does it know when to measure the level of oil in the oil pan? If you’re using a dipstick, the vehicle would be parked, it probably wouldn’t be running, and that’s when you’re checking the oil level. The sensor works the same way: It’s only measuring the oil level at certain instances. Let’s say it’s in Park when you first start up. Let’s say you’re sitting at a traffic light; that is when it’s measuring the level.
For more on sensors and how they work, including oxygen and TPMS sensors, watch the video above.

articles.title: The Effect of Thin Brake Fluid on Vehicle Systems
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Lower-viscosity brake fluid plays a growing role in modern brake systems. Today’s vehicles require brake fluid to move quickly through hydraulic control units that support ABS, stability control, traction control and several ADAS braking functions.
Modern brake systems use faster valves, tighter internal passages and more frequent automatic brake interventions than systems used 20 years ago.

As a result, many late-model vehicles require lower-viscosity brake fluid. The goal is to maintain efficient fluid movement at low temperatures so the hydraulic unit can build and release pressure quickly.
Lower-Viscosity Brake Fluid Supports Faster Response

The ABS hydraulic unit is used, not only during panic stops, but for electronic stability control, traction control, adaptive cruise control, collision mitigation braking and automatic emergency braking.

Inside the hydraulic control unit, brake fluid moves through small valves and narrow passages. Lower viscosity allows pressure to increase and decrease faster, helping the system make quicker and more precise braking corrections.
Brake fluid condition is also important. Moisture contamination can increase viscosity, lower the boiling point and raise corrosion risk.
Technicians should use the exact brake fluid specified by the vehicle manufacturer and replace it according to the proper service information.
